classical
  let Bround := Finset.univ.filter fun j : Fin r => (colour j).val = round
  let Xfinal := Finset.univ.filter fun x : VH =>
    (colour (B.sourceCluster x)).val < round ∨ B.sourceCluster x ∈ Bround
  change ∃ K : PartialCompatibleEmbedding B A X →
      PMF (PartialCompatibleEmbedding B A Xfinal),
    (∀ f ∈ μ.support, ∀ h ∈ (K f).support, ∀ x ∈ X,
      h.toFun x = f.toFun x) ∧
    ColourRoundInvariant B A colour epsilon density D C n round
      Bround Xfinal (μ.bind K)
  induction hcard : (Bround \ S).card using Nat.strong_induction_on
      generalizing S X μ with
  | h m ih =>
    have hSB : S ⊆ Bround := by
      intro j hj
      exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ j, hS j hj⟩
    by_cases hempty : Bround \ S = ∅
    · have hSfull : S = Bround :=
        Finset.Subset.antisymm hSB (Finset.sdiff_eq_empty_iff_subset.mp hempty)
      subst S
      have hX : X = Xfinal := hμ.2.2.2.2.1
      subst X
      refine ⟨PMF.pure, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro f hf h hh x hx
        have heq : h = f := (PMF.mem_support_pure_iff _ _).mp hh
        subst h
        rfl
      · simpa only [PMF.bind_pure] using hμ
    · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hempty
      obtain ⟨hiB, hiS⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hi
      have hicolour : (colour i).val = round := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hiB).2
      let Xnext := Finset.univ.filter fun x : VH =>
        (colour (B.sourceCluster x)).val < round ∨
          B.sourceCluster x ∈ insert i S
      obtain ⟨κ, hκagree, _, hκinv⟩ := step S X μ hS hμ i hicolour hiS
      have hnextS : ∀ j ∈ insert i S, (colour j).val = round := by
        intro j hj
        rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hj with rfl | hj
        · exact hicolour
        · exact hS j hj
      have hdecrease : (Bround \ insert i S).card < m := by
        rw [← hcard]
        apply Finset.card_lt_card
        refine Finset.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · intro j hj
          obtain ⟨hjB, hjS⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hj
          exact Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr
            ⟨hjB, fun h => hjS (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem h)⟩
        · intro heq
          have : i ∈ Bround \ insert i S := heq.symm ▸ hi
          exact (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp this).2 (Finset.mem_insert_self i S)
      obtain ⟨L, hLagree, hLinv⟩ :=
        ih (Bround \ insert i S).card hdecrease (insert i S) Xnext
          (μ.bind κ) hnextS hκinv rfl

        have hdomain := hμ.2.2.2.2.1
        rw [hdomain] at hx
        obtain ⟨_, hx⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hx
        apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
        refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ x, ?_⟩
        exact hx.imp_right Finset.mem_insert_of_mem
      refine ⟨fun f => (κ f).bind L, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro f hf h hh x hx
        obtain ⟨g, hg, hhg⟩ := (PMF.mem_support_bind_iff _ _ _).mp hh
        have hgμ : g ∈ (μ.bind κ).support :=
          (PMF.mem_support_bind_iff _ _ _).mpr ⟨f, hf, hg⟩
        exact (hLagree g hgμ h hhg x (hXXnext hx)).trans

      · rw [← PMF.bind_bind]
        exact hLinv
ColourClassSequentialCompletion.lean_statement:
theorem ColourClassSequentialCompletion
    {r q : ℕ} {VH VG : Type*} [Fintype VH] [Fintype VG]
    [DecidableEq VH] [DecidableEq VG]
    {H : SimpleGraph VH} {G : SimpleGraph VG} {R : SimpleGraph (Fin r)}
    [DecidableRel R.Adj]
    (B : BlowUpInstance r VH VG H G R) (A : CandidacySystem B)
    (colour : Fin r → Fin q) (epsilon density : ℕ → ENNReal)
    (D : ℕ) (C : ENNReal) (n round : ℕ)
    (step : ∀ (T : Finset (Fin r)) (Z : Finset VH)
      (ν : PMF (PartialCompatibleEmbedding B A Z)),
      (∀ j ∈ T, (colour j).val = round) →
      ColourRoundInvariant B A colour epsilon density D C n round T Z ν →
      ∀ i : Fin r, (colour i).val = round → i ∉ T →
        let Z' := Finset.univ.filter fun x : VH =>
          (colour (B.sourceCluster x)).val < round ∨
            B.sourceCluster x ∈ insert i T
        let Y := Finset.univ.filter fun x : VH => B.sourceCluster x = i
        ∃ κ : PartialCompatibleEmbedding B A Z →
            PMF (PartialCompatibleEmbedding B A Z'),
          (∀ f ∈ ν.support, ∀ h ∈ (κ f).support, ∀ x ∈ Z,
            h.toFun x = f.toFun x) ∧
          (∀ f ∈ ν.support, VertexSpreadOn
            ((κ f).map fun h => fun y : {y : VH // y ∈ Y} => h.toFun y.1)
            (C / n) Set.univ) ∧
          ColourRoundInvariant B A colour epsilon density D C n round
            (insert i T) Z' (ν.bind κ))
    (S : Finset (Fin r)) (X : Finset VH)
    (μ : PMF (PartialCompatibleEmbedding B A X))
    (hS : ∀ j ∈ S, (colour j).val = round)
    (hμ : ColourRoundInvariant B A colour epsilon density D C n round S X μ) :
    let Bround := Finset.univ.filter fun j : Fin r => (colour j).val = round
    let Xfinal := Finset.univ.filter fun x : VH =>
      (colour (B.sourceCluster x)).val < round ∨ B.sourceCluster x ∈ Bround
    ∃ K : PartialCompatibleEmbedding B A X →
        PMF (PartialCompatibleEmbedding B A Xfinal),
      (∀ f ∈ μ.support, ∀ h ∈ (K f).support, ∀ x ∈ X,
        h.toFun x = f.toFun x) ∧
      ColourRoundInvariant B A colour epsilon density D C n round
        Bround Xfinal (μ.bind K) := by
ColourClassSequentialCompletion.name: ColourClassSequentialCompletion
ColourClassSequentialCompletion.tex_proof:
\begin{proof}
This is the finite sequential control argument in
\texttt{paper/r2-colour-round-addendum.tex}, lines 241--271 and 333--341.
All invariants in this proof have the same round $t$; no new round is created.
By \noderef{ColourRoundInvariant}, the starting domain is exactly $X(t,S)$,
and the law's spread clause is the restriction-law bound of
\noderef{VertexSpreadOn}.  Maps and their restrictions are interpreted as in
\noderef{PartialCompatibleEmbedding}.

Induct on the finite remaining set $F=B_t\setminus S$, equivalently on
$|F|$, with the induction assertion quantified over all $S,X,\mu$ satisfying
the stated assumptions.  If $F$ is empty, $S=B_t$ since $S\subseteq B_t$.
The domain clause gives $X=X(t,B_t)$.  Identify the two partial-embedding
types using this equality, without changing any map.  Let $K(f)$ be the
point mass at $f$ under this identification.  Binding $\mu$ to these point
masses is precisely $\mu$ under the same domain identification, so its
invariant is the given one and map preservation is immediate.  This also
covers an empty colour class.  No transition is invoked in this case.

If $F$ is nonempty, choose $i\in F$.  Then $c(i)=t$ and $i\notin S$,
so apply the stated transition to the actual current law $\mu$.  Retain
its kernel $\kappa$, put $S_1=S\cup\{i\}$, $X_1=X(t,S_1)$, and put
$\mu_1=\mu\mathbin{\mathrm{bind}}\kappa$.
The transition supplies $\mathcal I(t,S_1;X_1,\mu_1)$, as well as preservation
of $X$ and the conditional spread of the new cluster for every supported
past outcome.  Since $i\in B_t\setminus S$, $S_1\subseteq B_t$ and
$B_t\setminus S_1=(B_t\setminus S)\setminus\{i\}$ has cardinality
$|F|-1$.  The induction hypothesis applied to this specified $\mu_1$
therefore gives a kernel $L$ from $\mathcal E(X_1)$ to
$\mathcal E(X(t,B_t))$, preserving every supported input on $X_1$, and
\[
 \mathcal I(t,B_t;X(t,B_t),\mu_1\mathbin{\mathrm{bind}}L).
\]
Define $K(f)=\kappa(f)\mathbin{\mathrm{bind}}L$ for every input $f$, including
inputs outside $\operatorname{supp}\mu$; no properties are required there.
The probability law of this composite kernel satisfies
\[
 \mu\mathbin{\mathrm{bind}}K
   =(\mu\mathbin{\mathrm{bind}}\kappa)\mathbin{\mathrm{bind}}L
   =\mu_1\mathbin{\mathrm{bind}}L.
\]
Indeed, the mass of an output $h$ on either side is
$\sum_f\sum_g\mu(f)\kappa(f)(g)L(g)(h)$; reassociation of the nonnegative
probability sums proves the equality.  Thus the final invariant is for
the recursively bound law, not for a newly chosen unrelated law.

To check preservation, fix $f\in\operatorname{supp}\mu$ and
$h\in\operatorname{supp}K(f)$.  The bind mass formula gives some
$g\in\operatorname{supp}\kappa(f)$ with $h\in\operatorname{supp}L(g)$:
a positive nonnegative sum has a positive summand, and a positive product
has positive factors.  The same formula, using the positive masses
$\mu(f)$ and $\kappa(f)(g)$, shows $g\in\operatorname{supp}\mu_1$.
Also $X\subseteq X_1$, because $X=X(t,S)$ and $S\subseteq S_1$.
For $x\in X$, preservation for $L$ and then for $\kappa$ gives
$h(x)=g(x)=f(x)$.  This proves the asserted preservation for $K$ and completes
the finite induction.  At each stage the spread clause is supplied for that
stage's bound law by the transition and retained by the induction hypothesis;
unfolding \noderef{ColourRoundInvariant} gives the final spread conclusion.
The conditional new-cluster bounds are those of the successive kernels
conditional on their actual past outcomes.  No conditioning on a global
success event, and no multiplication by a class-size-dependent loss, occurs.
\end{proof}
ColourClassSequentialCompletion.tex_statement:
\begin{lemma}[Sequential completion of a colour class]
Let $B$ be a blow-up instance with finite source and host vertex sets $V_H,V_G$,
candidacy system $A$, and reduced graph $R$ on $[r]$.  Fix a colouring
$c:[r]\to[q]$, sequences $\varepsilon,p:\mathbb N\to[0,\infty]$, a degree
bound $D\in\mathbb N$, $C\in[0,\infty]$, and $n,t\in\mathbb N$.
Write $\mathcal E(Z)$ for the compatible partial embeddings with domain $Z$,
$B_t=\{j:c(j)=t\}$, and
\[
 X(t,T)=\{x\in V_H:c(B.\mathrm{sourceCluster}(x))<t
                     \text{ or }B.\mathrm{sourceCluster}(x)\in T\}.
\]
Use the invariant $\mathcal I(t,T;Z,\nu)$ of
\noderef{ColourRoundInvariant}, with parameters $(\varepsilon,p,D,C,n)$.
Assume the following one-cluster transition for every finite $T\subseteq[r]$,
finite $Z\subseteq V_H$, and specified law $\nu$ on $\mathcal E(Z)$:
if $T\subseteq B_t$ and $\mathcal I(t,T;Z,\nu)$ holds, then for every
$i\in B_t\setminus T$, setting $Z'=X(t,T\cup\{i\})$ and
$Y_i=\{x:B.\mathrm{sourceCluster}(x)=i\}$, there is a probability kernel
$\kappa:\mathcal E(Z)\to\operatorname{PMF}(\mathcal E(Z'))$ such that
\begin{enumerate}
\item for every $f\in\operatorname{supp}\nu$, every
$h\in\operatorname{supp}\kappa(f)$, and every $x\in Z$, $h(x)=f(x)$;
\item for each $f\in\operatorname{supp}\nu$, the restriction to $Y_i$ of the
law $\kappa(f)$ is $(C/n)$-vertex-spread on the entire host vertex set;
\item $\mathcal I(t,T\cup\{i\};Z',\nu\mathbin{\mathrm{bind}}\kappa)$ holds
for the actual bound law.
\end{enumerate}
Then, for every $S\subseteq B_t$, finite $X\subseteq V_H$, and specified
law $\mu$ on $\mathcal E(X)$ satisfying $\mathcal I(t,S;X,\mu)$,
there is a kernel
$K:\mathcal E(X)\to\operatorname{PMF}(\mathcal E(X(t,B_t)))$ such that
every supported output of $K(f)$ agrees with $f$ on $X$ whenever
$f\in\operatorname{supp}\mu$, and
\[
 \mathcal I(t,B_t;X(t,B_t),\mu\mathbin{\mathrm{bind}}K).
\]
In particular this completed law is $(C/n)$-vertex-spread.
\end{lemma}
ColourClassSequentialCompletion.title: ColourClassSequentialCompletion

ColourRoundInvariant.lean_proof:
round < q ∧
  (∀ j : Fin r, (Finset.univ.filter fun k : Fin r => R.Adj j k).card ≤ D) ∧
  (∀ ⦃i j : Fin r⦄, i ≠ j →
    (R.Adj i j ∨ ∃ k : Fin r, R.Adj i k ∧ R.Adj k j) →
    colour i ≠ colour j) ∧
  (∀ j ∈ touched, (colour j).val = round) ∧
  X = Finset.univ.filter (fun x =>
    (colour (B.sourceCluster x)).val < round ∨ B.sourceCluster x ∈ touched) ∧
    VertexSpreadOn (μ.map fun f => fun x : {x : VH // x ∈ X} => f.toFun x.1)
      (C / n) Set.univ ∧
    ∀ f ∈ μ.support, ∀ j : Fin r, j ∉ touched → round ≤ (colour j).val →
      let exposure := (Finset.univ.filter fun k : Fin r =>
        ((colour k).val < round ∨ k ∈ touched) ∧ R.Adj j k).card
      let touchedNeighbors := touched.filter fun k => R.Adj j k
      let witnessError := if touchedNeighbors.Nonempty then epsilon (round + 1) else epsilon round
      let L : Finset (VH ⊕ VG) := Finset.univ.filter fun z =>
        ∃ y : VH, z = Sum.inl y ∧ B.sourceCluster y = j ∧ y ∉ X
      let Vused : Finset VG := X.image f.toFun
      let Q : Finset (VH ⊕ VG) := Finset.univ.filter fun z =>
        ∃ v : VG, z = Sum.inr v ∧ B.hostCluster v = j ∧ v ∉ Vused
      let Aⱼ : SimpleGraph (VH ⊕ VG) := SimpleGraph.fromRel fun p s =>
        ∃ y : VH, ∃ v : VG, p = Sum.inl y ∧ s = Sum.inr v ∧
          (y, v) ∈ UpdatedCandidacyCluster B A X f j
      exposure ≤ D ∧ touchedNeighbors.card ≤ 1 ∧
      ∃ W : SimpleGraph (VH ⊕ VG), W ≤ Aⱼ ∧
        @SuperRegularPair (VH ⊕ VG) _ W (Classical.decRel _)
          L Q witnessError (density exposure)

def ColourRoundInvariant {r q : ℕ} {VH VG : Type*} [Fintype VH] [Fintype VG]
    [DecidableEq VH] [DecidableEq VG]
    {H : SimpleGraph VH} {G : SimpleGraph VG} {R : SimpleGraph (Fin r)} [DecidableRel R.Adj]
    (B : BlowUpInstance r VH VG H G R) (A : CandidacySystem B)
    (colour : Fin r → Fin q) (epsilon density : ℕ → ENNReal)
    (D : ℕ) (C : ENNReal) (n round : ℕ) (touched : Finset (Fin r))
    (X : Finset VH) (μ : PMF (PartialCompatibleEmbedding B A X)) : Prop :=
ColourRoundInvariant.name: ColourRoundInvariant
ColourRoundInvariant.tex_statement:
\begin{definition}[Colour-round induction invariant]
Fix a graph $R$ of maximum degree at most $D$, a colouring
$c:V(R)\to[q]$ that assigns different colours to every two distinct
vertices at distance at most two, an error sequence
$(\varepsilon_t)_{t=0}^{q}$, exposure-density sequence $(D_x)_{x=0}^D$,
and a round $t<q$.  For a set $S\subseteq c^{-1}(t)$ of current clusters
already processed within the round, let $X(t,S)$ be the union of all source
clusters whose colour is less than $t$, together with the clusters in $S$.
For a specified law $\mu$ on compatible partial embeddings with domain $X$,
the invariant $\mathcal I(t,S;X,\mu)$ says first that $X=X(t,S)$ and that
$\mu$ is $(C/n)$-vertex-spread.  It also says that, for every law
outcome and every unembedded cluster $j$, the true updated candidacy graph
contains a spanning
\[
  (\varepsilon(t,S,j),D_{x_j(t,S)})\text{-super-regular witness},
  \qquad
  x_j(t,S)=|N_R(j)\cap(\{k:c(k)<t\}\cup S)|.
\]
Here
\[
 \varepsilon(t,S,j)=
 \begin{cases}
   \varepsilon_{t+1},&N_R(j)\cap S\ne\varnothing,\\
   \varepsilon_t,&N_R(j)\cap S=\varnothing.
 \end{cases}
\]
Moreover, the invariant records the square-colouring consequence
$|N_R(j)\cap S|\leq1$ for every such $j$.  Thus a witness touched earlier in
the current round has the next-round error, an untouched witness retains the
current-round error, and in both cases its density coordinate is exactly its
actual exposure coordinate.
\end{definition}
ColourRoundInvariant.title: ColourRoundInvariant

ColourRoundKernelAssembly.lean_proof:
classical
  dsimp only
  intro hlocal
  let X' := Finset.univ.filter fun x : VH =>
    (colour (B.sourceCluster x)).val < round ∨ B.sourceCluster x ∈ insert i touched
  let Y := Finset.univ.filter fun x : VH => B.sourceCluster x = i
  rcases hinv with ⟨hround, hdegree, hcolour, hS, hX, hspread, hwitness⟩
  have hgeom := ColourRoundUntouchedGeometry R colour D round touched i hdegree hcolour hS hi hiS
  have hdom : X' = X ∪ Y := by
    rw [hX]
    ext x
    simp only [X', Y, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and,
      Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_insert]
    tauto
  have hXY : Disjoint X Y := by
    apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro x hx hy
    have hc : B.sourceCluster x = i := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hy).2
    rw [hX] at hx
    have hh := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2
    rw [hc, hi] at hh
    exact hh.elim (fun h => (Nat.lt_irrefl _ h)) hiS
  have hExt (f : PartialCompatibleEmbedding B A X)
      (g : PartialCompatibleEmbedding B (UpdatedCandidacy B A X f) Y) :
      ∃ h : PartialCompatibleEmbedding B A X',
        (∀ x ∈ X, h.toFun x = f.toFun x) ∧ (∀ y ∈ Y, h.toFun y = g.toFun y) := by
    rw [hdom]
    exact ExtendUpdatedPartialEmbedding B A X Y hXY f g
  let ext (f : PartialCompatibleEmbedding B A X)
      (g : PartialCompatibleEmbedding B (UpdatedCandidacy B A X f) Y) := (hExt f g).choose
  have extX (f : PartialCompatibleEmbedding B A X)
      (g : PartialCompatibleEmbedding B (UpdatedCandidacy B A X f) Y) :=
    (hExt f g).choose_spec.1
  have extY (f : PartialCompatibleEmbedding B A X)
      (g : PartialCompatibleEmbedding B (UpdatedCandidacy B A X f) Y) :=
    (hExt f g).choose_spec.2
  let nu (f : PartialCompatibleEmbedding B A X) (hf : f ∈ mu.support) := (hlocal f hf).choose
  have hnu (f : PartialCompatibleEmbedding B A X) (hf : f ∈ mu.support) :=
    (hlocal f hf).choose_spec
  let K (f : PartialCompatibleEmbedding B A X) (hf : f ∈ mu.support) := (nu f hf).map (ext f)
  obtain ⟨f0, hf0⟩ := mu.support_nonempty
  let kappa : PartialCompatibleEmbedding B A X → PMF (PartialCompatibleEmbedding B A X') :=
    fun f => if hf : f ∈ mu.support then K f hf else K f0 hf0
  have hk (f : PartialCompatibleEmbedding B A X) (hf : f ∈ mu.support) : kappa f = K f hf := by
    simp only [kappa, dif_pos hf]
  have hkernelX : ∀ f ∈ mu.support, ∀ h ∈ (kappa f).support,
      ∀ x ∈ X, h.toFun x = f.toFun x := by
    intro f hf h hh
    rw [hk f hf] at hh
    obtain ⟨g, _, rfl⟩ := (PMF.mem_support_map_iff _ _ _).mp hh
    exact extX f g
  have hkernelY : ∀ f ∈ mu.support, VertexSpreadOn
      ((kappa f).map fun h => fun y : Y => h.toFun y.1) (C / n) Set.univ := by
    intro f hf
    rw [hk f hf, PMF.map_comp]
    have heq : (fun h : PartialCompatibleEmbedding B A X' => fun y : Y => h.toFun y.1) ∘
        ext f = (fun g => fun y : Y => g.toFun y.1) := by
      funext g y
      exact extY f g y.1 y.2
    rw [heq]
    exact (hnu f hf).1
  have hun (j : Fin r) (hj : j ∉ insert i touched) (hc : round ≤ (colour j).val) :
      ∀ y, B.sourceCluster y = j → y ∉ X' := by
    intro y hy hmem
    have hh := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hmem).2
    rw [hy] at hh
    exact hh.elim (fun h => (not_lt_of_ge hc h)) hj
  let out : PartialCompatibleEmbedding B A X' → X ⊕ Y → VG :=
    fun h => Sum.elim (fun x : X => h.toFun x.1) (fun y : Y => h.toFun y.1)
  have hcombined : VertexSpreadOn ((mu.bind kappa).map out) (C / n) Set.univ := by
    let old := fun f : PartialCompatibleEmbedding B A X => fun x : X => f.toFun x.1
    let new := fun h : PartialCompatibleEmbedding B A X' => fun y : Y => h.toFun y.1
    have hagree (f : PartialCompatibleEmbedding B A X) (hf : f ∈ mu.support)
        (h : PartialCompatibleEmbedding B A X') (hh : h ∈ (kappa f).support) :
        out h = Sum.elim (old f) (new h) := by
      funext z
      cases z with
      | inl x => exact hkernelX f hf h hh x.1 x.2
      | inr y => rfl
    classical
    refine ⟨hspread.1, ?_⟩
    intro s x y hx _
    let L := {i : Fin s // ∃ u : X, x i = Sum.inl u}
    let R := {i : Fin s // ¬∃ u : X, x i = Sum.inl u}
    let left : L → X := fun i => Classical.choose i.property
    have hleft (i : L) : x i.val = Sum.inl (left i) :=
      Classical.choose_spec i.property
    have rexists (i : R) : ∃ u : Y, x i.val = Sum.inr u := by
      cases hi : x i.val with
      | inl u => exact False.elim (i.property ⟨u, hi⟩)
      | inr u => exact ⟨u, rfl⟩
    let right : R → Y := fun i => Classical.choose (rexists i)
    have hright (i : R) : x i.val = Sum.inr (right i) := Classical.choose_spec (rexists i)
    have linj : Function.Injective left := by
      intro i j hij
      apply Subtype.ext
      apply hx
      rw [hleft i, hleft j, hij]
    have rinj : Function.Injective right := by
      intro i j hij
      apply Subtype.ext
      apply hx
      rw [hright i, hright j, hij]
    let a := Fintype.card L
    let b := Fintype.card R
    have hab : a + b = s := by
      simpa only [Fintype.card_sum, Fintype.card_fin] using
        Fintype.card_congr (Equiv.sumCompl (fun i : Fin s => ∃ u : X, x i = Sum.inl u))
    let eL := Fintype.equivFin L
    let eR := Fintype.equivFin R
    let EL : Set (X → VG) := {f | ∀ i : L, f (left i) = y i.val}
    let ER : Set (Y → VG) := {g | ∀ i : R, g (right i) = y i.val}
    have hEL : (mu.map old).toOuterMeasure EL ≤ (C / n) ^ a := by
      have heq : CylinderEvent (fun j : Fin a => left (eL.symm j))
          (fun j => y (eL.symm j).val) = EL := by
        ext f
        constructor
        · intro h i
          simpa only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using h (eL i)
        · intro h j
          exact h (eL.symm j)
      rw [← heq]
      exact hspread.2 a _ _ (linj.comp eL.symm.injective) (fun _ => Set.mem_univ _)
    have hER (f : PartialCompatibleEmbedding B A X) (hf : f ∈ mu.support) :
        ((kappa f).map new).toOuterMeasure ER ≤ (C / n) ^ b := by
      have heq : CylinderEvent (fun j : Fin b => right (eR.symm j))
          (fun j => y (eR.symm j).val) = ER := by
        ext g
        constructor
        · intro h i
          simpa only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using h (eR i)
        · intro h j
          exact h (eR.symm j)
      rw [← heq]
      exact (hkernelY f hf).2 b _ _ (rinj.comp eR.symm.injective) (fun _ => Set.mem_univ _)
    have joint (f : PartialCompatibleEmbedding B A X) (hf : f ∈ mu.support) (h : PartialCompatibleEmbedding B A X') (hh : h ∈ (kappa f).support) :
        out h ∈ CylinderEvent x y ↔ old f ∈ EL ∧ new h ∈ ER := by
      rw [hagree f hf h hh]
      change (∀ i, Sum.elim (old f) (new h) (x i) = y i) ↔
        (∀ i : L, old f (left i) = y i.val) ∧ (∀ i : R, new h (right i) = y i.val)
      constructor
      · intro h
        exact ⟨fun i => by simpa only [hleft i, Sum.elim_inl] using h i.val,
          fun i => by simpa only [hright i, Sum.elim_inr] using h i.val⟩
      · rintro ⟨hl, hr⟩ i
        by_cases hi : ∃ u : X, x i = Sum.inl u
        · rw [hleft ⟨i, hi⟩]
          exact hl ⟨i, hi⟩
        · rw [hright ⟨i, hi⟩]
          exact hr ⟨i, hi⟩
    have cond (f : PartialCompatibleEmbedding B A X) (hf : f ∈ mu.support) :
        ((kappa f).map out).toOuterMeasure (CylinderEvent x y) ≤
          if old f ∈ EL then (C / n) ^ b else 0 := by
      rw [PMF.toOuterMeasure_map_apply, PMF.toOuterMeasure_apply]
      have heq : (∑' h, ((out ⁻¹' CylinderEvent x y).indicator (kappa f)) h) =
          if old f ∈ EL then ((kappa f).map new).toOuterMeasure ER else 0 := by
        rw [PMF.toOuterMeasure_map_apply, PMF.toOuterMeasure_apply]
        by_cases ho : old f ∈ EL
        · simp only [ho, if_true]
          apply tsum_congr
          intro h
          by_cases hh : h ∈ (kappa f).support
          · simp only [Set.indicator_apply, Set.mem_preimage]
            rw [joint f hf h hh]
            simp only [ho, true_and]
          · have hz : kappa f h = 0 := by simpa only [PMF.mem_support_iff, not_not] using hh
            simp [Set.indicator_apply, hz]
        · simp only [ho, if_false]
          apply ENNReal.tsum_eq_zero.mpr
          intro h
          by_cases hh : h ∈ (kappa f).support
          · have hn : out h ∉ CylinderEvent x y := fun hp => ho ((joint f hf h hh).mp hp).1
            simp [hn]
          · have hz : kappa f h = 0 := by simpa only [PMF.mem_support_iff, not_not] using hh
            simp [hz]
      rw [heq]
      by_cases ho : old f ∈ EL
      · simpa only [ho, if_true] using hER f hf
      · simp only [ho, if_false, le_refl]
    calc
      ((mu.bind kappa).map out).toOuterMeasure (CylinderEvent x y) =
          ∑' f, mu f * ((kappa f).map out).toOuterMeasure (CylinderEvent x y) := by
        rw [PMF.toOuterMeasure_map_apply, PMF.toOuterMeasure_bind_apply]
        apply tsum_congr
        intro f
        rw [PMF.toOuterMeasure_map_apply]
      _ ≤ ∑' f, (if old f ∈ EL then mu f else 0) * (C / n) ^ b := by
        apply ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum
        intro f
        by_cases hf : f ∈ mu.support
        · have h := mul_le_mul_right (cond f hf) (mu f)
          by_cases ho : old f ∈ EL <;> simpa only [ho, if_true, if_false, mul_zero, zero_mul] using h
        · have hz : mu f = 0 := by simpa only [PMF.mem_support_iff, not_not] using hf
          simp [hz]
      _ = (mu.map old).toOuterMeasure EL * (C / n) ^ b := by
        rw [ENNReal.tsum_mul_right, PMF.toOuterMeasure_map_apply, PMF.toOuterMeasure_apply]
        simp only [Set.indicator_apply, Set.mem_preimage]
      _ ≤ (C / n) ^ a * (C / n) ^ b := mul_le_mul_left hEL _
      _ = (C / n) ^ s := by rw [← pow_add, hab]
  let e : X' → X ⊕ Y := fun x =>
    if hx : x.1 ∈ X then Sum.inl ⟨x.1, hx⟩ else
      Sum.inr ⟨x.1, (Finset.mem_union.mp (hdom ▸ x.2)).resolve_left hx⟩
  have heval (x : X') : Sum.elim (Subtype.val : X → VH) (Subtype.val : Y → VH) (e x) = x.1 := by
    dsimp only [e]
    split <;> rfl
  have heinj : Function.Injective e := by
    intro x y hxy
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [← heval x, ← heval y, hxy]
  have hfullspread : VertexSpreadOn
      ((mu.bind kappa).map fun h => fun x : X' => h.toFun x.1) (C / n) Set.univ := by
    have hr := VertexSpreadRestriction (U := Set.univ) ⟨e, heinj⟩ hcombined
    change VertexSpreadOn (((mu.bind kappa).map out).map (fun f => f ∘ e))
      (C / n) Set.univ at hr
    rw [PMF.map_comp] at hr
    have heq : (fun f : X ⊕ Y → VG => f ∘ e) ∘ out =
        (fun h : PartialCompatibleEmbedding B A X' => fun x : X' => h.toFun x.1) := by
      funext h x
      dsimp only [Function.comp_def, out, e]
      split <;> rfl
    rwa [heq] at hr
  refine ⟨kappa, hkernelX, hkernelY, hround, hdegree, hcolour, ?_, rfl, hfullspread, ?_⟩
  · intro j hj
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hj with rfl | hj
    · exact hi
    · exact hS j hj
  · intro h hh j hj hc
    obtain ⟨f, hf, hh⟩ := (PMF.mem_support_bind_iff _ _ _).mp hh
    have hjS : j ∉ touched := fun h => hj (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem h)
    have hji : j ≠ i := fun h => hj (h.symm ▸ Finset.mem_insert_self i touched)
    obtain ⟨hexp, _, Wold, hWold, hsuperOld⟩ := hwitness f hf j hjS hc
    have hcount := hgeom.2.2.1 j
    by_cases hadj : R.Adj i j
    · have hchange := hgeom.2.2.2 j hadj
      have htouchedNew : ((insert i touched).filter fun k => R.Adj j k).Nonempty :=
        ⟨i, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_insert_self _ _, R.symm hadj⟩⟩
      dsimp only
      rw [hchange.2, if_pos htouchedNew]
      refine ⟨by omega, hcount, ?_⟩
      rw [hk f hf] at hh
      obtain ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩ := (PMF.mem_support_map_iff _ _ _).mp hh
      exact (hnu f hf).2 g hg (ext f g) (extX f g) (extY f g) j hadj hjS hc
    · have hnji : ¬R.Adj j i := fun h => hadj (R.symm h)
      have hE : (Finset.univ.filter fun k : Fin r =>
          ((colour k).val < round ∨ k ∈ insert i touched) ∧ R.Adj j k) =
          (Finset.univ.filter fun k : Fin r =>
          ((colour k).val < round ∨ k ∈ touched) ∧ R.Adj j k) := by
        ext k
        by_cases hki : k = i
        · subst k
          simp [hnji]
        · simp [Finset.mem_insert, hki]
      have hT : ((insert i touched).filter fun k => R.Adj j k) =
          (touched.filter fun k => R.Adj j k) := by
        simp [Finset.filter_insert, hnji]
      have hpersist := UpdatedCandidacyNonneighborExtension B A X Y X' f h i j hdom
        (fun y hy => (Finset.mem_filter.mp hy).2) (hun j hj hc) hnji hji
        (hkernelX f hf h hh)
      dsimp only
      rw [hE, hT]
      refine ⟨hexp, by simpa only [hT] using hcount, Wold, ?_, ?_⟩
      · change Wold ≤ SimpleGraph.fromRel (fun p s =>
          ∃ y : VH, ∃ v : VG, p = Sum.inl y ∧ s = Sum.inr v ∧
            (y, v) ∈ UpdatedCandidacyCluster B A X' h j)
        rw [hpersist.1]
        exact hWold
      · have hL : (Finset.univ.filter fun z : VH ⊕ VG =>
            ∃ y : VH, z = Sum.inl y ∧ B.sourceCluster y = j ∧ y ∉ X') =
            (Finset.univ.filter fun z : VH ⊕ VG =>
            ∃ y : VH, z = Sum.inl y ∧ B.sourceCluster y = j ∧ y ∉ X) := by
          apply Finset.filter_congr
          intro z _
          constructor <;> rintro ⟨y, hz, hy, hm⟩
          · exact ⟨y, hz, hy, (hpersist.2.1 y hy).mp hm⟩
          · exact ⟨y, hz, hy, (hpersist.2.1 y hy).mpr hm⟩
        have hQ : (Finset.univ.filter fun z : VH ⊕ VG =>
            ∃ v : VG, z = Sum.inr v ∧ B.hostCluster v = j ∧ v ∉ X'.image h.toFun) =
            (Finset.univ.filter fun z : VH ⊕ VG =>
            ∃ v : VG, z = Sum.inr v ∧ B.hostCluster v = j ∧ v ∉ X.image f.toFun) := by
          apply Finset.filter_congr
          intro z _
          constructor <;> rintro ⟨v, hz, hv, hm⟩
          · exact ⟨v, hz, hv, (hpersist.2.2 v hv).mp hm⟩
          · exact ⟨v, hz, hv, (hpersist.2.2 v hv).mpr hm⟩
        rw [hL, hQ]
        exact hsuperOld
ColourRoundKernelAssembly.lean_statement:
theorem ColourRoundKernelAssembly
    {r q : ℕ} {VH VG : Type*} [Fintype VH] [Fintype VG]
    [DecidableEq VH] [DecidableEq VG]
    {H : SimpleGraph VH} {G : SimpleGraph VG} {R : SimpleGraph (Fin r)}
    [DecidableRel R.Adj]
    (B : BlowUpInstance r VH VG H G R) (A : CandidacySystem B)
    (colour : Fin r → Fin q) (epsilon density : ℕ → ENNReal)
    (D : ℕ) (C : ENNReal) (n round : ℕ) (touched : Finset (Fin r))
    (X : Finset VH) (mu : PMF (PartialCompatibleEmbedding B A X))
    (hinv : ColourRoundInvariant B A colour epsilon density D C n round touched X mu)
    (i : Fin r) (hi : (colour i).val = round) (hiS : i ∉ touched) :
    let X' := Finset.univ.filter fun x : VH =>
      (colour (B.sourceCluster x)).val < round ∨ B.sourceCluster x ∈ insert i touched
    let Y := Finset.univ.filter fun x : VH => B.sourceCluster x = i
    (∀ f ∈ mu.support,
      ∃ nu : PMF (PartialCompatibleEmbedding B (UpdatedCandidacy B A X f) Y),
        VertexSpreadOn (nu.map fun g => fun y : Y => g.toFun y.1) (C / n) Set.univ ∧
        (∀ g ∈ nu.support, ∀ h : PartialCompatibleEmbedding B A X',
          (∀ x ∈ X, h.toFun x = f.toFun x) →
          (∀ y ∈ Y, h.toFun y = g.toFun y) →
          ∀ j : Fin r, R.Adj i j → j ∉ touched → round ≤ (colour j).val →
            let exposure := (Finset.univ.filter fun k : Fin r =>
              ((colour k).val < round ∨ k ∈ touched) ∧ R.Adj j k).card
            let L : Finset (VH ⊕ VG) := Finset.univ.filter fun z =>
              ∃ y : VH, z = Sum.inl y ∧ B.sourceCluster y = j ∧ y ∉ X'
            let Q : Finset (VH ⊕ VG) := Finset.univ.filter fun z =>
              ∃ v : VG, z = Sum.inr v ∧ B.hostCluster v = j ∧ v ∉ X'.image h.toFun
            let Aj : SimpleGraph (VH ⊕ VG) := SimpleGraph.fromRel fun p s =>
              ∃ y : VH, ∃ v : VG, p = Sum.inl y ∧ s = Sum.inr v ∧
                (y, v) ∈ UpdatedCandidacyCluster B A X' h j
            ∃ W : SimpleGraph (VH ⊕ VG), W ≤ Aj ∧
              @SuperRegularPair (VH ⊕ VG) _ W (Classical.decRel _)
                L Q (epsilon (round + 1)) (density (exposure + 1)))) →
    ∃ kappa : PartialCompatibleEmbedding B A X → PMF (PartialCompatibleEmbedding B A X'),
      (∀ f ∈ mu.support, ∀ h ∈ (kappa f).support, ∀ x ∈ X,
        h.toFun x = f.toFun x) ∧
      (∀ f ∈ mu.support, VertexSpreadOn
        ((kappa f).map fun h => fun y : Y => h.toFun y.1) (C / n) Set.univ) ∧
      ColourRoundInvariant B A colour epsilon density D C n round
        (insert i touched) X' (mu.bind kappa) := by

ColourRoundKernelAssembly.tex_proof:
\begin{proof}
The domain description in \noderef{ColourRoundInvariant} gives
$X'=X\cup Y$ and $X\cap Y=\varnothing$: a vertex in $Y$ has colour
$t$ and its cluster $i$ is not in $S$. For each supported $f$, choose
$\nu_f$ as in the hypothesis. For every local compatible embedding
$g$, apply \noderef{ExtendUpdatedPartialEmbedding} on these disjoint
domains to choose a compatible lift $e_f(g)$ on $X'$. It agrees with
$f$ on $X$ and $g$ on $Y$. Set $K_f=(e_f)_*\nu_f$.
Every supported member of $K_f$ is the image of a supported $g$;
therefore it agrees with $f$ on $X$ and has all the asserted neighbour
witnesses. Its restriction law on $Y$ equals the restriction law of
$\nu_f$, so it is $C/n$-vertex-spread.

The support of a probability mass function is nonempty. Choose a
supported $f_0$, and set $\kappa(f)=K_f$ on the support of $\mu$ and
$\kappa(f)=K_{f_0}$ elsewhere. This is a total kernel with the asserted
support and conditional-spread properties. No new conditioning is
performed. Inputs outside the old support have mass zero and contribute
nothing to the defining bind law.

We check every invariant clause for that law. Its round, degree and
square-colouring clauses are inherited. Every vertex of $S\cup\{i\}$
has colour $t$ by the old clause and the hypothesis on $i$; the domain
clause is the definition of $X'$. Any supported output $h$ of the bind
has some $f\in\operatorname{supp}(\mu)$ with
$h\in\operatorname{supp}(\kappa(f))$.
Fix a still unembedded $j$. By
\noderef{ColourRoundUntouchedGeometry}, its touched-neighbour set in
$S\cup\{i\}$ has size at most one. If $ij\in E(R)$, that set contains
$i$, its exposure is exactly $e_j+1\le D$, and its witness error is
$\varepsilon_{t+1}$. The local witness hypothesis, applied to the
chosen supported $g$ and its lift $h$, supplies precisely this witness
on the actual parts. If $ij\notin E(R)$, both its exposure and its
touched-neighbour set are unchanged. Apply
\noderef{UpdatedCandidacyNonneighborExtension}: cluster $j$ is
disjoint from $X'$, $j\ne i$, the new domain is $X\cup Y$, and the
lift agrees on $X$. It gives equality of the old and new true candidacy
sets and equivalence of the unused source and host part conditions.
Thus the old contained witness is still a witness, with exactly its old
error. This treats both previously touched clusters, whose error is
$\varepsilon_{t+1}$, and completely untouched clusters, whose error
is $\varepsilon_t$; neither is asserted to have a smaller error.

We verify joint spread directly for this same bind law. Write
$\alpha=C/n$, $o(f)=f|_X$, $v(h)=h|_Y$, and
$w(h)=h|_X\sqcup h|_Y$, a function on $X\sqcup Y$. For every
$f\in\operatorname{supp}(\mu)$ and
$h\in\operatorname{supp}(\kappa(f))$, the agreement on $X$ gives
$w(h)=o(f)\sqcup v(h)$. No claim is made that the whole record $f$
is determined by $o(f)$.

Fix a cylinder $\operatorname{Cyl}(x,y)$ of
\noderef{CylinderEvent}, where $x:[s]\to X\sqcup Y$ is injective
and $y:[s]\to V(G)$ is arbitrary. Partition its index set as
$L=\{\ell:x(\ell)\in X\}$ and
$T=\{\ell:x(\ell)\in Y\}$, with membership understood in the
respective summands. Put $a=|L|$ and $b=|T|$; then $a+b=s$.
For $\ell\in L$ write $x(\ell)=\operatorname{inl}(x_L(\ell))$,
and for $\ell\in T$ write
$x(\ell)=\operatorname{inr}(x_T(\ell))$.
Both $x_L$ and $x_T$ are injective, since $x$ is injective.
Let
\[
 E_X=\{u:X\to V(G):u(x_L(\ell))=y(\ell)\text{ for all }\ell\in L\},
 \qquad
 E_Y=\{v:Y\to V(G):v(x_T(\ell))=y(\ell)\text{ for all }\ell\in T\}.
\]
Reindexing $L$ and $T$ by $[a]$ and $[b]$ makes these permitted
cylinders. The old spread clause of
\noderef{ColourRoundInvariant}, interpreted by
\noderef{VertexSpreadOn}, gives
$(o_*\mu)(E_X)\le\alpha^a$. The conditional spread already proved
above gives $(v_*\kappa(f))(E_Y)\le\alpha^b$ for every supported
$f$. These statements also cover $a=0$ or $b=0$.

For a supported input-output pair, the identity for $w(h)$ implies
\[
 w(h)\in\operatorname{Cyl}(x,y)
 \quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad o(f)\in E_X\text{ and }v(h)\in E_Y.
\]
In the sum defining the conditional event probability, every
$h\notin\operatorname{supp}(\kappa(f))$ has weight zero. Therefore,
for every supported $f$, this equivalence gives the exact identity
\[
 (w_*\kappa(f))(\operatorname{Cyl}(x,y))
 =\boldsymbol1_{E_X}(o(f))\,(v_*\kappa(f))(E_Y)
 \le\boldsymbol1_{E_X}(o(f))\,\alpha^b.
\]
Expand bind and pushforward using their probability mass sums.
Inputs $f$ outside $\operatorname{supp}(\mu)$ again contribute zero,
regardless of the filler kernel. Summing the displayed inequality over
the full input records, not over their restrictions, yields
\begin{align*}
 (w_*(\mu\mathbin{\mathrm{bind}}\kappa))(\operatorname{Cyl}(x,y))
 &=\sum_f\mu(f)\,(w_*\kappa(f))(\operatorname{Cyl}(x,y))\\
 &\le\sum_f\mu(f)\,\boldsymbol1_{E_X}(o(f))\,\alpha^b\\
 &=(o_*\mu)(E_X)\,\alpha^b
 \le\alpha^a\alpha^b=\alpha^s.
\end{align*}
All sums and products are nonnegative extended-real ones, so this
calculation uses no division or positive-event assumption. Together
with $\alpha\le1$ from the old spread clause, it proves the full
joint spread property on $X\sqcup Y$ in
\noderef{VertexSpreadOn}.

Finally send each vertex of $X'=X\cup Y$ to its summand in
$X\sqcup Y$. This map is injective: forgetting the summand recovers
the original vertex. Apply \noderef{VertexSpreadRestriction} to this
injection with target set $U=V(G)$. Composing $w(h)$ with the injection
gives exactly $h|_{X'}$, so functoriality of pushforward identifies the
resulting law with the restriction of
$\mu\mathbin{\mathrm{bind}}\kappa$ to $X'$.
All the clauses of the required invariant now hold.
\end{proof}
ColourRoundKernelAssembly.tex_statement:
\begin{lemma}[Assembly of locally certified extension laws]
Suppose $\mathcal I(t,S;X,\mu)$ of \noderef{ColourRoundInvariant}
holds and $i\in c^{-1}(t)\setminus S$. Put $Y=X_i$ and let $X'$ be
the source domain for the earlier colours and $S\cup\{i\}$.
For every $f\in\operatorname{supp}(\mu)$ suppose there is a law
$\nu_f$ on compatible partial embeddings of $Y$ for $A_f$, whose
restriction to $Y$ is $C/n$-vertex-spread. Suppose that for every
supported $g$ and every compatible lift $h$ on $X'$ agreeing with $f$
on $X$ and $g$ on $Y$, each unembedded neighbour $j$ of $i$ has a
contained spanning $(\varepsilon_{t+1},p_{e_j+1})$-super-regular
witness in its true updated candidacy graph at $h$, on the exact
unembedded source and unused host parts. Here
$e_j=|N_R(j)\cap(\{k:c(k)<t\}\cup S)|$.
Then there is a total kernel $\kappa$ from compatible embeddings on
$X$ to laws on those on $X'$, agreeing with each supported input on
$X$ and $C/n$-vertex-spread on $Y$, such that precisely
$\mu\mathbin{\mathrm{bind}}\kappa$ satisfies
$\mathcal I(t,S\cup\{i\};X',\mu\mathbin{\mathrm{bind}}\kappa)$.
\end{lemma}

classical
  let Y := Finset.univ.filter fun x : VH => B.sourceCluster x = i
  let K0 := Finset.univ.filter fun v : VG => B.hostCluster v = i
  let U := Y.image (Sum.inl : VH → VH ⊕ VG)
  let K := K0.image (Sum.inr : VG → VH ⊕ VG)
  let J := {j : Fin r // R.Adj i j ∧ j ∉ touched ∧ round ≤ (colour j).val}
  let Z : J → Finset (VH ⊕ VG) := fun j =>
    (Finset.univ.filter fun v : VG => B.hostCluster v = j).image Sum.inr
  let exposure := fun j : Fin r => (Finset.univ.filter fun k : Fin r =>
    ((colour k).val < round ∨ k ∈ touched) ∧ R.Adj j k).card
  let m := Y.card
  have heta : eta round < 1 := by
    have h : eta round ≤ 2 * eta round := by
      simpa only [one_mul] using mul_le_mul_right' (by norm_num : (1 : ENNReal) ≤ 2) (eta round)
    exact h.trans_lt (P.host_density_upper.trans_le tsub_le_self)
  have hn : 1 ≤ n := by
    by_contra h
    have hz : n = 0 := by omega
    have hfin := P.integer_reserve.trans_lt (P.inner_reserve.trans heta)
    simp [hz] at hfin
  have hnm : n ≤ m := by
    rcases (hsizes i).1 with h | h <;> change n ≤ Y.card <;> change Y.card = _ at h <;> omega
  have hm : 0 < m := lt_of_lt_of_le (by omega) hnm
  have hm0 : (m : ENNReal) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hm.ne'
  have hmt : (m : ENNReal) ≠ ⊤ := ENNReal.natCast_ne_top m
  have hU : U.card = m := by simp [U, m, Finset.card_image_of_injective, Sum.inl_injective]
  have hK : K.card = m := by
    simp only [K, Finset.card_image_of_injective _ Sum.inr_injective]
    exact (hsizes i).2.symm
  have hUK : Disjoint U K := by
    apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro z hz hk
    obtain ⟨y, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hz
    obtain ⟨v, _, h⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hk
    cases h
  obtain ⟨F, F13, F23, hFA, hF, htrip, htransport⟩ :=
    ColourRoundRetainedTriplets B A colour theta density epsilon rho eta omega xi
      D d C a n round P hn hsizes hhost hsource touched X mu hinv i hi hiS f hf
  letI : DecidableRel F.Adj := Classical.decRel _
  letI : ∀ j, DecidableRel (F13 j).Adj := fun _ => Classical.decRel _
  letI : ∀ j, DecidableRel (F23 j).Adj := fun _ => Classical.decRel _
  have geom := ColourRoundUntouchedGeometry R colour D round touched i
    hinv.2.1 hinv.2.2.1 hinv.2.2.2.1 hi hiS
  have hx : exposure i ≤ D := by
    apply (Finset.card_le_card ?_).trans (hinv.2.1 i)
    intro k hk
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hk).2.2⟩
  have hy (j : J) : exposure j < D := (geom.2.2.2 j j.property.1).1
  have hJ : Fintype.card J ≤ D := by
    change Fintype.card {j : Fin r // R.Adj i j ∧ j ∉ touched ∧ round ≤ (colour j).val} ≤ D
    rw [Fintype.card_subtype]
    apply (Finset.card_le_card ?_).trans (hinv.2.1 i)
    intro j hj
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2.1⟩
  have hrho : rho (exposure i) ≤ 1 := by
    have h := (P.witness_density (exposure i) hx).2
    have hpos : 0 < 1 - rho (exposure i) := lt_of_le_of_lt bot_le h
    exact (lt_of_not_ge fun hh => by simpa [tsub_eq_zero_of_le hh] using hpos).le
  let eEx := (Fintype.equivFin (VH ⊕ VG)).trans (Equiv.ulift.symm)
  obtain ⟨eUEx, eKEx, hUKEx, eMEx, heUEx, heKEx, heMEx, hregEx, _, _⟩ :=
    FiniteTripletRelabelling eEx F U K hUK
  have hMEx := P.certificate.matchingExistenceGuarantee round P.round_bound (exposure i) hx
      (F.comap eEx.symm) (U.image eEx) (K.image eEx) hUKEx m
      ((P.scalar_thresholds _ hx).2.2.2.1.trans hnm)
      (by simpa only [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ eEx.injective] using hU)
      (by simpa only [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ eEx.injective] using hK)
      ((hregEx _ _).mp hF)
  have hM : Nonempty {sigma : U → K // PerfectMatching F U K hUK sigma} :=
    hMEx.map eMEx.symm
  let M := {sigma : U → K // PerfectMatching F U K hUK sigma}
  let mu0 : PMF M := UniformPerfectMatching F U K hUK hM
  let muf : PMF (U → K) := mu0.map Subtype.val
  obtain ⟨e, v, lift, he, hv, hlift, hcontain⟩ :=
    ColourRoundMatchingRecords B A colour round touched X f i hi hiS
      hinv.2.2.2.2.1 (Finset.card_pos.mp hm) F hUK hFA hM
  let Cm : ENNReal := C * m / n
  have halve (T : ENNReal) (s : ℕ) : T / (2 * s) = (T / s) / 2 := by
    rw [div_eq_mul_inv, div_eq_mul_inv, div_eq_mul_inv,
      ENNReal.mul_inv (Or.inl two_ne_zero) (Or.inl ENNReal.ofNat_ne_top)]
    ac_rfl
  have hCm : Cm / m = C / n := by
    dsimp only [Cm]
    simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
    calc
      C * m * (n : ENNReal)⁻¹ * (m : ENNReal)⁻¹ =
          C * (n : ENNReal)⁻¹ * ((m : ENNReal) * (m : ENNReal)⁻¹) := by ac_rfl
      _ = C * (n : ENNReal)⁻¹ := by rw [ENNReal.mul_inv_cancel hm0 hmt, mul_one]
  have hCm2 : Cm / (2 * m) = C / (2 * n) := by rw [halve, hCm, ← halve]
  have hhalfunit : C / (2 * n) ≤ 1 := by
    rw [halve]
    have h : (C / n) / 2 ≤ C / n := by
      simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_one] using
        mul_le_mul_left' (by norm_num : (2 : ENNReal)⁻¹ ≤ 1) (C / n)
    exact h.trans P.spread_unit
  let eSp := (Fintype.equivFin (VH ⊕ VG)).trans (Equiv.ulift.symm)
  obtain ⟨eUSp, eKSp, hUKSp, eMSp, heUSp, heKSp, heMSp, hregSp, _, _⟩ :=
    FiniteTripletRelabelling eSp F U K hUK
  let hMSp := hM.map eMSp
  let muSp := UniformPerfectMatching (F.comap eSp.symm) (U.image eSp) (K.image eSp) hUKSp hMSp
  have hrawSp := P.certificate.matchingGuarantee round P.round_bound (exposure i) hx
    (F.comap eSp.symm) (U.image eSp) (K.image eSp) hUKSp m
    ((P.scalar_thresholds _ hx).2.2.1.trans hnm)
    (by simpa only [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ eSp.injective] using hU)
    (by simpa only [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ eSp.injective] using hK)
    ((hregSp _ _).mp hF) hMSp
  have uniformSp : mu0.map eMSp = muSp := by
    letI := hM
    letI := hMSp
    ext s
    rw [PMF.map_apply, ← eMSp.symm.tsum_eq]
    simp only [eMSp.apply_symm_apply, mu0, muSp, UniformPerfectMatching,
      PMF.uniformOfFintype_apply, Fintype.card_eq_nat_card, Nat.card_congr eMSp]
    simp
  have hrawAmb : VertexSpreadOn (mu0.map fun sigma u => (sigma.val u : VH ⊕ VG))
      (P.certificate.matchingConstant round (exposure i) / m) Set.univ := by
    refine ⟨hrawSp.1, ?_⟩
    intro s x y hxi _
    have hh := hrawSp.2 s (fun k => eUSp (x k)) (fun k => eSp (y k))
      (eUSp.injective.comp hxi) (fun _ => Set.mem_univ _)
    change VertexSpreadOn _ _ _ at hrawSp
    change (muSp.map _).toOuterMeasure _ ≤ _ at hh
    rw [← uniformSp, PMF.map_comp, PMF.toOuterMeasure_map_apply] at hh
    rw [PMF.toOuterMeasure_map_apply]
    have eqset : (fun sigma : M => fun u => ((eMSp sigma).val u).val) ⁻¹'
        CylinderEvent (fun k => eUSp (x k)) (fun k => eSp (y k)) =
        (fun sigma : M => fun u => (sigma.val u : VH ⊕ VG)) ⁻¹' CylinderEvent x y := by
      ext sigma
      simp only [Set.mem_preimage, CylinderEvent, Set.mem_setOf_eq, heMSp, heKSp]
      exact ⟨fun hh k => eSp.injective (hh k), fun hh k => congrArg eSp (hh k)⟩
    exact eqset ▸ hh
  have hrawSub : VertexSpreadOn muf (P.certificate.matchingConstant round (exposure i) / m)
      Set.univ := by
    refine ⟨hrawAmb.1, ?_⟩
    intro s x y hxi _
    have h := hrawAmb.2 s x (fun k => (y k : VH ⊕ VG)) hxi (fun _ => Set.mem_univ _)
    rw [PMF.toOuterMeasure_map_apply] at h ⊢
    have hsets : (fun sigma : M => fun u => (sigma.val u : VH ⊕ VG)) ⁻¹'
        CylinderEvent x (fun k => (y k : VH ⊕ VG)) =
        Subtype.val ⁻¹' CylinderEvent x y := by
      ext sigma
      simp only [Set.mem_preimage, CylinderEvent, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
      exact ⟨fun hh k => Subtype.ext (hh k), fun hh k => congrArg Subtype.val (hh k)⟩
    exact hsets ▸ h
  have hraw : VertexSpreadOn muf (Cm / (2 * m)) Set.univ := by
    apply VertexSpreadMonotone hrawSub
    · rw [hCm2]
      calc
        P.certificate.matchingConstant round (exposure i) / m ≤ (C / 2) / m :=
          ENNReal.div_le_div_right (P.scalar_thresholds _ hx).2.2.2.2 _
        _ = C / (2 * m) := by rw [halve]; simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]; ac_rfl
        _ ≤ C / (2 * n) := by gcongr
    · simpa only [hCm2] using hhalfunit
  have hbudget : D * (1 - a) ^ m ≤ (2 : ENNReal)⁻¹ := by
    apply le_trans (mul_le_mul_left' (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (zero_le _) tsub_le_self hnm) _) P.local_loss
  have hgood (j : J) :
      1 - (1 - a) ^ m ≤ mu0.toOuterMeasure {sigma |
        letI : DecidableRel
            (MatchingInducedGraph (F13 j) (F23 j) U K (Z j) sigma).Adj := Classical.decRel _
        let L := Finset.univ.image (Sum.inl : U → U ⊕ Z j)
        let Q := Finset.univ.image (Sum.inr : Z j → U ⊕ Z j)
        SuperRegularPair (MatchingInducedGraph (F13 j) (F23 j) U K (Z j) sigma)
          L Q (omega (round + 1)) (rho (exposure j) * (d / 2))} := by
    let e4 := (Fintype.equivFin (VH ⊕ VG)).trans (Equiv.ulift.symm)
    obtain ⟨eU4, eK4, hUK4, eM4, heU4, heK4, heM4, hreg4, htrip4, hind4⟩ :=
      FiniteTripletRelabelling e4 F U K hUK
    let hM4 := hM.map eM4
    let mu4 := UniformPerfectMatching (F.comap e4.symm) (U.image e4) (K.image e4) hUK4 hM4
    have hg := P.certificate.fourGraphsGuarantee round P.round_bound
      (exposure i) (exposure j) hx (hy j).le
      (F.comap e4.symm) ((F13 j).comap e4.symm) ((F23 j).comap e4.symm)
      (U.image e4) (K.image e4) ((Z j).image e4) m
      ((P.ordered_thresholds _ _ hx (hy j).le).1.trans hnm)
      ((htrip4 _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _).mp (htrip j)) hUK4 hM4
    have uniform4 : mu0.map eM4 = mu4 := by
      letI := hM
      letI := hM4
      ext s
      rw [PMF.map_apply, ← eM4.symm.tsum_eq]
      simp only [eM4.apply_symm_apply, mu0, mu4, UniformPerfectMatching,
        PMF.uniformOfFintype_apply, Fintype.card_eq_nat_card, Nat.card_congr eM4]
      simp
    change _ ≤ mu4.toOuterMeasure _ at hg
    rw [← uniform4, PMF.toOuterMeasure_map_apply] at hg
    have hevent : eM4 ⁻¹' {sigma |
        letI : DecidableRel (MatchingInducedGraph ((F13 j).comap e4.symm)
          ((F23 j).comap e4.symm) (U.image e4) (K.image e4) ((Z j).image e4) sigma).Adj :=
          Classical.decRel _
        SuperRegularPair (MatchingInducedGraph ((F13 j).comap e4.symm)
          ((F23 j).comap e4.symm) (U.image e4) (K.image e4) ((Z j).image e4) sigma)
          (Finset.univ.image Sum.inl) (Finset.univ.image Sum.inr)
          (omega (round + 1)) (rho (exposure j) * (d / 2))} =
        {sigma : M |
          letI : DecidableRel (MatchingInducedGraph (F13 j) (F23 j) U K (Z j) sigma).Adj :=
            Classical.decRel _
          SuperRegularPair (MatchingInducedGraph (F13 j) (F23 j) U K (Z j) sigma)
            (Finset.univ.image Sum.inl) (Finset.univ.image Sum.inr)
            (omega (round + 1)) (rho (exposure j) * (d / 2))} := by
      ext sigma
      exact (hind4 (F13 j) (F23 j) (Z j) sigma _ _).symm
    rw [hevent] at hg
    apply le_trans ?_ hg
    apply tsub_le_tsub_left
    exact pow_le_pow_left' (tsub_le_tsub_left (P.ordered_thresholds _ _ hx (hy j).le).2 1) m
  obtain ⟨Ef, hEf, hmass, hEfSupport, hconditioned⟩ :=
    OneClusterExtension F F13 F23 U K Z m D (theta round) (rho (exposure i))
      (fun _ => theta round) (fun _ => omega (round + 1))
      (fun j => rho (exposure j)) (fun _ => d / 2) a Cm
      hJ hbudget (P.retained_density _ hx).1 (P.retained_density _ hx).2 hrho
      (by simpa only [hCm] using P.spread_unit) hU hK hF htrip hUK hM hraw hgood
  let E0 : Set M := Subtype.val ⁻¹' Ef
  have hE0 : ∃ sigma ∈ E0, sigma ∈ mu0.support := by
    obtain ⟨sigma, hs, hsup⟩ := hEfSupport
    obtain ⟨s, hsup, heq⟩ := (PMF.mem_support_map_iff Subtype.val mu0 sigma).mp hsup
    refine ⟨s, ?_, hsup⟩
    change s.val ∈ Ef
    rw [heq]
    exact hs
  let nu0 := mu0.map lift
  let E := lift '' E0
  have hE : ∃ g ∈ E, g ∈ nu0.support := by
    obtain ⟨s, hs, hsup⟩ := hE0
    exact ⟨lift s, ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩, (PMF.mem_support_map_iff _ _ _).mpr ⟨s, hsup, rfl⟩⟩
  have preE : lift ⁻¹' E = E0 := by
    ext s
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨s', hs', hh⟩
      exact lift.injective hh ▸ hs'
    · intro hs
      exact ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
  -- Conditioning commutes with either pushforward along the same success preimage.
  have filter_map {α β : Type _} (p : PMF α) (b : α → β) (S : Set β)
      (hS : ∃ z ∈ S, z ∈ (p.map b).support)
      (hpre : ∃ z ∈ b ⁻¹' S, z ∈ p.support) :
      (p.filter (b ⁻¹' S) hpre).map b = (p.map b).filter S hS := by
    have hmass : (∑' z, ((b ⁻¹' S).indicator p) z) =
        ∑' z, (S.indicator (p.map b)) z := by
      simpa only [PMF.toOuterMeasure_apply] using (PMF.toOuterMeasure_map_apply b p S).symm
    ext z
    rw [PMF.map_apply, PMF.filter_apply, ← hmass]
    simp only [PMF.filter_apply]
    by_cases hz : z ∈ S
    · simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem hz, PMF.map_apply, ← ENNReal.tsum_mul_right]
      apply tsum_congr
      intro x
      by_cases heq : z = b x
      · subst z
        simp [hz]
      · simp [heq]
    · simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem hz, zero_mul]
      apply ENNReal.tsum_eq_zero.mpr
      intro x
      by_cases heq : z = b x
      · subst z
        simp [hz]
      · simp [heq]
  have commute0 : (mu0.filter E0 hE0).map Subtype.val = muf.filter Ef hEfSupport :=
    filter_map mu0 Subtype.val Ef hEfSupport hE0
  have commute : (mu0.filter E0 hE0).map lift = nu0.filter E hE := by
    have hp : ∃ s ∈ lift ⁻¹' E, s ∈ mu0.support := by simpa only [preE] using hE0
    simpa only [preE] using filter_map mu0 lift E hE hp
  -- Pull back cylinders through the source equivalence and the host injection.
  have transfer (p : PMF (U → K)) (Q : ENNReal) (hs : VertexSpreadOn p Q Set.univ) :
      VertexSpreadOn (p.map fun sigma => fun y : Y => v (sigma (e y))) Q Set.univ := by
    refine ⟨hs.1, ?_⟩
    intro s x y hxi _
    rw [PMF.toOuterMeasure_map_apply]
    by_cases hall : ∀ k, ∃ z : K, v z = y k
    · choose z hz using hall
      have eqset : (fun sigma : U → K => fun y : Y => v (sigma (e y))) ⁻¹'
          CylinderEvent x y = CylinderEvent (fun k => e (x k)) z := by
        ext sigma
        exact ⟨fun h k => v.injective ((h k).trans (hz k).symm),
          fun h k => (congrArg v (h k)).trans (hz k)⟩
      rw [eqset]
      exact hs.2 s _ z (e.injective.comp hxi) (fun _ => Set.mem_univ _)
    · have hempty : (fun sigma : U → K => fun y : Y => v (sigma (e y))) ⁻¹'
          CylinderEvent x y = ∅ := by
        apply Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
        intro sigma hh
        exact hall (fun k => ⟨sigma (e (x k)), hh k⟩)
      simp [hempty, PMF.toOuterMeasure_apply]
  have rawEval : nu0.map (fun g => fun y : Y => g.toFun y.1) =
      muf.map (fun sigma => fun y : Y => v (sigma (e y))) := by
    simp only [nu0, muf, PMF.map_comp]
    congr 1
    funext sigma y
    exact hlift sigma y
  have condEval : (nu0.filter E hE).map (fun g => fun y : Y => g.toFun y.1) =
      (muf.filter Ef hEfSupport).map (fun sigma => fun y : Y => v (sigma (e y))) := by
    rw [← commute, ← commute0]
    simp only [PMF.map_comp]
    congr 1
    funext sigma y
    exact hlift sigma y
  refine ⟨nu0, E, hE, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [PMF.toOuterMeasure_map_apply, preE]
    rw [PMF.toOuterMeasure_map_apply] at hmass
    exact hmass
  · rw [rawEval]
    apply transfer
    simpa only [hCm2] using hraw
  · rw [condEval]
    apply transfer
    simpa only [hCm] using hconditioned
  · intro g hg h hxf hyg j hij hjS hjt
    obtain ⟨hgE, hgsup⟩ := (PMF.mem_support_filter_iff hE).mp hg
    obtain ⟨sigma, hs, rfl⟩ := (PMF.mem_support_map_iff _ _ _).mp hgsup
    have hsig : sigma.val ∈ Ef := by
      obtain ⟨s, hs, hh⟩ := hgE
      exact lift.injective hh ▸ hs
    let jj : J := ⟨j, hij, hjS, hjt⟩
    have hsuccess := (hEf sigma.val).mp hsig jj
    obtain ⟨W, hWT, hW⟩ := htransport sigma.val sigma.property.1 jj hsuccess
    obtain ⟨hTA, hL, hQ⟩ := hcontain sigma h hxf hyg j hij hjS hjt
    refine ⟨W, hWT.trans hTA, ?_⟩
    rw [hL, hQ]
    change @SuperRegularPair _ _ W (Classical.decRel _) _ _
      (epsilon (round + 1)) (density (exposure j + 1))
    rw [P.density_update (exposure j) (hy jj)]
    exact hW
ColourRoundMatchingPreparation.lean_statement:
theorem ColourRoundMatchingPreparation
    {r q : ℕ} {VH VG : Type*} [Fintype VH] [Fintype VG]
    [DecidableEq VH] [DecidableEq VG]
    {H : SimpleGraph VH} {G : SimpleGraph VG} {R : SimpleGraph (Fin r)}
    [DecidableRel G.Adj] [DecidableRel R.Adj]
    (B : BlowUpInstance r VH VG H G R) (A : CandidacySystem B)
    (colour : Fin r → Fin q)
    (theta density epsilon rho eta omega xi : ℕ → ENNReal)
    (D : ℕ) (d C a : ENNReal) (n round : ℕ)
    (P : ColourRoundStepParameters D q d C a n round
      theta density epsilon rho eta omega xi)
    (hsizes : ∀ j : Fin r,
      ((Finset.univ.filter fun x : VH => B.sourceCluster x = j).card = n ∨
       (Finset.univ.filter fun x : VH => B.sourceCluster x = j).card = n + 1) ∧
      (Finset.univ.filter fun x : VH => B.sourceCluster x = j).card =
        (Finset.univ.filter fun v : VG => B.hostCluster v = j).card)
    (hhost : InstanceSuperRegular B (epsilon 0) d)
    (hsource : ∀ ⦃i j : Fin r⦄, R.Adj i j → SaturatingSourcePair B i j)
    (touched : Finset (Fin r)) (X : Finset VH)
    (mu : PMF (PartialCompatibleEmbedding B A X))
    (hinv : ColourRoundInvariant B A colour epsilon density D C n round touched X mu)
    (i : Fin r) (hi : (colour i).val = round) (hiS : i ∉ touched)
    (f : PartialCompatibleEmbedding B A X) (hf : f ∈ mu.support) :
    let X' := Finset.univ.filter fun x : VH =>
      (colour (B.sourceCluster x)).val < round ∨ B.sourceCluster x ∈ insert i touched
    let Y := Finset.univ.filter fun x : VH => B.sourceCluster x = i
    ∃ (nu0 : PMF (PartialCompatibleEmbedding B (UpdatedCandidacy B A X f) Y))
      (E : Set (PartialCompatibleEmbedding B (UpdatedCandidacy B A X f) Y))
      (hE : ∃ g ∈ E, g ∈ nu0.support),
      (2 : ENNReal)⁻¹ ≤ nu0.toOuterMeasure E ∧
      VertexSpreadOn (nu0.map fun g => fun y : Y => g.toFun y.1)
        (C / (2 * n)) Set.univ ∧
      VertexSpreadOn ((nu0.filter E hE).map fun g => fun y : Y => g.toFun y.1)
        (C / n) Set.univ ∧
      (∀ g ∈ (nu0.filter E hE).support,
        ∀ h : PartialCompatibleEmbedding B A X',
        (∀ x ∈ X, h.toFun x = f.toFun x) →
        (∀ y ∈ Y, h.toFun y = g.toFun y) →
        ∀ j : Fin r, R.Adj i j → j ∉ touched → round ≤ (colour j).val →
          let exposure := (Finset.univ.filter fun k : Fin r =>
            ((colour k).val < round ∨ k ∈ touched) ∧ R.Adj j k).card
          let L : Finset (VH ⊕ VG) := Finset.univ.filter fun z =>
            ∃ y : VH, z = Sum.inl y ∧ B.sourceCluster y = j ∧ y ∉ X'
          let Q : Finset (VH ⊕ VG) := Finset.univ.filter fun z =>
            ∃ v : VG, z = Sum.inr v ∧ B.hostCluster v = j ∧ v ∉ X'.image h.toFun
          let Aj : SimpleGraph (VH ⊕ VG) := SimpleGraph.fromRel fun p s =>
            ∃ y : VH, ∃ v : VG, p = Sum.inl y ∧ s = Sum.inr v ∧
              (y, v) ∈ UpdatedCandidacyCluster B A X' h j
          ∃ W : SimpleGraph (VH ⊕ VG), W ≤ Aj ∧
            @SuperRegularPair (VH ⊕ VG) _ W (Classical.decRel _)
              L Q (epsilon (round + 1)) (density (exposure + 1))) := by

ColourRoundMatchingPreparation.tex_proof:
\begin{proof}
We use \noderef{ColourRoundRetainedTriplets} for the deterministic
retained graph and its family of triplets, and
\noderef{ColourRoundMatchingRecords} for matching records and containment
in the true updated graphs. The following paragraphs record the
parameter verifications and then compose their conclusions with the
local matching law.
Write $\mathcal C$ for the certificate in the parameter record. By
\noderef{ColourRoundUntouchedGeometry}, $i$ and every neighbour tested
in this lemma have no neighbour in $S$. The witness clause of
\noderef{ColourRoundInvariant} therefore gives their common input
error $\varepsilon_t$. Their exposure counts $x=e_i$ and $y=e_j$
are bounded by $D$, and $y<D$. We make no comparison between $x$ and
$y$. At every use of a certificate guarantee below, give it $t<q$
and separately the bound on each exposure argument.

An unembedded cluster has no source vertices in $X$. Its host cluster
contains no vertex of $f(X)$: the cluster-respecting clause of
\noderef{CandidacySystem} and compatibility in
\noderef{PartialCompatibleEmbedding} put every image in its processed
source cluster. Thus the witness parts are the full clusters, of their
actual sizes $n$ or $n+1$. The inequalities
$2\zeta_t<1-\rho_x$ and $2\zeta_t<1-d/2$ imply respectively
$\rho_x<1$ and $d/2<1$; these conclusions do not follow merely from
super-regularity. Together with the lower density inequalities they
give $0<\rho_x,d/2<1$ and $\zeta_t<1$.
Consequently $\xi_t$ is finite, and $1/n\le\xi_t$ implies $n\ge1$.
Also $\varepsilon_t\le\varepsilon_{t+1}\le1$.

For the current witness and each future witness apply
$\mathcal C.\mathrm{witnessThinningGuarantee}$ at $(t,x)$ and $(t,y)$.
Disjointness comes from the source/host copies. Both part sizes are at
least $n$, and differ by at most one, so the scalar threshold bounds
license both sides of every thinning. This produces contained
$(\xi_t,\rho_x)$ and $(\xi_t,\rho_y)$ pairs.
For each relevant host pair apply
$\mathcal C.\mathrm{hostThinningGuarantee}$ at $t$, to the original
$(\varepsilon_0,d)$ host pair from \noderef{InstanceSuperRegular}.
Its threshold is also at most both actual sizes. The result is a
contained $(\xi_t,d/2)$ pair.
All these are the actual thinning guarantees from
\noderef{InductionApplicationCertificate}.

Let $m=|X_i|=|V_i|$ and $k_j=|X_j|=|V_j|$.
View all the pairs on the finite ambient sum of source and host vertices.
The canonical injections preserve each part cardinality, each degree
and each rectangle edge count, so this change of ambient type preserves
all the displayed pair parameters.
The source-pair definition gives an injection in one of the two
orientations whose edges are exactly the source edges. If the sizes are
equal, the injection is bijective and either orientation yields a
bijection from the current to the future source part. If the current
part is larger, an injection from it to the smaller part is impossible,
so the other orientation is provided; its image misses exactly one
current vertex. If the future part is larger, the injection is from
the current part and misses exactly one future vertex. These statements
follow by counting the image of the injection and the one-element
complement, and use only \noderef{SaturatingSourcePair}.

For each $j$ apply the corresponding preparation-and-transport result:
\noderef{EqualSizeSourceWitnessTransport} if $m=k_j$,
\noderef{CurrentExtraSourceWitnessTransport} if $m=k_j+1$, and
\noderef{FutureExtraSourceWitnessTransport} if $k_j=m+1$.
Take $O$ to be the stored old witness, $W$ its thinning, $J$ the
thinned host pair, and $H$ the original host pair. In the unequal
cases the size parameter is $n$, because the smaller size is $n$.
The inner reserves are exactly those in the parameter record; its
integer reserve supplies the artificial-row rounding bound. The outer
reserves are applied at $y\le D$, with
$\omega=\omega_{t+1}$ and $e=\varepsilon_{t+1}$.
The density $\rho_y d/2$ is at most one because each factor is at
most one. In the future-extra case the old error is at most one and
the density gap is
$\rho_y d/2+\varepsilon_t+1/n\le p_y$, using the density-update
identity at $y<D$. Thus every hypothesis of all three cases is verified.
They give graphs $F_{13}^j$ on the full current source part and the full
future host part, of parameters $(\zeta_t,\rho_y)$, and a deterministic
contained-witness transport for every successful matching. In particular
the future-extra row is deleted before testing, and the current-extra
artificial row is inserted before testing. No total current-to-future
source map is used in the latter case.

Weaken the current and host thinning errors to $\zeta_t$; error
enlargement only increases degree windows and reduces the rectangles
tested in \noderef{SuperRegularPair}.
Index the tests by the unembedded neighbours of $i$, a finite set of
cardinality at most $D$. Form the graph of retained current edges with
the common-neighbour window
\[
(\rho_y d/2-2\zeta_t)k_j\ \le
 |N_{F_{13}^j}(u)\cap N_{F_{23}^j}(v)\cap V_j|
 \le (\rho_y d/2+2\zeta_t)k_j.
\]
This is exactly \noderef{SimultaneousGoodEdgeGraph} with constant
error family $\zeta_t$. Apply
\noderef{NearEqualVaryingGoodEdgeSuperRegularity}.
Its density lower hypotheses follow from $2\zeta_t<\rho_y,d/2$,
and its upper hypotheses from the strict complementary inequalities
already used. Its square-root premise and the two finite-sum premises
follow from the three displayed loss bounds in the parameter record:
$\sum_j\sqrt{\zeta_t}\le D\sqrt{\zeta_t}$ and
$\sum_j\zeta_t\le D\zeta_t$.
The base error satisfies $\zeta_t\le\theta_t$ by the regularity-loss
bound. Thus the retained current pair is
$(\theta_t,\rho_x)$-super-regular. Moreover
$2\zeta_t\le2\sqrt{\zeta_t}\le\theta_t$ because
$0\le\zeta_t\le1$. The retained window therefore implies the
$(\rho_y d/2\pm\theta_t)k_j$ window. All three pairs, their actual
size relations, their disjointness, and this window give the precise
\noderef{NearEqualRegularTriplet} at $(\theta_t,\rho_x,\rho_y,d/2)$.

Use $\mathcal C.\mathrm{matchingExistenceGuarantee}$ at $(t,x)$,
size $m\ge n$, on the retained pair. Its input error is $\theta_t$,
not $\theta_t/2$. Use
$\mathcal C.\mathrm{matchingGuarantee}$ at the same round and
exposure. The uniformly chosen retained matching has ambient-value
spread at most
$\mathcal C.\mathrm{matchingConstant}(t,x)/m\le C/(2m)$.
The passage between its host subtype and ambient host values is
injective; a prescribed value outside the host part has probability
zero, and values inside give the identical cylinder. Hence the same
bound holds for matching functions into the host subtype.
These certificate fields can be used at their own vertex-type universes.
Relabel the finite ambient type to a lifted finite ordinal, using
\noderef{FiniteTripletRelabelling}. It preserves part sizes,
super-regularity, triplets, matching bijections, and matching-induced
success conditions. The matching bijection pushes the uniform law to
the uniform law: each matching has mass the reciprocal of the same
finite matching count. Pulling back cylinders through the part
bijections gives identical cylinders. Thus the certificate bounds apply
to the original retained graph, even if the field and ambient universes
differ; no threshold is changed.
For every test use
$\mathcal C.\mathrm{fourGraphsGuarantee}$ at $(t,x,y)$, explicitly
with $x,y\le D$ and $t<q$. Its threshold is at most $n\le m$ and
the triplet has just been verified. It gives failure at most
$(1-a_{t,x,y})^m\le(1-a)^m$, since $a\le a_{t,x,y}\le1$.

Apply \noderef{OneClusterExtension} at actual size $m$, with constant
$C_m=Cm/n$, so $C_m/m=C/n$ and $C_m/(2m)=C/(2n)$.
The raw spread bound $C/(2m)\le C/(2n)$ supplies its spread premise;
the scalar budget is
$D(1-a)^m\le D(1-a)^n\le1/2$.
Its density hypotheses are $0<\theta_t$, $4\theta_t<\rho_x\le1$;
its spread-unit hypothesis is the recorded $C/n\le1$.
All its conclusions therefore hold for this one current matching:
the intersection of the local success events has probability at least
one half, contains a supported matching, and its conditioned law is
$C/n$-spread. For the preliminary law use the matching-spread guarantee
and $m\ge n$ to get the weaker $C/(2n)$ bound. These enlargements are
justified by \noderef{VertexSpreadMonotone}.

Every retained matching is a compatible partial embedding of $Y$ for
the updated system: it is injective, its edges lie in the current
contained witness, and $Y$ is independent by \noderef{BlowUpInstance}.
The injection $\ell$ in \noderef{ColourRoundMatchingRecords} chooses
fixed values off $Y$, and on $Y$ evaluates the matching via a source
bijection $e:Y\to U$ and host injection $v:K\to V(G)$.
Let $\lambda$ be the uniform law on perfect matching records and
$\lambda_f$ its pushforward to matching functions. If $E_f$ is the
simultaneous-success event supplied by \noderef{OneClusterExtension},
put $E_0=\{\sigma:\sigma\in E_f\}$ in matching-record space,
$\nu_0=\ell_*\lambda$, and $E=\ell(E_0)$.
Injectivity gives $\ell^{-1}(E)=E_0$, so
\[
 \nu_0(E)=\lambda(E_0)=\lambda_f(E_f)\ge1/2.
\]
A supported successful function has a supported matching-record
preimage, and its image under $\ell$ is the required supported record.
For any pushforward $b_*\lambda$ and any event $S$ of positive mass,
the filter formula is
\[
 \bigl(b_*(\lambda\mid b^{-1}S)\bigr)(z)
 =\frac{\sum_{\sigma:b(\sigma)=z}1_S(b(\sigma))\lambda(\sigma)}
        {\lambda(b^{-1}S)}
 =\bigl((b_*\lambda)\mid S\bigr)(z).
\]
Use this with $b=\ell,S=E$, and with the matching-record forgetful map
and $S=E_f$. The two evaluation pushforwards therefore commute with
conditioning and have exactly the unconditioned and conditioned
matching-function laws transported by
$\sigma\mapsto(y\mapsto v(\sigma(e(y))))$.
For an injective family of source targets $y_b\in Y$ and host targets
$w_b$, if some $w_b$ is outside $v(K)$, its cylinder has empty preimage
and probability zero. Otherwise choose the unique $k_b\in K$ with
$v(k_b)=w_b$. Its preimage is exactly the matching cylinder
$\sigma(e(y_b))=k_b$ for all $b$. The indices $e(y_b)$ remain
distinct, so both matching spread estimates transfer unchanged.
This proves the raw $C/(2n)$ and conditioned $C/n$ estimates also
for cylinders whose ambient host targets need not lie in the host part.

Finally fix a supported successful record. It has a matching-record
preimage $\sigma$, and membership in $E$ and injectivity of $\ell$
give $\sigma\in E_0$. Thus all the success clauses of $E_f$ hold.
For each tested neighbour, \noderef{ColourRoundRetainedTriplets}
supplies $W\subseteq T^j_\sigma$ with the required future
super-regularity. For any compatible agreeing lift $h$,
\noderef{ColourRoundMatchingRecords} gives
$T^j_\sigma\subseteq A_h^j$ and both exact unused-part equalities.
Compose these containments; no equality with the true candidacy graph
is asserted. The future exposure is less than $D$ by
\noderef{ColourRoundUntouchedGeometry}, so the recorded identity
$\rho_y d/2=p_{y+1}$ supplies the required density.
The error is $\varepsilon_{t+1}$, and the argument holds for every
compatible agreeing lift, completing the pointwise conclusion.
\end{proof}
ColourRoundMatchingPreparation.tex_statement:
\begin{lemma}[Retained triplets and local success law]
Fix a blow-up instance $B$, candidacy system $A$, square colouring $c$,
sequences $\theta,p,\varepsilon,\rho,\zeta,\omega,\xi$, and a
\noderef{ColourRoundStepParameters} record at $(D,q,d,C,a,n,t)$.
Assume each source cluster has size $n$ or $n+1$ and its host cluster
has the same size, the initial host pairs are
$(\varepsilon_0,d)$-super-regular, and every reduced edge is a
\noderef{SaturatingSourcePair}. Suppose
\(\mathcal I(t,S;X,\mu)\) of \noderef{ColourRoundInvariant} holds,
$i\in c^{-1}(t)\setminus S$, and $f\in\operatorname{supp}(\mu)$.
Put $Y=X_i$, and let $X'$ be the source domain indexed by the earlier
colour classes and $S\cup\{i\}$.
There exist a law $\nu_0$ on compatible partial embeddings of $Y$ for
the updated system $A_f$, an event $E$ in that record space, and a
supported member of $E$, such that
\[
\nu_0(E)\ge1/2,\quad
(\nu_0|_Y)\text{ is }C/(2n)\text{-vertex-spread},\quad
(\nu_0(\,\cdot\mid E)|_Y)\text{ is }C/n\text{-vertex-spread}.
\]
For every supported $g$ of this conditioned law, every compatible
embedding $h$ on $X'$ agreeing with $f$ on $X$ and $g$ on $Y$, and every
unembedded neighbour $j$ of $i$ (that is, $j\notin S$ and $c(j)\ge t$),
the true updated candidacy graph of $j$ at $h$ contains a spanning
$(\varepsilon_{t+1},p_{e_j+1})$-super-regular witness. Here
$e_j=|N_R(j)\cap(\{k:c(k)<t\}\cup S)|$, and the parts are exactly
the source vertices of $j$ outside $X'$ and the host vertices of $j$
outside $h(X')$, not enlarged or abstract image parts.
\end{lemma}

classical
  dsimp only
  intro F hUK hFA hmatch
  let Y := Finset.univ.filter fun x : VH => B.sourceCluster x = i
  let K0 := Finset.univ.filter fun w : VG => B.hostCluster w = i
  let U := Y.image (Sum.inl : VH → VH ⊕ VG)
  let K := K0.image (Sum.inr : VG → VH ⊕ VG)
  let X' := Finset.univ.filter fun x : VH =>
    (colour (B.sourceCluster x)).val < round ∨ B.sourceCluster x ∈ insert i touched
  let ein : Y → U := fun y => ⟨Sum.inl y.1, Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨y.1, y.2, rfl⟩⟩
  have hein : Function.Bijective ein := by
    constructor
    · intro a b hab
      exact Subtype.ext (Sum.inl.inj (congrArg Subtype.val hab))
    · intro u
      obtain ⟨y, hy, heq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp u.2
      exact ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, Subtype.ext heq⟩
  let e : Y ≃ U := Equiv.ofBijective ein hein
  have he (y : Y) : (e y : VH ⊕ VG) = Sum.inl y.1 := rfl
  have hk (k : K) : ∃ w : VG, Sum.inr w = (k : VH ⊕ VG) := by
    obtain ⟨w, _, hw⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp k.2
    exact ⟨w, hw⟩
  let v : K ↪ VG :=
    { toFun := fun k => Classical.choose (hk k)
      inj' := by
        intro a b hab
        apply Subtype.ext
        calc
          (a : VH ⊕ VG) = Sum.inr (Classical.choose (hk a)) := (Classical.choose_spec (hk a)).symm
          _ = Sum.inr (Classical.choose (hk b)) := congrArg Sum.inr hab
          _ = (b : VH ⊕ VG) := Classical.choose_spec (hk b) }
  have hv (k : K) : Sum.inr (v k) = (k : VH ⊕ VG) := Classical.choose_spec (hk k)
  let M := {sigma : U → K // PerfectMatching F U K hUK sigma}
  obtain ⟨sigma0⟩ := hmatch
  obtain ⟨y0, hy0⟩ := hY
  let filler := v (sigma0.val (e ⟨y0, hy0⟩))
  let g (sigma : M) (y : VH) : VG :=
    if hy : y ∈ Y then v (sigma.val (e ⟨y, hy⟩)) else filler
  have hg (sigma : M) (y : Y) : g sigma y.1 = v (sigma.val (e y)) := by
    simp only [g, dif_pos y.2]
  have allowed (sigma : M) (y : Y) :
      (UpdatedCandidacy B A X f).allowed y.1 (g sigma y.1) := by
    have hedge := hFA (sigma.property.2 (e y))
    rw [SimpleGraph.fromRel_adj] at hedge
    rcases hedge.2 with hedge | hedge
    · obtain ⟨a, w, ha, hw, haw⟩ := hedge
      rw [he] at ha
      rw [← hv] at hw
      have hay : y.1 = a := Sum.inl.inj ha
      have hwv : v (sigma.val (e y)) = w := Sum.inr.inj hw
      rw [hg, hay, hwv]
      exact haw.2.2
    · obtain ⟨a, w, ha, hw, _⟩ := hedge
      rw [← hv] at ha
      cases ha
  let record (sigma : M) : PartialCompatibleEmbedding B (UpdatedCandidacy B A X f) Y :=
    { toFun := g sigma
      injOn := by
        intro a ha b hb hab
        rw [hg sigma ⟨a, ha⟩, hg sigma ⟨b, hb⟩] at hab
        exact congrArg Subtype.val (e.injective (sigma.property.1.1 (v.injective hab)))
      map_adj := by
        intro a b ha hb hab
        have hai : B.sourceCluster a = i := (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha).2
        have hbi : B.sourceCluster b = i := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hb).2
        have hne : a ≠ b := hab.ne
        exact False.elim (B.source_independent i hai hbi hne hab)
      compatible := fun y hy => allowed sigma ⟨y, hy⟩ }
  have hrecord (sigma : M) (y : Y) :
      (record sigma).toFun y.1 = v (sigma.val (e y)) := hg sigma y
  let lift : M ↪ PartialCompatibleEmbedding B (UpdatedCandidacy B A X f) Y :=
    { toFun := record
      inj' := by
        intro a b hab
        apply Subtype.ext
        funext u
        obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := e.surjective u
        apply v.injective
        rw [← hrecord, ← hrecord]
        exact congrArg (fun z => z.toFun y.1) hab }
  refine ⟨e, v, lift, he, hv, hrecord, ?_⟩
  intro sigma h hold hnew j hij hjS hjround
  have hji : j ≠ i := fun heq => hij.ne heq.symm
  have memX' (x : VH) : x ∈ X' ↔ x ∈ X ∨ x ∈ Y := by
    rw [hX]
    simp only [X', Y, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and,
      Finset.mem_insert]
    tauto
  have source_unused {y : VH} (hyj : B.sourceCluster y = j) : y ∉ X' := by
    simp only [X', Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, hyj,
      Finset.mem_insert]
    exact not_or.mpr ⟨not_lt.mpr hjround, not_or.mpr ⟨hji, hjS⟩⟩
  have host_unused {w : VG} (hwj : B.hostCluster w = j) : w ∉ X'.image h.toFun := by
    intro hw
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxw⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hw
    have hxj : B.sourceCluster x = j := by
      rw [A.cluster_respecting (h.compatible x hx), hxw, hwj]
    exact source_unused hxj hx
  have transported {y : VH} {w : VG}
      (hyold : (y, w) ∈ UpdatedCandidacyCluster B A X f j)
      (hconstraint : ∀ u : U, (∃ x : VH, (u : VH ⊕ VG) = Sum.inl x ∧ H.Adj x y) →
        ∃ z : VG, (sigma.val u : VH ⊕ VG) = Sum.inr z ∧ G.Adj z w) :
      (y, w) ∈ UpdatedCandidacyCluster B A X' h j := by
    rcases hyold with ⟨hyj, hwj, hyallowed⟩
    refine ⟨hyj, hwj, source_unused hyj, host_unused hwj, hyallowed.2.2.1, ?_⟩
    intro x hx hyx
    rcases (memX' x).mp hx with hxold | hxY
    · rw [hold x hxold]
      exact hyallowed.2.2.2 x hxold hyx
    · let xy : Y := ⟨x, hxY⟩
      obtain ⟨z, hz, hzw⟩ := hconstraint (e xy) ⟨x, he xy, hyx.symm⟩
      have hzv : v (sigma.val (e xy)) = z := Sum.inr.inj ((hv _).trans hz)
      have hhx : h.toFun x = v (sigma.val (e xy)) :=
        (hnew x hxY).trans (hrecord sigma xy)
      rw [hhx, hzv]
      exact hzw.symm
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro p s hedge
    rw [SimpleGraph.fromRel_adj] at hedge ⊢
    refine ⟨hedge.1, ?_⟩
    rcases hedge.2 with hedge | hedge
    · obtain ⟨y, w, hp, hs, hyw, hc⟩ := hedge
      exact Or.inl ⟨y, w, hp, hs, transported hyw hc⟩
    · obtain ⟨y, w, hs, hp, hyw, hc⟩ := hedge
      exact Or.inr ⟨y, w, hs, hp, transported hyw hc⟩
  · ext z
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_image]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, rfl, hyj, _⟩
      exact ⟨y, hyj, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨y, hyj, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨y, rfl, hyj, ?_⟩
      simpa only [X', Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] using source_unused hyj
  · ext z
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_image]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨w, rfl, hwj, _⟩
      exact ⟨w, hwj, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨w, hwj, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨w, rfl, hwj, ?_⟩
      simpa only [X', Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
        using host_unused hwj

theorem ColourRoundMatchingRecords
    {r q : ℕ} {VH VG : Type*} [Fintype VH] [Fintype VG]
    [DecidableEq VH] [DecidableEq VG]
    {H : SimpleGraph VH} {G : SimpleGraph VG} {R : SimpleGraph (Fin r)}
    (B : BlowUpInstance r VH VG H G R) (A : CandidacySystem B)
    (colour : Fin r → Fin q) (round : ℕ) (touched : Finset (Fin r))
    (X : Finset VH) (f : PartialCompatibleEmbedding B A X)
    (i : Fin r) (hi : (colour i).val = round) (hiS : i ∉ touched)
    (hX : X = Finset.univ.filter fun x =>
      (colour (B.sourceCluster x)).val < round ∨ B.sourceCluster x ∈ touched)
    (hY : (Finset.univ.filter fun x : VH => B.sourceCluster x = i).Nonempty) :
    let Y := Finset.univ.filter fun x : VH => B.sourceCluster x = i
    let K0 := Finset.univ.filter fun v : VG => B.hostCluster v = i
    let U := Y.image (Sum.inl : VH → VH ⊕ VG)
    let K := K0.image (Sum.inr : VG → VH ⊕ VG)
    let X' := Finset.univ.filter fun x : VH =>
      (colour (B.sourceCluster x)).val < round ∨ B.sourceCluster x ∈ insert i touched
    let Ai := SimpleGraph.fromRel fun p s =>
      ∃ y : VH, ∃ v : VG, p = Sum.inl y ∧ s = Sum.inr v ∧
        (y, v) ∈ UpdatedCandidacyCluster B A X f i
    ∀ (F : SimpleGraph (VH ⊕ VG)) (hUK : Disjoint U K), F ≤ Ai →
      Nonempty {sigma : U → K // PerfectMatching F U K hUK sigma} →
      ∃ (e : Y ≃ U) (v : K ↪ VG)
        (lift : {sigma : U → K // PerfectMatching F U K hUK sigma} ↪
          PartialCompatibleEmbedding B (UpdatedCandidacy B A X f) Y),
        (∀ y : Y, (e y : VH ⊕ VG) = Sum.inl y.1) ∧
        (∀ k : K, Sum.inr (v k) = (k : VH ⊕ VG)) ∧
        (∀ sigma, ∀ y : Y, (lift sigma).toFun y.1 = v (sigma.val (e y))) ∧
        (∀ sigma, ∀ h : PartialCompatibleEmbedding B A X',
          (∀ x ∈ X, h.toFun x = f.toFun x) →
          (∀ y ∈ Y, h.toFun y = (lift sigma).toFun y) →
          ∀ j : Fin r, R.Adj i j → j ∉ touched → round ≤ (colour j).val →
            let Vj := (Finset.univ.filter fun y : VH => B.sourceCluster y = j).image
              (Sum.inl : VH → VH ⊕ VG)
            let Zj := (Finset.univ.filter fun w : VG => B.hostCluster w = j).image
              (Sum.inr : VG → VH ⊕ VG)
            let T := SimpleGraph.fromRel fun p s =>
              ∃ y : VH, ∃ w : VG, p = Sum.inl y ∧ s = Sum.inr w ∧
                (y, w) ∈ UpdatedCandidacyCluster B A X f j ∧
                ∀ u : U, (∃ x : VH, (u : VH ⊕ VG) = Sum.inl x ∧ H.Adj x y) →
                  ∃ z : VG, (sigma.val u : VH ⊕ VG) = Sum.inr z ∧ G.Adj z w

              ∃ y : VH, ∃ w : VG, p = Sum.inl y ∧ s = Sum.inr w ∧

            (Finset.univ.filter fun z : VH ⊕ VG =>
