open scoped BigOperators

structure FiniteIntegralFlow {V : Type*} [Fintype V]
    (N : FiniteCapacityNetwork V) where
FiniteIntegralFlow.name: FiniteIntegralFlow
FiniteIntegralFlow.tex_statement:
\begin{definition}[Feasible integral net flow]
For a network as in \noderef{FiniteCapacityNetwork}, a feasible integral
net flow is a function $f:V\times V\to\mathbb Z$ such that
$f(v,w)=-f(w,v)$, $f(v,w)\leq c(v,w)$, and
$\sum_w f(v,w)=0$ whenever $v\ne s,t$.
Its value is $|f|=\sum_w f(s,w)$. In particular
$-c(w,v)\leq f(v,w)\leq c(v,w)$; if the reverse arc is absent, this
is the usual nonnegative integral arc flow. A residual step from $v$ to
$w$ is a pair with $f(v,w)<c(v,w)$, with residual capacity
$c(v,w)-f(v,w)$.
\end{definition}
FiniteIntegralFlow.title: FiniteIntegralFlow

FinitePartialMatchingCompletion.lean_proof:
classical
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := Function.Embedding.nonempty_of_card_le hcard
  let A := {x : S // ∃ y, M x y}
  let g : A → T := fun x => Classical.choose x.property
  have hg (x : A) : M x.val (g x) := Classical.choose_spec x.property
  have hginj : Function.Injective g := by
    intro x y h
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hright x.val y.val (g y) (h ▸ hg x) (hg y)
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := Equiv.Perm.exists_extending_pair
    (fun x : A => e x.val) g (e.injective.comp Subtype.val_injective) hginj
  refine ⟨e.trans σ.toEmbedding, ?_⟩
  intro x y hxy
  have h := hσ ⟨x, ⟨y, hxy⟩⟩
  change σ (e x) = y
  exact h.trans (hleft x _ y (hg ⟨x, ⟨y, hxy⟩⟩) hxy)
FinitePartialMatchingCompletion.lean_statement:
theorem FinitePartialMatchingCompletion
    {S T : Type*} [Fintype S] [Fintype T] (M : S → T → Prop)
    (hleft : ∀ x y z, M x y → M x z → y = z)
    (hright : ∀ x y z, M x z → M y z → x = y)
    (hcard : Fintype.card S ≤ Fintype.card T) :
    ∃ τ : S ↪ T, ∀ x y, M x y → τ x = y := by
FinitePartialMatchingCompletion.name: FinitePartialMatchingCompletion
FinitePartialMatchingCompletion.tex_proof:
\begin{proof}
Let $A=\{x\in S:\exists y\in T,\ M(x,y)\}$.
For $x\in A$, let $g(x)$ be its unique partner.  The first uniqueness
condition makes this well-defined; the second makes $g:A\to T$ injective.
Put $D=g(A)$.  Then $g:A\to D$ is a bijection, so $|A|=|D|$.
The finite disjoint decompositions $S=A\sqcup(S\setminus A)$ and
$T=D\sqcup(T\setminus D)$ show that
$|S\setminus A|=|S|-|A|\leq |T|-|D|=|T\setminus D|$.
Enumerate the two complements and send the $\ell$th element of the
first to the $\ell$th element of the second.  This defines an injection
$f:S\setminus A\to T\setminus D$, also when the domain is empty.
Define $\tau$ to equal $g$ on $A$ and $f$ on its complement.
Each restriction is injective and their images lie in the disjoint
sets $D$ and $T\setminus D$, so $\tau$ is injective.  If $M(x,y)$,
then $x\in A$ and uniqueness gives $\tau(x)=g(x)=y$.
\end{proof}
FinitePartialMatchingCompletion.tex_statement:
\begin{lemma}[Completion of a finite partial matching]
Let $S,T$ be finite sets and let $M\subseteq S\times T$ satisfy the
following two uniqueness conditions: $M(x,y)$ and $M(x,z)$ imply $y=z$,
and $M(x,z)$ and $M(y,z)$ imply $x=y$.
If $|S|\leq |T|$, there is an injection $\tau:S\to T$ such that
$M(x,y)$ implies $\tau(x)=y$ for every $x\in S,y\in T$.
Thus the graph of $\tau$ retains every pair of the original partial matching.
\end{lemma}
FinitePartialMatchingCompletion.title: FinitePartialMatchingCompletion

FiniteSuperRegularThinning.lean_proof:
classical
  let e : V ≃ ULift.{v} (Fin (Fintype.card V)) :=
    (Fintype.equivFin V).trans Equiv.ulift.symm
  let T := G.comap e.symm
  obtain ⟨_, _, hdisj, _, _, _, _, hsr, _, _⟩ :=
    FiniteTripletRelabelling e G L R hLR
  have card (S : Finset V) : (S.image e).card = S.card :=
    Finset.card_image_of_injective S e.injective
  obtain ⟨T', hsub, hT'⟩ := guarantee T (L.image e) (R.image e) hdisj
    (by simpa only [card] using hL) (by simpa only [card] using hR)
    (by simpa only [card] using hnearL) (by simpa only [card] using hnearR)
    ((hsr eps p).mp hG)
  let G' := T'.comap e
  letI : DecidableRel T'.Adj := Classical.decRel _
  refine ⟨G', ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x y hxy
    have hh := hsub hxy
    simpa only [T, SimpleGraph.comap_adj, Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using hh
  · have hh := SuperRegularPairEmbedding e.symm e.symm.injective T' G'
      (L.image e) (R.image e) xi rho (fun x _ y _ => by simp [G']) hT'
    simpa only [Finset.image_image, Function.comp_def, Equiv.symm_apply_apply,
      Finset.image_id'] using hh
FiniteSuperRegularThinning.lean_statement:
universe u v

theorem FiniteSuperRegularThinning
    (N : ℕ) (eps p xi rho : ENNReal)
    (guarantee : ∀ {V : Type v} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
      (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (L R : Finset V),
      Disjoint L R → N ≤ L.card → N ≤ R.card →
      L.card ≤ R.card + 1 → R.card ≤ L.card + 1 →
      SuperRegularPair G L R eps p →
      ∃ G' : SimpleGraph V, G' ≤ G ∧
        @SuperRegularPair V _ G' (Classical.decRel _) L R xi rho)
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (L R : Finset V)
    (hLR : Disjoint L R) (hL : N ≤ L.card) (hR : N ≤ R.card)
    (hnearL : L.card ≤ R.card + 1) (hnearR : R.card ≤ L.card + 1)
    (hG : SuperRegularPair G L R eps p) :
    ∃ G' : SimpleGraph V, G' ≤ G ∧
      @SuperRegularPair V _ G' (Classical.decRel _) L R xi rho := by
FiniteSuperRegularThinning.name: FiniteSuperRegularThinning
FiniteSuperRegularThinning.tex_proof:
\begin{proof}
Identify the given finite vertex type $V$ with
$\operatorname{ULift}(\{0,\ldots,|V|-1\})$ in the universe of the
assumed guarantee, using an equivalence $e$. Put $T=G\circ e^{-1}$
edgewise and $L'=e(L)$, $R'=e(R)$. By
\noderef{FiniteTripletRelabelling}, disjointness and the input
super-regularity are preserved. Injectivity of $e$ gives
$|L'|=|L|$, $|R'|=|R|$, so both threshold and both near-equal-size
inequalities hold unchanged. The assumed guarantee supplies $T'\subseteq T$
with parameters $(\xi,\rho)$ on $L',R'$.
Pull back $T'$ by $e$ to obtain $G'$. An edge $xy$ of $G'$ is an edge
$e(x)e(y)$ of $T'$, hence of $T$, hence an edge of $G$; this proves
containment on the whole ambient type. Apply
\noderef{SuperRegularPairEmbedding} to the injective map $e^{-1}$ and $T'$,
using the adjacency equivalence of the pullback on the two parts. The images
$e^{-1}(L')=L$ and $e^{-1}(R')=R$ are exact, so the output
super-regularity has the original parts and unchanged parameters.
\end{proof}
FiniteSuperRegularThinning.tex_statement:
\begin{lemma}[Universe-independent finite thinning]
Fix a natural number $N$ and parameters $\varepsilon,p,\xi,\rho$.
Assume that, for every finite vertex type in one fixed universe, every graph
$G$ and disjoint finite parts $L,R$ with $N\le |L|,|R|$ and
$|L|\le |R|+1$, $|R|\le |L|+1$, an
$(\varepsilon,p)$-super-regular pair admits a contained
$(\xi,\rho)$-super-regular graph on the same parts.
Then the same conclusion holds for a graph on any finite vertex type,
with the same hypotheses, threshold, parts, and parameters.
\end{lemma}
FiniteSuperRegularThinning.title: FiniteSuperRegularThinning

FiniteTripletRelabelling.lean_proof:
classical
  dsimp only
  let part (S : Finset V) : S ≃ S.image e :=
    { toFun := fun x => ⟨e x, Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨x, x.property, rfl⟩⟩
      invFun := fun y => ⟨e.symm y, by
        obtain ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp y.property
        simpa [← hxy] using hx⟩
      left_inv := fun x => Subtype.ext (e.symm_apply_apply x)
      right_inv := fun y => Subtype.ext (e.apply_symm_apply y) }
  let eU := part U
  let eK := part K
  have coePart (S : Finset V) (x : S) : ((part S) x : V') = e x := rfl
  have hUK' : Disjoint (U.image e) (K.image e) :=
    (Finset.disjoint_image e.injective).mpr hUK
  let push (sigma : {sigma : U → K // PerfectMatching F U K hUK sigma}) :
      {sigma : U.image e → K.image e //
        PerfectMatching (F.comap e.symm) (U.image e) (K.image e) hUK' sigma} :=
    ⟨fun x => eK (sigma.val (eU.symm x)), by
      refine ⟨eK.bijective.comp (sigma.property.1.comp eU.symm.bijective), ?_⟩
      intro x
      change F.Adj (e.symm x) (e.symm (e (sigma.val (eU.symm x))))
      simpa only [e.symm_apply_apply] using sigma.property.2 (eU.symm x)⟩
  let pull (sigma : {sigma : U.image e → K.image e //
        PerfectMatching (F.comap e.symm) (U.image e) (K.image e) hUK' sigma}) :
      {sigma : U → K // PerfectMatching F U K hUK sigma} :=
    ⟨fun x => eK.symm (sigma.val (eU x)), by
      refine ⟨eK.symm.bijective.comp (sigma.property.1.comp eU.bijective), ?_⟩
      intro x
      have h := sigma.property.2 (eU x)
      change F.Adj (e.symm (e x)) (e.symm (sigma.val (eU x))) at h
      simpa only [e.symm_apply_apply] using h⟩
  let eM :=
    { toFun := push
      invFun := pull
      left_inv := fun sigma => by
        apply Subtype.ext
        funext x
        change eK.symm (eK (sigma.val (eU.symm (eU x)))) = sigma.val x
        simp only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
      right_inv := fun sigma => by
        apply Subtype.ext
        funext x
        change eK (eK.symm (sigma.val (eU (eU.symm x)))) = sigma.val x
        simp only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply] :
      {sigma : U → K // PerfectMatching F U K hUK sigma} ≃
        {sigma : U.image e → K.image e //
          PerfectMatching (F.comap e.symm) (U.image e) (K.image e) hUK' sigma} }
  have eval (sigma : {sigma : U → K // PerfectMatching F U K hUK sigma}) (u : U) :
      (eM sigma).val (eU u) = eK (sigma.val u) := by
    change eK (sigma.val (eU.symm (eU u))) = _
    rw [eU.symm_apply_apply]
  have card (S : Finset V) : (S.image e).card = S.card :=
    Finset.card_image_of_injective S e.injective
  have sr (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (L R : Finset V)
      (eps d : ENNReal) :
      SuperRegularPair G L R eps d ↔

FiniteTripletRelabelling.lean_statement:
theorem FiniteTripletRelabelling
    {V V' : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype V'] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableEq V']
    (e : V ≃ V') (F : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel F.Adj]
    (U K : Finset V) (hUK : Disjoint U K) :
    let U' := U.image e
    let K' := K.image e
    let F' := F.comap e.symm
    ∃ (eU : U ≃ U') (eK : K ≃ K') (hUK' : Disjoint U' K')
      (eM : {sigma : U → K // PerfectMatching F U K hUK sigma} ≃
        {sigma : U' → K' // PerfectMatching F' U' K' hUK' sigma}),
      (∀ u, (eU u : V') = e u) ∧
      (∀ k, (eK k : V') = e k) ∧
      (∀ sigma u, (eM sigma).val (eU u) = eK (sigma.val u)) ∧
      (∀ eps d, SuperRegularPair F U K eps d ↔ SuperRegularPair F' U' K' eps d) ∧
      (∀ (F13 F23 : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel F13.Adj] [DecidableRel F23.Adj]
        (Z : Finset V) (m : ℕ) (eps d12 d13 d23 : ENNReal),
        NearEqualRegularTriplet F F13 F23 U K Z m eps d12 d13 d23 ↔
        NearEqualRegularTriplet F' (F13.comap e.symm) (F23.comap e.symm)
          U' K' (Z.image e) m eps d12 d13 d23) ∧
      (∀ (F13 F23 : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel F13.Adj] [DecidableRel F23.Adj]
        (Z : Finset V) (sigma : {sigma : U → K // PerfectMatching F U K hUK sigma})
        (eps d : ENNReal),
        let I := MatchingInducedGraph F13 F23 U K Z sigma.val
        let I' := MatchingInducedGraph (F13.comap e.symm) (F23.comap e.symm)
          U' K' (Z.image e) (eM sigma).val
        @SuperRegularPair _ _ I (Classical.decRel _)
          (Finset.univ.image (Sum.inl : U → U ⊕ Z))
          (Finset.univ.image (Sum.inr : Z → U ⊕ Z)) eps d ↔
        @SuperRegularPair _ _ I' (Classical.decRel _)
          (Finset.univ.image (Sum.inl : U' → U' ⊕ Z.image e))
          (Finset.univ.image (Sum.inr : Z.image e → U' ⊕ Z.image e)) eps d) := by
FiniteTripletRelabelling.name: FiniteTripletRelabelling
FiniteTripletRelabelling.tex_proof:
\begin{proof}
Restriction of $e$ to any finite part is injective and surjective onto
its image, yielding $e_U,e_K$ and likewise $e_Z:Z\to e(Z)$.
If $e(u)=e(k)$ with $u\in U$, $k\in K$, injectivity would give
$u=k$, contrary to disjointness; thus the new parts are disjoint.
Define $e_M(\sigma)=e_K\circ\sigma\circ e_U^{-1}$.
This is bijective because all three factors are bijective.
Its edges are edges of $F'$ exactly when the original matching edges
are edges of $F$, by the definition of the relabelled graph.
Conversely $\sigma'=e_K^{-1}\circ\tau\circ e_U$ is a perfect matching
whenever $\tau$ is one in $F'$. The two constructions are inverse,
proving the matching bijection and the displayed evaluation identity.
Here the meaning of a perfect matching is \noderef{PerfectMatching}.

For any rectangle $P\subseteq U$, $Q\subseteq K$, the map
$(u,k)\mapsto(e(u),e(k))$ is a bijection from its edges to the edges
of the corresponding rectangle in $F'$. Also $|e(P)|=|P|$ and
$|e(Q)|=|Q|$. Consequently the edge densities, defined by
\noderef{PairDensity}, are equal, including empty rectangles.
Every rectangle in the image parts arises in this way by inverse image.
For each vertex the same map gives a bijection of its neighbours
in the opposite part. Thus degrees, part sizes, and the rectangle
size tests in \noderef{SuperRegularPair} are unchanged. All its
inequalities transfer in both directions. Apply this argument also
to the two other pairs. Cardinalities of the three parts and their
disjointness are unchanged, so the three possible near-equal size
relations are unchanged as well. For an edge of the current pair,
$z\mapsto e(z)$ is a bijection between the tested common
neighbourhoods in $Z$ and $e(Z)$. Hence their cardinalities and the
window normalized by $|Z|$ are identical. These facts verify every
clause of \noderef{NearEqualRegularTriplet} in both directions.

Finally use the bijection $e_U\oplus e_Z$ between the two subtype
sum types. By \noderef{MatchingInducedGraph}, a cross edge in the
first intersection means
$F_{13}(u,z)$ and $F_{23}(\sigma(u),z)$.
In the second intersection these conditions are precisely
$e(F_{13})(e_U(u),e_Z(z))$ and
$e(F_{23})(e_M(\sigma)(e_U(u)),e_Z(z))$, by the evaluation identity.
Thus this sum bijection preserves and reflects every cross edge and
maps each full copied part exactly onto its counterpart. The same
degree and rectangle counting argument proves the last equivalence.
No probability statement is needed for this relabelling result.
\end{proof}
FiniteTripletRelabelling.tex_statement:
\begin{lemma}[Relabelling triplets and their matching intersections]
Let $e:V\to V'$ be a bijection between finite vertex types.
Let $F$ be a graph on $V$ with disjoint finite parts $U,K$.
Put $U'=e(U)$, $K'=e(K)$ and $F'=e(F)$, where an edge of $e(F)$
means that its inverse images are adjacent in $F$.
There are bijections $e_U:U\to U'$, $e_K:K\to K'$ agreeing with $e$
on underlying vertices, disjointness $U'\cap K'=\varnothing$, and a
bijection $e_M$ between the perfect matchings of $(F;U,K)$ and
$(F';U',K')$, with
\[
 e_M(\sigma)(e_U(u))=e_K(\sigma(u)).
\]
For every error and density, $(F;U,K)$ is super-regular if and only
if $(F';U',K')$ is super-regular with those same parameters.
For any two further graphs $F_{13},F_{23}$, part $Z$, size $m$, and
parameters, the near-equal regular triplet on $(U,K,Z)$ is equivalent
to the corresponding triplet of relabelled graphs on $(U',K',e(Z))$.
For every perfect matching $\sigma$, error $\delta$, and density $p$,
its matching-induced intersection is $(\delta,p)$-super-regular on
the full canonical subtype copies of $U,Z$ if and only if the
intersection induced by $e_M(\sigma)$ in the relabelled graphs is
$(\delta,p)$-super-regular on the full subtype copies of $U',e(Z)$.
\end{lemma}
FiniteTripletRelabelling.title: FiniteTripletRelabelling

FourGraphsPolynomialLossAbsorption.lean_statement:
theorem FourGraphsPolynomialLossAbsorption (c : ENNReal) (hc : c < 1) :
    ∃ a₀ : ENNReal, 0 < a₀ ∧ ∀ a : ENNReal, 0 < a → a ≤ a₀ →
      ∃ n₀ : ℕ, 2 ≤ n₀ ∧ ∀ m : ℕ, n₀ ≤ m →
        (((m + 1 : ℕ) : ENNReal) + ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ENNReal) ^ 2) * c ^ m ≤
          (1 - a) ^ m := by
FourGraphsPolynomialLossAbsorption.name: FourGraphsPolynomialLossAbsorption
FourGraphsPolynomialLossAbsorption.tex_proof:
\begin{proof}
The number $c$ is finite. Put $r=(c+1)/2$, so $0<r<1$ and $c<r$,
and choose $a_0=1-r>0$. If $c=0$, every displayed left-hand side
vanishes for $m\geq2$, and the claim follows immediately.
Otherwise put $t=c/r\in(0,1)$. For $j=0,1,2$ the sequence $m^jt^m$
tends to zero: for $j>0$ its consecutive-term ratio is
$t(1+1/m)^j$, which is eventually bounded by a fixed number strictly
below $1$; for $j=0$ it is geometric. Hence
\[
 ((m+1)+(m+1)^2)t^m=(m^2+3m+2)t^m\longrightarrow0.
\]
Choose $n_0\geq2$ so this expression is at most $1$ for every
$m\geq n_0$. Multiplying by $r^m>0$ gives the left-hand side in
the statement at most $r^m$. Finally $a\leq1-r$ implies
$r\leq1-a$, proving the assertion. All these choices concern finite
nonnegative numbers, so they are equally valid in extended arithmetic.
\end{proof}
FourGraphsPolynomialLossAbsorption.tex_statement:
\begin{lemma}[Absorbing the Four Graphs polynomial loss]
For every extended nonnegative real $c<1$ there exists $a_0>0$ such
that, for every $0<a\leq a_0$, there is $n_0\geq2$ with
\[
 ((m+1)+(m+1)^2)c^m\leq(1-a)^m\qquad(m\geq n_0).
\]
\end{lemma}
FourGraphsPolynomialLossAbsorption.title: FourGraphsPolynomialLossAbsorption

have h₁ : (s.choose x : ℝ) * (x.factorial : ℝ) *
      ((s - x).factorial : ℝ) = (s.factorial : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial hxs
  have h₂ : ((n - s).choose (t - x) : ℝ) * ((t - x).factorial : ℝ) *
      ((n - s - (t - x)).factorial : ℝ) = ((n - s).factorial : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial hfit
  have h₃ : (n.choose s : ℝ) * (s.factorial : ℝ) *
      ((n - s).factorial : ℝ) = (n.factorial : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial hs
  have hn : (n.factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_ne_zero n
  have hc : (n.choose s : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.choose_ne_zero hs
  apply (div_eq_div_iff hn hc).2
  calc
    _ = (t.choose x : ℝ) * ((n - t).choose (s - x) : ℝ) *
        ((n.choose s : ℝ) *
          ((s.choose x : ℝ) * (x.factorial : ℝ) * ((s - x).factorial : ℝ)) *
          (((n - s).choose (t - x) : ℝ) * ((t - x).factorial : ℝ) *
            ((n - s - (t - x)).factorial : ℝ))) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [h₁, h₂, h₃]
FourRectangleFactorialCancellation.lean_statement:
theorem FourRectangleFactorialCancellation (n s t x : ℕ)
    (hs : s ≤ n) (ht : t ≤ n) (hxs : x ≤ s) (hxt : x ≤ t)
    (hfit : t - x ≤ n - s) :
    (s.choose x : ℝ) * (t.choose x : ℝ) *
      ((n - t).choose (s - x) : ℝ) * ((n - s).choose (t - x) : ℝ) *
      ((x.factorial : ℝ) * ((s - x).factorial : ℝ) *
        ((t - x).factorial : ℝ) * ((n - s - (t - x)).factorial : ℝ)) /
      (n.factorial : ℝ) =
    (t.choose x : ℝ) * ((n - t).choose (s - x) : ℝ) / (n.choose s : ℝ) := by
FourRectangleFactorialCancellation.name: FourRectangleFactorialCancellation
FourRectangleFactorialCancellation.tex_proof:
\begin{proof}
The factorial identity $\binom a b b!(a-b)!=a!$ for $b\le a$
applied to $(a,b)=(s,x),(n-s,t-x),(n,s)$ gives, respectively,
\[
 \binom s x x!(s-x)!=s!,\quad
 \binom{n-s}{t-x}(t-x)!y_4!=(n-s)!,\quad
 \binom n s s!(n-s)!=n!.
\]
Multiplying the first two identities and then the third proves the desired
identity after multiplying both sides by the positive numbers $n!$ and
$\binom n s$. These numbers are positive also when $n=0$. All factorials
of zero equal one, so no cancellation excludes an empty rectangle.
\end{proof}
FourRectangleFactorialCancellation.tex_statement:
\begin{lemma}[Four-rectangle factorial cancellation]
Let $s,t\le n$, $x\le s,t$, and $t-x\le n-s$ be natural numbers.
Put $y_1=x$, $y_2=s-x$, $y_3=t-x$, and
$y_4=n-s-(t-x)=n-s-t+x$. Then
\[
 \binom s x\binom t x\binom{n-t}{s-x}\binom{n-s}{t-x}
 {y_1!y_2!y_3!y_4!\over n!}
 ={\binom t x\binom{n-t}{s-x}\over\binom n s}.
\]
This includes zero orders, including $n=0$.
\end{lemma}
FourRectangleFactorialCancellation.title: FourRectangleFactorialCancellation

    · exact Finset.sdiff_subset
  have horders (q : choices) (i : Fin 4) :
      (L q i).card = y i ∧ (R q i).card = y i := by
    obtain ⟨hA, hB, hC, hE⟩ := hp q
    have hEU := hE.1.trans Finset.sdiff_subset
    have hCW := hC.1.trans Finset.sdiff_subset
    have hSE : Disjoint S q.1.2.2.2 := by
      apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
      intro u huS huE
      exact (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp (hE.1 huE)).2 huS
    have hTC : Disjoint T q.1.2.2.1 := by
      apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
      intro u huT huC
      exact (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp (hC.1 huC)).2 huT
    fin_cases i
    · exact ⟨hA.2, hB.2⟩
    · refine ⟨?_, hC.2⟩
      change (S \ q.1.1).card = S.card - x
      rw [Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset hA.1, hA.2]
    · refine ⟨hE.2, ?_⟩
      change (T \ q.1.2.1).card = T.card - x
      rw [Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset hB.1, hB.2]
    · constructor
      · change (U \ (S ∪ q.1.2.2.2)).card = n - S.card - (T.card - x)
        rw [Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset (Finset.union_subset hS hEU), hU,
          Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hSE, hE.2, Nat.sub_add_eq]
      · change (W \ (T ∪ q.1.2.2.1)).card = n - S.card - (T.card - x)
        rw [Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset (Finset.union_subset hT hCW), hW,
          Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hTC, hC.2]
        omega
  have hy (i : Fin 4) : y i ≤ n := by
    have hs := Finset.card_le_card hS
    have ht := Finset.card_le_card hT
    fin_cases i <;> dsimp [y] <;> omega
  have hcover (q : choices) (u : V) (hu : u ∈ U) : ∃ i, u ∈ L q i := by
    by_cases huS : u ∈ S
    · by_cases huA : u ∈ q.1.1
      · exact ⟨0, huA⟩
      · exact ⟨1, Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨huS, huA⟩⟩
    · by_cases huE : u ∈ q.1.2.2.2
      · exact ⟨2, huE⟩
      · exact ⟨3, Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨hu, by simpa only [Finset.mem_union,
          not_or] using (And.intro huS huE)⟩⟩
  let fiber := fun q : choices => {f : U → W | PerfectMatching G U W hUW f ∧
    ∀ i, ((L q i).attach.image fun u => (f ⟨u.1, hL q i u.2⟩).1) = R q i}
  let counted := {f : U → W | PerfectMatching G U W hUW f ∧
    (Finset.univ.filter fun u : U => u.1 ∈ S ∧ (f u).1 ∈ T).card = x}
  have hencode (f : counted) : ∃ q : choices, f.1 ∈ fiber q := by
    -- Extend to ambient vertices for finset images; only values on U matter.
    let F : V → V := fun u => if hu : u ∈ U then (f.1 ⟨u, hu⟩).1 else u
    have hFu (u : U) : F u.1 = (f.1 u).1 := by simp [F, u.2]
    have hF : Set.BijOn F (U : Set V) (W : Set V) := by
      refine Set.BijOn.mk ?_ ?_ ?_
      · intro u hu
        rw [hFu ⟨u, hu⟩]
        exact (f.1 ⟨u, hu⟩).2
      · intro u hu v hv huv
        have heq : f.1 ⟨u, hu⟩ = f.1 ⟨v, hv⟩ :=
          Subtype.ext ((hFu ⟨u, hu⟩).symm.trans (huv.trans (hFu ⟨v, hv⟩)))
        exact congrArg (fun a : U => a.1) (f.2.1.1.1 heq)
      · intro v hv
        obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := f.2.1.1.2 ⟨v, hv⟩
        exact ⟨u.1, u.2, (hFu u).trans (congrArg (fun b : W => b.1) hu)⟩
    have hx : (S.filter fun u => F u ∈ T).card = x := by
      rw [← f.2.2]
      symm
      apply Finset.card_bij (fun u _ => u.1)
      · intro u hu
        obtain ⟨_, huS, huT⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hu
        exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨huS, (hFu u).symm ▸ huT⟩
      · intro u hu v hv huv
        exact Subtype.ext huv
      · intro v hv
        obtain ⟨hvS, hvT⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hv
        refine ⟨⟨v, hS hvS⟩, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hvS, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
        simpa only [F, dif_pos (hS hvS)] using hvT
    obtain ⟨hA, hB, hC, hE, hEi, hDi, hSc, hTc, hDc, hRc, hpartL, hpartR⟩ :=
      FourRectangleMatchingPartition U W S T F hF hS hT n x hU hW hx
    let A := S.filter fun u => F u ∈ T
    let B := A.image F
    let C := (S \ A).image F
    let E := U.filter fun u => F u ∈ T \ B
    let q : choices := ⟨(A, B, C, E), by
      exact Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨hA, Finset.mem_product.mpr
        ⟨hB, Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨hC, hE⟩⟩⟩⟩
    refine ⟨q, f.2.1, ?_⟩
    intro i
    have himage : ((L q i).attach.image fun u =>
        (f.1 ⟨u.1, hL q i u.2⟩).1) = (L q i).image F := by
      ext v
      simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_attach, true_and]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨u, hu⟩
        exact ⟨u.1, u.2, (hFu ⟨u.1, hL q i u.2⟩).trans hu⟩
      · rintro ⟨u, hu, huv⟩
        exact ⟨⟨u, hu⟩, (hFu ⟨u, hL q i hu⟩).symm.trans huv⟩
    rw [himage]
    fin_cases i
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · exact hEi
    · exact hDi
  have hfiber (q : choices) : ((fiber q).ncard : ℝ) ≤ ∏ i, K (y i) := by
    let P := fun i => {g : L q i → R q i |
      PerfectMatching G (L q i) (R q i) (hUW.mono (hL q i) (hR q i)) g}
    have hcount : (fiber q).ncard ≤ ∏ i, (P i).ncard :=
      MatchingPartitionRestrictionCount G U W hUW (L q) (R q) (hL q) (hR q) (hcover q)
    have hb (i : Fin 4) : ((P i).ncard : ℝ) ≤ K (y i) :=
      hbound (L q i) (R q i) (hUW.mono (hL q i) (hR q i))
        (y i) (hL q i) (hR q i) (horders q i).1 (horders q i).2
    have h01 : ((P 0).ncard : ℝ) * ((P 1).ncard : ℝ) ≤ K (y 0) * K (y 1) :=
      mul_le_mul (hb 0) (hb 1) (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (hK _ (hy 0))
    have h012 : ((P 0).ncard : ℝ) * ((P 1).ncard : ℝ) * ((P 2).ncard : ℝ) ≤
        K (y 0) * K (y 1) * K (y 2) :=
      mul_le_mul h01 (hb 2) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
        (mul_nonneg (hK _ (hy 0)) (hK _ (hy 1)))
    calc
      ((fiber q).ncard : ℝ) ≤ ((∏ i, (P i).ncard : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hcount
      _ = ∏ i, ((P i).ncard : ℝ) := by rw [Nat.cast_prod]
      _ ≤ ∏ i, K (y i) := by
        rw [Fin.prod_univ_four, Fin.prod_univ_four]
        exact mul_le_mul h012 (hb 3) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
          (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hK _ (hy 0)) (hK _ (hy 1))) (hK _ (hy 2)))
  let encode : counted → Σ q : choices, fiber q := fun f =>
    ⟨(hencode f).choose, ⟨f.1, (hencode f).choose_spec⟩⟩
  have hinj : Function.Injective encode := by
    intro f g hfg
    exact Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun z : Σ q : choices, fiber q => z.2.1) hfg)
  have htotal : counted.ncard ≤ ∑ q : choices, (fiber q).ncard := by
    have h := Fintype.card_le_of_injective encode hinj
    simpa only [Fintype.card_sigma, ← Nat.card_coe_set_eq, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using h
  have hsum : (counted.ncard : ℝ) ≤ (choices.card : ℝ) * (∏ i, K (y i)) := by
    calc
      (counted.ncard : ℝ) ≤ ((∑ q : choices, (fiber q).ncard : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast htotal
      _ = ∑ q : choices, ((fiber q).ncard : ℝ) := by rw [Nat.cast_sum]
      _ ≤ ∑ _q : choices, ∏ i, K (y i) := Finset.sum_le_sum fun q _ => hfiber q
      _ = (choices.card : ℝ) * (∏ i, K (y i)) := by
        simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_coe, nsmul_eq_mul]
  have hc : choices.card = S.card.choose x * T.card.choose x *
      (n - T.card).choose (S.card - x) * (n - S.card).choose (T.card - x) := by
    simp only [choices, Finset.product_eq_sprod, Finset.card_product, Finset.card_powersetCard,
      Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset hT, Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset hS, hU, hW]
    ac_rfl
  change (counted.ncard : ℝ) ≤ _
  convert hsum using 1
  rw [hc, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_mul, Fin.prod_univ_four]
  rfl
FourRectangleMatchingFiberBound.lean_statement:
theorem FourRectangleMatchingFiberBound
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (U W S T : Finset V) (hUW : Disjoint U W) (n x : ℕ)
    (hU : U.card = n) (hW : W.card = n) (hS : S ⊆ U) (hT : T ⊆ W)
    (hxS : x ≤ S.card) (hxT : x ≤ T.card)
    (hfit : T.card - x ≤ n - S.card) (K : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hK : ∀ y ≤ n, 0 ≤ K y)
    (hbound : ∀ (A B : Finset V) (hAB : Disjoint A B) (y : ℕ),
      A ⊆ U → B ⊆ W → A.card = y → B.card = y →
      ({f : A → B | PerfectMatching G A B hAB f}.ncard : ℝ) ≤ K y) :
    ({f : U → W | PerfectMatching G U W hUW f ∧
      (Finset.univ.filter fun u : U => u.1 ∈ S ∧ (f u).1 ∈ T).card = x}.ncard : ℝ) ≤
    (S.card.choose x : ℝ) * (T.card.choose x : ℝ) *
      ((n - T.card).choose (S.card - x) : ℝ) *
      ((n - S.card).choose (T.card - x) : ℝ) *
      (K x * K (S.card - x) * K (T.card - x) * K (n - S.card - (T.card - x))) := by
FourRectangleMatchingFiberBound.name: FourRectangleMatchingFiberBound
FourRectangleMatchingFiberBound.tex_proof:
\begin{proof}
By \noderef{PerfectMatching}, each counted map is a bijection and uses
only graph edges. For such a map define
$A=\{u\in S:f(u)\in T\}$, $B=f(A)$,
$C=f(S\setminus A)$, and $E=f^{-1}(T\setminus B)$.
These sets have sizes $x,x,s-x,t-x$, respectively; they lie in
$S,T,W\setminus T,U\setminus S$, respectively. There are exactly
$\binom s x\binom t x\binom{n-t}{s-x}\binom{n-s}{t-x}$ possible
quadruples $(A,B,C,E)$, by choosing subsets of the specified sizes
independently in those four fixed sets.

For a fixed quadruple, restriction sends a counted map to four perfect
matchings on the balanced pairs
\[
 (A,B),\quad (S\setminus A,C),\quad(E,T\setminus B),\quad
 (U\setminus(S\cup E),W\setminus(T\cup C)).
\]
Their orders are $x,s-x,t-x,n-s-(t-x)$. The left sets partition $U$
and the right sets partition $W$. Thus the four restrictions determine
the map uniquely. Conversely their union is a bijection using graph
edges and has exactly $x$ images of $S$ in $T$. This also works for empty
parts: the unique empty map is a perfect matching. The assumed rectangle
bound therefore bounds the size of this fiber by the product of the four
$K$ values. All four orders lie between zero and $n$, so these bounds are
nonnegative and can be multiplied. Summing over the possible quadruples
proves the displayed inequality (in fact the restriction construction
gives an exact sum of the four matching-count products).
\end{proof}
FourRectangleMatchingFiberBound.tex_statement:
\begin{lemma}[Counting four-rectangle matching fibers]
Let $G$ be a graph on a finite vertex set, with disjoint parts $U,W$ of
size $n$, and $S\subseteq U$, $T\subseteq W$. Write $s=|S|$, $t=|T|$.
Let $x\le s,t$ and $t-x\le n-s$. Suppose $K(y)\ge0$ for $0\le y\le n$
and every balanced pair $A\subseteq U$, $B\subseteq W$ of order $y$ has
at most $K(y)$ perfect matchings, in the sense of
\noderef{PerfectMatching}. Then the number $M_x$ of perfect matchings
$f:U\to W$ with $|f(S)\cap T|=x$ satisfies
\[
 M_x\le\binom s x\binom t x\binom{n-t}{s-x}\binom{n-s}{t-x}
 K(x)K(s-x)K(t-x)K(n-s-(t-x)).
\]
\end{lemma}
FourRectangleMatchingFiberBound.title: FourRectangleMatchingFiberBound

classical

  let A := S.filter fun u => F u ∈ T

    C ∈ (W \ T).powersetCard (S.card - x) ∧
    E ∈ (U \ S).powersetCard (T.card - x) ∧ _
  have hA : A ⊆ S := Finset.filter_subset _ _
  have hAU : A ⊆ U := hA.trans hS

    intro v hv
    obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hv
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hu).2
  have hBc : B.card = x := by
    rw [show B = A.image F from rfl,
      Finset.card_image_of_injOn (hF.injOn.mono hAU), hAc]

    intro v hv
    obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hv
    obtain ⟨huS, huA⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hu
    refine Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨hF.mapsTo (hS huS), ?_⟩
    intro huT

    rw [Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset hA, hAc]

    rw [show C = (S \ A).image F from rfl,
      Finset.card_image_of_injOn (hF.injOn.mono (Finset.sdiff_subset.trans hS)), hSc]

  have hE : E ⊆ U \ S := by
    intro u hu

    obtain ⟨huT, huB⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp huTB
    refine Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨huU, ?_⟩

  have hEi : E.image F = T \ B := by
    ext v
    constructor
    · intro hv

      obtain ⟨u, huU, hu⟩ := hF.surjOn (hT (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hv).1)

FourRectangleMatchingPartition.lean_statement:
theorem FourRectangleMatchingPartition
    {V : Type*} [DecidableEq V]
    (U W S T : Finset V) (F : V → V)
    (hF : Set.BijOn F (U : Set V) (W : Set V))
    (hS : S ⊆ U) (hT : T ⊆ W) (n x : ℕ)
    (hU : U.card = n) (hW : W.card = n)
    (hx : (S.filter fun u => F u ∈ T).card = x) :
    let A := S.filter fun u => F u ∈ T
    let B := A.image F
    let C := (S \ A).image F
    let E := U.filter fun u => F u ∈ T \ B
    A ∈ S.powersetCard x ∧ B ∈ T.powersetCard x ∧
    C ∈ (W \ T).powersetCard (S.card - x) ∧
    E ∈ (U \ S).powersetCard (T.card - x) ∧
    E.image F = T \ B ∧
    (U \ (S ∪ E)).image F = W \ (T ∪ C) ∧
    (S \ A).card = S.card - x ∧ (T \ B).card = T.card - x ∧
    (U \ (S ∪ E)).card = n - S.card - (T.card - x) ∧
    (W \ (T ∪ C)).card = n - S.card - (T.card - x) ∧
    A ∪ (S \ A) ∪ E ∪ (U \ (S ∪ E)) = U ∧
    B ∪ C ∪ (T \ B) ∪ (W \ (T ∪ C)) = W := by
FourRectangleMatchingPartition.name: FourRectangleMatchingPartition
FourRectangleMatchingPartition.tex_proof:
\begin{proof}
The definition gives $A\subseteq S$, $|A|=x$, and $B\subseteq T$.
Injectivity of $F$ on $U$ gives $|B|=x$ and
$|C|=|S\setminus A|=|S|-x$. If $u\in S\setminus A$, then
$F(u)\in W$ but $F(u)\notin T$, since otherwise $u\in A$.
Thus $C\subseteq W\setminus T$.

If $u\in E\cap S$, then $F(u)\in T$ implies $u\in A$, and
hence $F(u)\in B$, contradicting the definition of $E$.
Consequently $E\subseteq U\setminus S$. Every element of $F(E)$
lies in $T\setminus B$ by definition. Conversely, each
$w\in T\setminus B$ has a preimage $u\in U$ because $F$ maps $U$
onto $W$, and that preimage belongs to $E$. Therefore
$F(E)=T\setminus B$. Injectivity now gives
$|E|=|T\setminus B|=|T|-x$.

We have $F(S)=B\cup C$, and therefore
$F(S\cup E)=B\cup C\cup(T\setminus B)=T\cup C$.
Since $F$ is injective on $U$ and maps $U$ onto $W$, taking complements
inside these parts gives
$F(U\setminus(S\cup E))=W\setminus(T\cup C)$.
The disjointness of $S$ and $E$ gives
$|U\setminus(S\cup E)|=n-|S|-(|T|-x)$; injectivity gives the
same order for its image. The first union identity follows from
$A\cup(S\setminus A)=S$ and $S\cup E\subseteq U$.
For the second, $B\cup C\cup(T\setminus B)=T\cup C\subseteq W$,
so adjoining its complement in $W$ gives $W$. These arguments also
apply when any of the sets is empty.
\end{proof}
FourRectangleMatchingPartition.tex_statement:
\begin{lemma}[The canonical four-rectangle partition]
Let $U,W$ be finite sets of size $n$, let $S\subseteq U$ and
$T\subseteq W$, and let $F$ map $U$ bijectively onto $W$.
Suppose $|\{u\in S:F(u)\in T\}|=x$. Define
\[
 A=\{u\in S:F(u)\in T\},\quad B=F(A),\quad
 C=F(S\setminus A),\quad E=\{u\in U:F(u)\in T\setminus B\}.
\]
Then $A,B,C,E$ belong, respectively, to the families of subsets of
$S,T,W\setminus T,U\setminus S$ of sizes $x,x,|S|-x,|T|-x$.
Moreover,
\[
 F(E)=T\setminus B,\qquad
 F(U\setminus(S\cup E))=W\setminus(T\cup C).
\]
The orders of $S\setminus A$ and $T\setminus B$ are $|S|-x$ and
$|T|-x$, respectively. Both $U\setminus(S\cup E)$ and
$W\setminus(T\cup C)$ have order $n-|S|-(|T|-x)$.
Finally, the unions of the four left and four right parts are exactly
$U$ and $W$:
\[
 A\cup(S\setminus A)\cup E\cup(U\setminus(S\cup E))=U,
 \qquad
 B\cup C\cup(T\setminus B)\cup(W\setminus(T\cup C))=W.
\]
\end{lemma}

FourRectangleSmallOrderProduct.tex_proof:
\begin{proof}
Not all four orders can be smaller than $\kappa n$, since that would
give $n<4\kappa n<n$. Fix one large order. Put $r_i=0$ for large
orders and $r_i=y_i$ for small orders. Each $r_i$ is nonnegative and
at most $\kappa n$, and the fixed large order contributes zero.
Thus $q=\sum_i r_i\le3\kappa n$.
For every order the density factor in $K(y_i)$ equals
$\exp((y_i-r_i)\log D)$, including zero orders. Multiplying gives
$\exp((n-q)\log D)\prod_i y_i!$.
If $D\ge1$, then $\log D\ge0$ and $q\ge0$, so this is at most
$D^n\prod_i y_i!$; also $\log\min(D,1)=0$.
If $0<D<1$, then $\log D\le0$ and $q\le3\kappa n$, so
$(n-q)\log D\le n\log D-3\kappa n\log D$.
Exponentiating this inequality proves the bound in this case as well.
The factorial product is nonnegative, hence multiplication preserves
both inequalities.
\end{proof}
FourRectangleSmallOrderProduct.tex_statement:
\begin{lemma}[Loss from small matching rectangles]
Let $0<\kappa<1/4$, $D>0$, and let $n>0$ be an integer.
Let four nonnegative integer orders $y_i$, indexed by $i\in\{0,1,2,3\}$,
sum to $n$. Set $K(y)=D^y y!$ if $y\ge\kappa n$, and $K(y)=y!$
otherwise. Then
\[
 \prod_i K(y_i)\le
 D^n\exp(-3\kappa n\log\min(D,1))\prod_i y_i!.
\]
\end{lemma}

FutureExtraSourceWitnessTransport.tex_proof:
\begin{proof}
Before testing any edges, use \noderef{MatchingInducedLeftRowDeletion}
on $W[V,Z]$ to delete the row $v_0$. The size parameter is $n$, the
right part has $n+1$ vertices, the errors are $\xi,\eta$, and all the
unit and slack hypotheses are displayed. The resulting pair on
$V\setminus\{v_0\},Z$ is $(\eta,p)$-super-regular.
Pull it back along $\tau$ and restrict to $U,Z$. Bijections preserve
all the degrees and tested rectangle edge counts in
\noderef{SuperRegularPair}, giving the asserted graph $F$ and its
exact cross-part adjacency equivalence.

For a successful $\sigma$, define the residual graph $B$ to have just
the edges $\tau(u)z$ with $uz\in F$ and $\sigma(u)z\in J$, and their
reverses. Apply \noderef{MatchingInducedUpdatedCandidacyTransport} to
$\tau$, $\sigma$, and $B$, using the complete bipartite matching graph
on $U,K$. Bijectivity makes $\sigma$ a perfect matching as in
\noderef{PerfectMatching}. Its adjacency hypothesis is the definition
of $B$; its exact-image hypotheses are the equivalence for
$V\setminus\{v_0\}=\tau(U)$ and the identity equivalence for $Z$.
Thus $B[V\setminus\{v_0\},Z]$ is $(\omega,ph)$-super-regular.
The pulled-back-row identity, $W\subseteq O$, and $J\subseteq H$
show $B\subseteq T_\sigma$. The source-matching equivalence ensures
there is precisely one newly imposed host constraint on every residual
row. It also ensures that $v_0$ has no neighbour in $U$, so its entire
old $O$-row is still available in $T_\sigma$.

Put $k=\lfloor ph|Z|\rfloor$. The outer degree reserve implies
$1/n\le e$ and hence $e|Z|\ge1$, since $|Z|=n+1$.
Integer rounding therefore gives
$(ph-e)|Z|\le k\le(ph+e)|Z|$.
The old degree lower bound gives
$\deg_{T_\sigma}(v_0,Z)=\deg_O(v_0,Z)\ge(p_0-e_0)|Z|$.
The gap inequality implies $p_0-e_0\ge ph+1/n$, and consequently
$k\le ph|Z|\le(p_0-e_0)|Z|\le\deg_{T_\sigma}(v_0,Z)$.
Here $e_0$ is finite because $e_0\le1$; $p_0$ is finite because otherwise
the old row lower bound at $v_0$ would be infinite, contradicting its
finite degree and $|Z|>0$. Thus subtracting $e_0$ in the gap inequality
is legitimate. These calculations also cover zero output density.
Now apply \noderef{FutureExtraVertexStability} to $B$ inside
$T_\sigma$, on residual left size $n$ and right size $n+1$, with
row size $k$, errors $\omega,e$, and density $ph$. Its two analytic
reserves and unit bounds are exactly the hypotheses. It selects a
$k$-subset of the genuine old row, adjoins that row, and returns a
spanning contained $(e,ph)$-super-regular graph. No artificial row and
no surjection onto the full future part are used in this case.
\end{proof}
FutureExtraSourceWitnessTransport.tex_statement:
\begin{lemma}[Residual future transport and genuine row restoration]
In a finite disjoint-union ambient set, let
$U\cap K=U\cap Z=K\cap Z=V\cap Z=\varnothing$,
$|U|=|K|=n$, $|V|=|Z|=n+1$, and $n\ge1$.
Let $v_0\in V$ and let $\tau:U\to V\setminus\{v_0\}$ be a bijection
such that $uv\in M\Longleftrightarrow v=\tau(u)$ on $U\times V$.
Assume $W\subseteq O$, $J\subseteq H$, $e_0\le1$,
$O[V,Z]$ is $(e_0,p_0)$-super-regular, and $W[V,Z]$ is
$(\xi,p)$-super-regular. Suppose $p\le1$, $ph\le1$, and
\[
\xi<\eta\le1,\quad\xi+2/n\le\eta,\quad
\xi+1/(\eta n)\le\eta,
\]
\[
\omega<e\le1,\quad\omega+2/n\le e,\quad
\omega+1/(en)\le e,\quad ph+e_0+1/n\le p_0.
\]
There is an $(\eta,p)$-super-regular graph $F[U,Z]$ with
$uz\in F\Longleftrightarrow\tau(u)z\in W$ on $U\times Z$.
For every bijection $\sigma:U\to K$, if the matching-induced graph on
subtype copies of $U,Z$, with edges $uz\in F$ and $\sigma(u)z\in J$,
is $(\omega,ph)$-super-regular, the graph
\[
T_\sigma:\quad vz\in E(T_\sigma)\Longleftrightarrow
v\in V,\ z\in Z,\ vz\in O,\quad
\forall u\in U\ (uv\in M\Rightarrow\sigma(u)z\in H),
\]
symmetrized as a simple graph, contains a spanning
$(e,ph)$-super-regular graph on $V,Z$.
\end{lemma}

        _ = (d + ε') * m := (add_mul _ _ _).symm

theorem FutureExtraVertexStability :
    ∀ (m k : ℕ) (ε ε' d : ENNReal),
      1 ≤ m → ε < ε' → ε' ≤ 1 → d ≤ 1 →
      ε + (2 : ENNReal) / (m : ENNReal) ≤ ε' →
      ε + 1 / (ε' * (m : ENNReal)) ≤ ε' →
      ∀ {V : Type*} [DecidableEq V]
        (G T : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] [DecidableRel T.Adj]
        (L R : Finset V) (x : V),
        Disjoint L R → x ∉ L → x ∉ R → L.card = m →
        (R.card = m ∨ R.card = m + 1) →
        G ≤ T → k ≤ (R.filter fun y => T.Adj x y).card →
        (d - ε') * (R.card : ENNReal) ≤ k →
        (k : ENNReal) ≤ (d + ε') * (R.card : ENNReal) →
        SuperRegularPair G L R ε d →
        ∃ (N : Finset V) (G' : SimpleGraph V),
          N ⊆ R ∧ N.card = k ∧ N ⊆ (R.filter fun y => T.Adj x y) ∧ G' ≤ T ∧
          (∀ y ∈ R, G'.Adj x y ↔ y ∈ N) ∧
          (∀ u v, u ≠ x → v ≠ x → (G'.Adj u v ↔ G.Adj u v)) ∧
          @SuperRegularPair V _ G' (Classical.decRel _) (insert x L) R ε' d := by

FutureExtraVertexStability.tex_proof:
\begin{proof}
Choose a $k$-set $N\subseteq N_T(x)\cap R$. Define $G'$ by keeping $G$ away
from $x$ and giving $x$ exactly the neighbors $N$. Then $G'\subseteq T$.
The new degree of $x$ obeys the displayed bounds. Other left degrees do not
change, while a right degree stays fixed or increases by one. Comparing its
old normalization by $m$ with the new normalization by $m+1$, and allowing
the extra unit, costs at most $2/m$. Thus the first slack inequality proves
all degree clauses of \noderef{SuperRegularPair}.

For regularity take $U\subseteq L\cup\{x\}$ and $W\subseteq R$ above the
$\varepsilon'$ thresholds. If $x\notin U$, old regularity applies. If
$x\in U$, put $U_0=U\setminus\{x\}$. From
$|U|>\varepsilon'(m+1)$ and $1/m\leq\varepsilon'-\varepsilon$ we get
$|U_0|>\varepsilon m$; also $|W|>\varepsilon|R|$. Old regularity controls
$G[U_0,W]$. Adding one row changes the density by at most
$1/|U|<1/(\varepsilon'm)$, which the second slack inequality absorbs.
Thus all tested densities lie in $[d-\varepsilon',d+\varepsilon']$.
Together with the degree calculation this proves the result.
\end{proof}
FutureExtraVertexStability.tex_statement:
\begin{lemma}[Adjoining one exceptional row to a near-equal super-regular pair]
Let $m\geq1$, let $L$ and $R$ be disjoint sets with $|L|=m$ and
$|R|\in\{m,m+1\}$, and let $x\notin L\cup R$. Suppose $(L,R)$ is
$(\varepsilon,d)$-super-regular in a graph $G$ and $G\subseteq T$. Fix an
integer $k$ not exceeding $|N_T(x)\cap R|$ and satisfying
\[
 (d-\varepsilon')|R|\leq k\leq(d+\varepsilon')|R|,
 \quad \varepsilon+2/m\leq\varepsilon',\quad
 \varepsilon+1/(\varepsilon'm)\leq\varepsilon',
\]
where $\varepsilon<\varepsilon'\leq1$ and $d\leq1$. Then there are a $k$-set
$N\subseteq N_T(x)\cap R$ and a graph $G'\subseteq T$ such that $x$ has
precisely the neighbors $N$ in $R$, every edge not incident with $x$ is the
same in $G'$ as in $G$, and $(L\cup\{x\},R)$ is
$(\varepsilon',d)$-super-regular in $G'$.
\end{lemma}
FutureExtraVertexStability.title: FutureExtraVertexStability

GreedyPartialEmbedding.lean_proof:
raw_bound : ∀ x, x ∉ S →
    d * (d - ε) ^ (S.filter fun y => H.Adj x y).card * n ≤
      (RawCandidates B A S toFun x).card
GreedyPartialEmbedding.lean_statement:
structure GreedyPartialEmbedding {r : ℕ} {VH VG : Type*} [Fintype VH] [Fintype VG]
    {H : SimpleGraph VH} {G : SimpleGraph VG} {R : SimpleGraph (Fin r)}
    [DecidableRel H.Adj]
    (B : BlowUpInstance r VH VG H G R) (A : CandidacySystem B)
    (d ε : ENNReal) (n : ℕ) (S : Finset VH)
    extends PartialCompatibleEmbedding B A S where
GreedyPartialEmbedding.name: GreedyPartialEmbedding
GreedyPartialEmbedding.tex_statement:
\begin{definition}[Greedy partial-embedding state]
A greedy state on $S$ is a partial compatible embedding as in
\noderef{PartialCompatibleEmbedding}, represented by a total map $f$,
with the additional invariant
\[
 d(d-\varepsilon)_+^{|S\cap N_H(x)|}n\leq |D_S^f(x)|
                  \qquad\text{for every }x\notin S.
\]
The sets $D_S^f(x)$ are those of \noderef{RawCandidates}; occupied
images are not removed in this invariant. The exponent is the actual
number of embedded neighbors, and subtraction is truncated subtraction
of extended nonnegative reals. Values of the total map outside $S$
are not otherwise constrained.
\end{definition}
GreedyPartialEmbedding.title: GreedyPartialEmbedding

GreedyPartialEmbeddingReserve.lean_proof:
classical
  intro x hx
  let W := RawCandidates B A S f.toFun x
  let O := (S.filter fun y => B.sourceCluster y = B.sourceCluster x).image f.toFun
  have memraw (v : VG) : v ∈ W ↔
      A.allowed x v ∧ ∀ y ∈ S, H.Adj x y → G.Adj v (f.toFun y) := by
    simp [W, RawCandidates]
  have hk : (S.filter fun y => H.Adj x y).card ≤ Δ := by
    apply le_trans _ ((H.degree_le_maxDegree x).trans hdeg)
    change (S.filter fun y => H.Adj x y).card ≤ (H.neighborFinset x).card
    apply Finset.card_le_card
    intro y hy
    exact (H.mem_neighborFinset x y).mpr (Finset.mem_filter.mp hy).2
  have hraw : a * n ≤ (W.card : ENNReal) := by
    calc
      a * n ≤ d * (d - ε) ^ (S.filter fun y => H.Adj x y).card * n := by
        gcongr
        exact hpower _ hk
      _ ≤ (W.card : ENNReal) := f.raw_bound x hx
  have hOcard : O.card ≤ Fintype.card {y : VH // B.sourceCluster y = B.sourceCluster x} := by
    apply (Finset.card_image_le).trans
    rw [Fintype.card_subtype]
    apply Finset.card_le_card
    intro y hy
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hy).2⟩
  have hO : (O.card : ENNReal) ≤ a / 2 * n := by
    calc
      (O.card : ENNReal) ≤ Fintype.card {y : VH // B.sourceCluster y = B.sourceCluster x} :=
        by exact_mod_cast hOcard
      _ ≤ ε * Fintype.card {v : VG // B.hostCluster v = B.sourceCluster x} := hsmall _
      _ ≤ ε * ((1 + ε) * n) := by gcongr; exact hhost _
      _ = (ε * (1 + ε)) * n := (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ ≤ a / 2 * n := by gcongr
  have havail : {v : VG | (UpdatedCandidacy B A S f.toPartialCompatibleEmbedding).allowed x v} =
      (↑(W \ O) : Set VG) := by
    ext v
    change (x ∉ S ∧ v ∉ S.image f.toFun ∧ A.allowed x v ∧
        ∀ y ∈ S, H.Adj x y → G.Adj v (f.toFun y)) ↔ v ∈ W \ O
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨_, hv, ha, he⟩
      apply Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr
      refine ⟨(memraw v).mpr ⟨ha, he⟩, ?_⟩
      intro hvo
      obtain ⟨y, hy, hyv⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hvo
      exact hv (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨y, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hy).1, hyv⟩)
    · intro hv
      obtain ⟨hW, hO'⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hv
      have hW' : A.allowed x v ∧ ∀ y ∈ S, H.Adj x y → G.Adj v (f.toFun y) :=
        (memraw v).mp hW
      refine ⟨hx, ?_, hW'⟩
      intro hvs
      obtain ⟨y, hy, hyv⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hvs
      have hycluster : B.sourceCluster y = B.sourceCluster x := by
        calc
          B.sourceCluster y = B.hostCluster (f.toFun y) :=
            A.cluster_respecting (f.compatible y hy)
          _ = B.hostCluster v := congrArg B.hostCluster hyv
          _ = B.sourceCluster x := (A.cluster_respecting hW'.1).symm
      exact hO' (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨y, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hy, hycluster⟩, hyv⟩)
  rw [havail, Set.ncard_coe_finset]
  have hcount : (W.card : ENNReal) ≤ ((W \ O).card : ENNReal) + O.card := by
    exact_mod_cast (Finset.card_le_card_sdiff_add_card (s := W) (t := O))
  have hhalf : a / 2 * n ≤ (W.card : ENNReal) := by
    calc
      a / 2 * n ≤ a * n := by gcongr; exact ENNReal.half_le_self
      _ ≤ (W.card : ENNReal) := hraw
  have hhalftop : a / 2 * n ≠ ⊤ := ne_top_of_le_ne_top (by simp) hhalf
  have hsum : a / 2 * n + a / 2 * n ≤ ((W \ O).card : ENNReal) + a / 2 * n := by
    calc
      a / 2 * n + a / 2 * n = a * n := by rw [← add_mul, ENNReal.add_halves]
      _ ≤ (W.card : ENNReal) := hraw
      _ ≤ ((W \ O).card : ENNReal) + O.card := hcount
      _ ≤ ((W \ O).card : ENNReal) + a / 2 * n := by gcongr
  calc
    d' * n ≤ a / 2 * n := by gcongr
    _ ≤ ((W \ O).card : ENNReal) := ENNReal.le_of_add_le_add_right hhalftop hsum
GreedyPartialEmbeddingReserve.lean_statement:
theorem GreedyPartialEmbeddingReserve (Δ : ℕ) (d ε a d' : ENNReal) (n : ℕ)
    (hpower : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ Δ → a ≤ d * (d - ε) ^ k)
    (hloss : ε * (1 + ε) ≤ a / 2) (hd' : d' ≤ a / 2)
    {r : ℕ} {VH VG : Type*} [Fintype VH] [Fintype VG]
    [DecidableEq VH] [DecidableEq VG]
    {H : SimpleGraph VH} {G : SimpleGraph VG} [DecidableRel H.Adj]
    {R : SimpleGraph (Fin r)}
    (B : BlowUpInstance r VH VG H G R) (A : CandidacySystem B)
    (hdeg : H.maxDegree ≤ Δ)
    (hsmall : ∀ i, (Fintype.card {x : VH // B.sourceCluster x = i} : ENNReal) ≤
      ε * Fintype.card {v : VG // B.hostCluster v = i})
    (hhost : ∀ i, (Fintype.card {v : VG // B.hostCluster v = i} : ENNReal) ≤
      (1 + ε) * n)
    (S : Finset VH) (f : GreedyPartialEmbedding B A d ε n S) :
    ∀ x, x ∉ S → d' * n ≤ Set.ncard
      {v : VG | (UpdatedCandidacy B A S f.toPartialCompatibleEmbedding).allowed x v} := by
GreedyPartialEmbeddingReserve.name: GreedyPartialEmbeddingReserve
GreedyPartialEmbeddingReserve.tex_proof:
\begin{proof}
Fix $x\notin S$ and put $i=c(x)$. The exposure count is at most
$\Delta$, so \noderef{GreedyPartialEmbedding} and the power bound
give $an\leq|D_S^f(x)|$. The raw set lies in $V_i$ by
\noderef{RawCandidates} and \noderef{CandidacySystem}. By
\noderef{UpdatedCandidacy}, the available set is exactly
$D_S^f(x)\setminus f(S)$, or equivalently
$D_S^f(x)\setminus O_i$, where $O_i=f(S)\cap V_i$.
Compatibility and injectivity from \noderef{PartialCompatibleEmbedding}
give $|O_i|=|S\cap X_i|\leq\varepsilon|V_i|$.
The finite-set deletion inequality therefore gives
\[
 |D_S^f(x)\setminus O_i|+|O_i|\geq|D_S^f(x)|\geq an,
 \qquad |O_i|\leq\varepsilon(1+\varepsilon)n\leq(a/2)n.
\]
If $n=0$, the claimed bound is zero, so it holds without further
conditions. If $n>0$, the finite raw-set bound forces $a<\infty$.
The hypotheses then force $\varepsilon<\infty$ and $d'<\infty$.
Subtracting the occupied-set upper bound in ordinary finite real
arithmetic gives $|D_S^f(x)\setminus O_i|\geq(a/2)n\geq d'n$.
The set cardinality in the conclusion is the same finite cardinality,
which proves the claim. No estimate uses $|S|$ or the number of clusters.
\end{proof}
GreedyPartialEmbeddingReserve.tex_statement:
\begin{lemma}[Clusterwise reserve of a greedy state]
Let $\Delta,n\in\mathbb N$ and $d,\varepsilon,a,d'$ be extended
nonnegative reals satisfying
$a\leq d(d-\varepsilon)_+^k$ for $k\leq\Delta$,
$\varepsilon(1+\varepsilon)\leq a/2$, and $d'\leq a/2$.
Let $B,A$ be a finite blow-up instance with candidacy system, with
$\Delta(H)\leq\Delta$, $|X_i|\leq\varepsilon|V_i|$, and
$|V_i|\leq(1+\varepsilon)n$ for every $i$.
For every greedy state $f$ on $S$ and every $x\notin S$, the updated
candidacy graph has at least $d'n$ candidates for $x$:
\[
 d'n\leq|\{v:(\operatorname{UpdatedCandidacy}(B,A,S,f))(x,v)\}|.
\]
\end{lemma}
GreedyPartialEmbeddingReserve.title: GreedyPartialEmbeddingReserve

GreedyPartialEmbeddingStep.lean_proof:
classical
  let V (i : Fin r) := Finset.univ.filter fun v => B.hostCluster v = i
  let W (x : VH) := RawCandidates B A S f.toFun x
  have memraw (x : VH) (v : VG) : v ∈ W x ↔
      A.allowed x v ∧ ∀ y ∈ S, H.Adj x y → G.Adj v (f.toFun y) := by
    simp [W, RawCandidates]
  have hVcard (i : Fin r) : (V i).card =
      Fintype.card {v : VG // B.hostCluster v = i} := by
    simp [V, Fintype.card_subtype]
  have hWsub (x : VH) : W x ⊆ V (B.sourceCluster x) := by
    intro v hv
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _,
      (A.cluster_respecting ((memraw x v).mp hv).1).symm⟩
  have hk (x : VH) : (S.filter fun y => H.Adj x y).card ≤ Δ := by
    apply le_trans _ ((H.degree_le_maxDegree x).trans hdeg)
    change (S.filter fun y => H.Adj x y).card ≤ (H.neighborFinset x).card
    apply Finset.card_le_card
    intro y hy
    exact (H.mem_neighborFinset x y).mpr (Finset.mem_filter.mp hy).2
  have hraw (x : VH) (hx : x ∉ S) : a * n ≤ ((W x).card : ENNReal) := by
    exact (mul_le_mul_left (hpower _ (hk x)) (n : ENNReal)).trans (f.raw_bound x hx)
  have hn0 : (n : ENNReal) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hn.ne'
  have han : a * n ≠ ⊤ := ne_top_of_le_ne_top (by simp) (hraw z hz)
  have hatop : a ≠ ⊤ := (ENNReal.lt_top_of_mul_ne_top_left han hn0).ne
  let U := (H.neighborFinset z) \ S
  let E (w : VH) := (V (B.sourceCluster z)).filter fun v =>
    (((W w).filter fun u => G.Adj v u).card : ENNReal) < (d - ε) * (W w).card
  have hUcard : U.card ≤ Δ :=
    (Finset.card_le_card (Finset.sdiff_subset : U ⊆ H.neighborFinset z)).trans
      ((H.degree_le_maxDegree z).trans hdeg)
  have hEcard (w : VH) (hw : w ∈ U) :
      ((E w).card : ENNReal) ≤ ε * (V (B.sourceCluster z)).card := by
    obtain ⟨hzw, hwS⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hw
    have hzw' := (H.mem_neighborFinset z w).mp hzw
    apply LowerRegularBadRows G (V (B.sourceCluster z))
      (V (B.sourceCluster w)) (W w) ε d
      (hreg (B.reduced_support hzw')) (hWsub w)
    calc
      ε * (V (B.sourceCluster w)).card ≤ ε * ((1 + ε) * n) := by
        rw [hVcard]
        exact mul_le_mul_right (hhost _) ε
      _ = (ε * (1 + ε)) * n := (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ < a * n := by
        simpa only [mul_comm] using ENNReal.mul_lt_mul_right hn0 (by simp) hthreshold
      _ ≤ ((W w).card : ENNReal) := hraw w hwS
  let O := (S.filter fun y => B.sourceCluster y = B.sourceCluster z).image f.toFun
  have hOcard : O.card ≤ Fintype.card {y : VH // B.sourceCluster y = B.sourceCluster z} := by
    apply (Finset.card_image_le).trans
    rw [Fintype.card_subtype]
    apply Finset.card_le_card
    intro y hy
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hy).2⟩
  have hO : (O.card : ENNReal) ≤ ε * (V (B.sourceCluster z)).card := by
    rw [hVcard]
    have hOcard' : (O.card : ENNReal) ≤ Fintype.card {y : VH // B.sourceCluster y = B.sourceCluster z} :=
      by exact_mod_cast hOcard
    exact hOcard'.trans (hsmall _)
  let F := O ∪ U.biUnion E
  have hF : (F.card : ENNReal) ≤ a / 2 * n := by
    calc
      (F.card : ENNReal) ≤ (O.card : ENNReal) + (U.biUnion E).card := by
        exact_mod_cast (Finset.card_union_le O (U.biUnion E))
      _ ≤ ε * (V (B.sourceCluster z)).card + ∑ w ∈ U, ((E w).card : ENNReal) := by
        apply add_le_add hO
        exact_mod_cast (Finset.card_biUnion_le (s := U) (t := E))
      _ ≤ ε * (V (B.sourceCluster z)).card +
          ∑ _w ∈ U, ε * (V (B.sourceCluster z)).card := by
        exact add_le_add le_rfl (Finset.sum_le_sum hEcard)
      _ = ((U.card : ENNReal) + 1) * ε * (V (B.sourceCluster z)).card := by
        simp only [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
        simp only [add_mul, one_mul]
        simp only [mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, add_comm]
      _ ≤ (Δ + 1 : ENNReal) * ε * (V (B.sourceCluster z)).card := by
        gcongr
      _ ≤ (Δ + 1 : ENNReal) * ε * ((1 + ε) * n) := by
        rw [hVcard]
        exact mul_le_mul_right (hhost _) _
      _ = ((Δ + 1 : ENNReal) * ε * (1 + ε)) * n := (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ ≤ a / 2 * n := mul_le_mul_left hloss _
  let L := W z \ F
  have hL : a / 2 * n ≤ (L.card : ENNReal) := by
    have hcount : ((W z).card : ENNReal) ≤ (L.card : ENNReal) + F.card := by
      exact_mod_cast (Finset.card_le_card_sdiff_add_card (s := W z) (t := F))
    have hhalftop : a / 2 * n ≠ ⊤ :=
      ENNReal.mul_ne_top (ENNReal.div_ne_top hatop (by norm_num)) (by simp)
    apply ENNReal.le_of_add_le_add_right hhalftop
    calc
      a / 2 * n + a / 2 * n = a * n := by rw [← add_mul, ENNReal.add_halves]
      _ ≤ ((W z).card : ENNReal) := hraw z hz
      _ ≤ (L.card : ENNReal) + F.card := hcount
      _ ≤ (L.card : ENNReal) + a / 2 * n := add_le_add le_rfl hF
  have hLpos : (0 : ENNReal) < L.card :=
    (ENNReal.mul_pos (ENNReal.half_pos ha.ne').ne' hn0).trans_le hL
  refine ⟨L, Finset.card_pos.mp (by exact_mod_cast hLpos), hL, ?_⟩
  intro v hv
  obtain ⟨hvr, hvF⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hv
  obtain ⟨hvA, hvadj⟩ := (memraw z v).mp hvr
  have hvO : v ∉ O := fun h => hvF (Finset.mem_union_left _ h)
  have hvE (w : VH) (hw : w ∈ U) : v ∉ E w := by
    intro h
    exact hvF (Finset.mem_union_right _ (Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨w, hw, h⟩))
  have hvnew : ∀ y ∈ S, f.toFun y ≠ v := by
    intro y hy heq
    have hycluster : B.sourceCluster y = B.sourceCluster z := by
      calc
        B.sourceCluster y = B.hostCluster (f.toFun y) :=
          A.cluster_respecting (f.compatible y hy)
        _ = B.hostCluster v := congrArg B.hostCluster heq
        _ = B.sourceCluster z := (A.cluster_respecting hvA).symm
    exact hvO (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨y, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hy, hycluster⟩, heq⟩)
  have hupdate (y : VH) (hy : y ∈ S) : Function.update f.toFun z v y = f.toFun y := by
    exact Function.update_of_ne (ne_of_mem_of_not_mem hy hz) v f.toFun
  let g : GreedyPartialEmbedding B A d ε n (insert z S) :=
    { toFun := Function.update f.toFun z v
      injOn := by
        intro x hx y hy heq
        by_cases hxz : x = z
        · subst x
          by_cases hyz : y = z
          · exact hyz.symm
          · have hyS := (Finset.mem_insert.mp hy).resolve_left hyz
            have h : v = f.toFun y := by simpa only [Function.update_self, hupdate y hyS] using heq
            exact (hvnew y hyS h.symm).elim
        · have hxS := (Finset.mem_insert.mp hx).resolve_left hxz
          by_cases hyz : y = z
          · subst y
            have h : f.toFun x = v := by simpa only [Function.update_self, hupdate x hxS] using heq
            exact (hvnew x hxS h).elim
          · have hyS := (Finset.mem_insert.mp hy).resolve_left hyz
            exact f.injOn hxS hyS (by simpa only [hupdate x hxS, hupdate y hyS] using heq)
      map_adj := by
        intro x y hx hy hxy
        by_cases hxz : x = z
        · subst x
          have hyz : y ≠ z := hxy.ne.symm
          have hyS := (Finset.mem_insert.mp hy).resolve_left hyz
          simpa only [Function.update_self, hupdate y hyS] using hvadj y hyS hxy
        · have hxS := (Finset.mem_insert.mp hx).resolve_left hxz
          by_cases hyz : y = z
          · subst y
            simpa only [Function.update_self, hupdate x hxS] using (hvadj x hxS hxy.symm).symm
          · have hyS := (Finset.mem_insert.mp hy).resolve_left hyz
            simpa only [hupdate x hxS, hupdate y hyS] using f.map_adj hxS hyS hxy
      compatible := by
        intro x hx
        rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hx with rfl | hx
        · simpa only [Function.update_self] using hvA
        · simpa only [hupdate x hx] using f.compatible x hx
      raw_bound := by
        intro x hx
        have hxS : x ∉ S := fun h => hx (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem h)
        by_cases hxz : H.Adj x z
        · have hxU : x ∈ U := Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr
            ⟨(H.mem_neighborFinset z x).mpr hxz.symm, hxS⟩
          have hgood : (d - ε) * (W x).card ≤
              (((W x).filter fun u => G.Adj v u).card : ENNReal) := by
            apply le_of_not_gt
            intro hbad
            exact hvE x hxU (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hWsub z hvr, hbad⟩)
          have hrawupdate : RawCandidates B A (insert z S) (Function.update f.toFun z v) x =
              (W x).filter fun u => G.Adj v u := by
            ext u
            simp only [RawCandidates, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
            constructor
            · rintro ⟨huA, huadj⟩
              refine ⟨(memraw x u).mpr ⟨huA, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
              · intro y hy hxy
                simpa only [hupdate y hy] using huadj y (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hy) hxy
              · simpa only [Function.update_self] using
                  (huadj z (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _) hxz).symm
            · rintro ⟨hur, huv⟩
              obtain ⟨huA, huadj⟩ := (memraw x u).mp hur
              refine ⟨huA, ?_⟩
              intro y hy hxy
              rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hy with rfl | hy
              · simpa only [Function.update_self] using huv.symm
              · simpa only [hupdate y hy] using huadj y hy hxy
          have hcount : ((insert z S).filter fun y => H.Adj x y).card =
              (S.filter fun y => H.Adj x y).card + 1 := by
            rw [Finset.filter_insert, if_pos hxz, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem]
            exact fun h => hz (Finset.mem_filter.mp h).1
          rw [hrawupdate, hcount, pow_succ]
          calc
            d * ((d - ε) ^ (S.filter fun y => H.Adj x y).card * (d - ε)) * n =
                (d - ε) * (d * (d - ε) ^ (S.filter fun y => H.Adj x y).card * n) := by ac_rfl
            _ ≤ (d - ε) * (W x).card := mul_le_mul_right (f.raw_bound x hxS) _
            _ ≤ _ := hgood
        · have hrawupdate : RawCandidates B A (insert z S) (Function.update f.toFun z v) x = W x := by
            ext u
            simp only [RawCandidates, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
            constructor
            · rintro ⟨huA, huadj⟩
              refine (memraw x u).mpr ⟨huA, ?_⟩
              intro y hy hxy
              simpa only [hupdate y hy] using huadj y (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hy) hxy
            · intro hur
              obtain ⟨huA, huadj⟩ := (memraw x u).mp hur
              refine ⟨huA, ?_⟩
              intro y hy hxy
              rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hy with rfl | hy
              · exact (hxz hxy).elim
              · simpa only [hupdate y hy] using huadj y hy hxy
          have hcount : (insert z S).filter (fun y => H.Adj x y) =
              S.filter (fun y => H.Adj x y) := by
            rw [Finset.filter_insert, if_neg hxz]
          rw [hrawupdate, hcount]
          exact f.raw_bound x hxS }
  exact ⟨g, rfl⟩

theorem GreedyPartialEmbeddingStep (Δ : ℕ) (d ε a : ENNReal) (n : ℕ)
    (hn : 0 < n) (ha : 0 < a)
    (hpower : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ Δ → a ≤ d * (d - ε) ^ k)
    (hthreshold : ε * (1 + ε) < a)
    (hloss : (Δ + 1 : ENNReal) * ε * (1 + ε) ≤ a / 2)
    {r : ℕ} {VH VG : Type*} [Fintype VH] [Fintype VG]
    [DecidableEq VH] [DecidableEq VG]
    {H : SimpleGraph VH} {G : SimpleGraph VG}
    [DecidableRel H.Adj] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {R : SimpleGraph (Fin r)}
    (B : BlowUpInstance r VH VG H G R) (A : CandidacySystem B)
    (hreg : InstanceLowerRegular B ε d) (hdeg : H.maxDegree ≤ Δ)
    (hsmall : ∀ i, (Fintype.card {x : VH // B.sourceCluster x = i} : ENNReal) ≤
      ε * Fintype.card {v : VG // B.hostCluster v = i})
    (hhost : ∀ i, (Fintype.card {v : VG // B.hostCluster v = i} : ENNReal) ≤
      (1 + ε) * n)
    (S : Finset VH) (f : GreedyPartialEmbedding B A d ε n S)
    (z : VH) (hz : z ∉ S) :
    ∃ L : Finset VG, L.Nonempty ∧ a / 2 * n ≤ (L.card : ENNReal) ∧
      ∀ v ∈ L, ∃ g : GreedyPartialEmbedding B A d ε n (insert z S),
        g.toFun = Function.update f.toFun z v := by
GreedyPartialEmbeddingStep.name: GreedyPartialEmbeddingStep
GreedyPartialEmbeddingStep.tex_proof:
\begin{proof}
Write $b=(d-\varepsilon)_+$ and $i=c(z)$. The exposure count
$k_S(x)=|S\cap N_H(x)|$ is at most $\Delta$. Hence
\noderef{GreedyPartialEmbedding} and the power hypothesis give
$|D_S^f(x)|\geq an$ for every $x\notin S$. By
\noderef{RawCandidates} and \noderef{CandidacySystem}, this set lies
in $V_{c(x)}$.
For each unembedded neighbor $w$ of $z$, put $j=c(w)$ and
\[
 E_w=\{v\in V_i:|N_G(v)\cap D_S^f(w)|<b|D_S^f(w)|\}.
\]
We have $|D_S^f(w)|\geq an>\varepsilon(1+\varepsilon)n
\geq\varepsilon|V_j|$. The strict inequality follows by multiplying
the strict threshold hypothesis by the positive finite integer $n$.
The edge $zw$ gives $R(i,j)$ by \noderef{BlowUpInstance}.
Thus \noderef{InstanceLowerRegular} supplies the lower-regular pair
$(V_i,V_j)$, and \noderef{LowerRegularBadRows} gives
$|E_w|\leq\varepsilon|V_i|$. This uses only lower regularity.

Let $O_i=f(S)\cap V_i$. On $S$ the map is injective and compatible
by \noderef{PartialCompatibleEmbedding}. Cluster respect implies
that an image lies in $V_i$ exactly when its source lies in $X_i$.
Thus $|O_i|=|S\cap X_i|\leq|X_i|\leq\varepsilon|V_i|$.
Define
\[
 L=D_S^f(z)\setminus\left(O_i\cup
                      \bigcup_{w\in N_H(z)\setminus S}E_w\right).
\]
There are at most $\Delta$ bad sets. Subtracting the size of a union
of forbidden sets from the size of $D_S^f(z)$ gives
\[
 |L|\geq an-(\Delta+1)\varepsilon|V_i|
 \geq an-(\Delta+1)\varepsilon(1+\varepsilon)n\geq(a/2)n.
\]
All quantities subtracted here are finite. Indeed, if $a$ were infinite,
$an\leq|D_S^f(z)|$ would contradict finiteness of this raw set.
If $\varepsilon$ were infinite, the strict threshold hypothesis would
fail. The loss inequality is therefore ordinary subtraction of finite
nonnegative real quantities. Since $a>0$ and $n>0$, the last lower
bound is positive and $L$ is nonempty.

Fix $v\in L$ and replace the value at $z$ by $v$. Raw membership
gives $A(z,v)$ and every required edge to an embedded neighbor of $z$.
It also places $v$ in $V_i$. Because $v\notin O_i$, it is outside
$f(S)$: any image equal to $v$ necessarily lies in $V_i$. Thus the
updated map is injective on $S\cup\{z\}$, remains compatible, and
preserves all edges of the induced source graph. Values on $S$ did
not change. For each remaining vertex $w$ adjacent to $z$, its new
raw set is exactly $D_S^f(w)\cap N_G(v)$ and its new exposure count
is $k_S(w)+1$. Because $v\notin E_w$, its size is at least
\[
 b|D_S^f(w)|\geq d b^{k_S(w)+1}n.
\]
Multiplication is monotone in the extended nonnegative reals, including
zero endpoints. A remaining vertex not adjacent to $z$ has exactly
the same raw set and exposure count as before. Hence the invariant
holds for every remaining vertex, not just vertices of a prescribed
future embedded set. Together with partial compatibility this is
precisely the required greedy state.
\end{proof}
GreedyPartialEmbeddingStep.tex_statement:
\begin{lemma}[One-vertex greedy extension]
Let $\Delta,n$ be natural numbers with $n>0$, and let $d,\varepsilon,a$
be extended nonnegative reals satisfying
\[
 0<a,\quad a\leq d(d-\varepsilon)_+^k\ (k\leq\Delta),\quad
 \varepsilon(1+\varepsilon)<a,\quad
 (\Delta+1)\varepsilon(1+\varepsilon)\leq a/2.
\]
Let $B,A$ be a finite blow-up instance with candidacy system, whose
host is lower-$(\varepsilon,d)$-regular, with
$\Delta(H)\leq\Delta$, $|X_i|\leq\varepsilon|V_i|$, and
$|V_i|\leq(1+\varepsilon)n$ for every $i$. For every greedy state
$f$ on $S$ and every $z\notin S$, there is a nonempty finite set $L$
of at least $(a/2)n$ possible images such that each $v\in L$ gives a
greedy state on $S\cup\{z\}$ whose total map is exactly $f$ with its
value at $z$ replaced by $v$. Greedy states are those of
\noderef{GreedyPartialEmbedding}.
\end{lemma}
GreedyPartialEmbeddingStep.title: GreedyPartialEmbeddingStep

HostExceptionalCorrection.lean_proof:
classical
  by_cases htrivial : d ≤ 2 * ε
  · refine ⟨f, hf, hcapacity, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro p
      simp
    · intro v
      simp [tsub_eq_zero_of_le htrivial]
  have hkpos : 0 < k := by omega
  have hmpos : 0 < n / k := Nat.div_pos (by omega) hkpos
  have hεfinite : ε ≠ ⊤ := ne_top_of_lt hεsmall
  have htwo : ε ≤ 2 * ε := by
    simpa using mul_le_mul_left (show (1 : ENNReal) ≤ 2 by norm_num) ε
  -- The floor estimate leaves room for the union of all exceptional sets.
  have hroom : (k : ENNReal) * ε * n < (n / k : ℕ) := by
    have hkR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hk
    have hmR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (n / k : ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast hmpos
    have hfloor : (n : ℝ) < (k : ℝ) * ((n / k : ℕ) + 1) := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_mul_div_succ n hkpos
    have heR : ε.toReal < 1 / (8 * (k : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
      have h := (ENNReal.toReal_lt_toReal hεfinite
        (by finiteness : 1 / (8 * (k : ENNReal) ^ 2) ≠ ⊤)).mpr hεsmall
      simpa using h
    have heprod : ε.toReal * (8 * (k : ℝ) ^ 2) < 1 :=
      (lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity)).mp heR
    have hnk : (n : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (k : ℝ) * (n / k : ℕ) := by nlinarith
    have hmain : (k : ℝ) * ε.toReal * n < (n / k : ℕ) := by
      have hscaled := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hnk
        (show 0 ≤ (k : ℝ) * ε.toReal by positivity)
      have hscaled' := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right heprod
        (show 0 < (n / k : ℕ) / (4 : ℝ) by positivity)
      nlinarith [ENNReal.toReal_nonneg (a := ε)]
    apply (ENNReal.toReal_lt_toReal (by finiteness) (by simp)).mp
    simpa using hmain
  let X (p : Fin r × Fin k) := Finset.univ.filter fun x => σ x = p
  let S (i : Fin r) := Finset.univ.filter fun x => B.sourceCluster x = i
  let V (i : Fin r) := Finset.univ.filter fun v => B.hostCluster v = i
  have hXmin (p : Fin r × Fin k) : n / k ≤ (X p).card := by
    rcases hsize p with h | h <;> change n / k ≤
      (Finset.univ.filter fun x => σ x = p).card <;> omega
  have hlarge (p : Fin r × Fin k) : ε * n < (X p).card := by
    calc
      ε * n = 1 * ε * n := by simp
      _ ≤ (k : ENNReal) * ε * n :=
        mul_le_mul_left (mul_le_mul_left
          (show (1 : ENNReal) ≤ k by exact_mod_cast hk) ε) n
      _ < (n / k : ℕ) := hroom
      _ ≤ (X p).card := by exact_mod_cast hXmin p
  let C : SimpleGraph (VH ⊕ VG) := SimpleGraph.fromRel fun p q =>
    ∃ x : VH, ∃ v : VG, p = Sum.inl x ∧ q = Sum.inr v ∧ A.allowed x v
  letI : DecidableRel C.Adj := Classical.decRel _
  let left (T : Finset VH) : Finset (VH ⊕ VG) := T.map Function.Embedding.inl
  let right (T : Finset VG) : Finset (VH ⊕ VG) := T.map Function.Embedding.inr
  have hadj (x : VH) (v : VG) : C.Adj (Sum.inl x) (Sum.inr v) ↔ A.allowed x v := by
    simp [C, SimpleGraph.fromRel_adj]
  have hadj' (v : VG) (x : VH) : C.Adj (Sum.inr v) (Sum.inl x) ↔ A.allowed x v := by
    rw [C.adj_comm, hadj]
  have hleft (T : Finset VH) (v : VG) :
      ((left T).filter fun z => C.Adj z (Sum.inr v)).card =
        (T.filter fun x => A.allowed x v).card := by
    simp only [left, Finset.filter_map, Finset.card_map, Function.comp_def,
      Function.Embedding.inl_apply, hadj]
  have hleft' (T : Finset VH) (v : VG) :
      ((left T).filter fun z => C.Adj (Sum.inr v) z).card =
        (T.filter fun x => A.allowed x v).card := by
    simp only [left, Finset.filter_map, Finset.card_map, Function.comp_def,
      Function.Embedding.inl_apply, hadj']
  have hpair (i : Fin r) : LowerSuperRegularPair C (left (S i)) (right (V i)) ε d := by
    have hl : left (S i) = Finset.univ.filter (fun z : VH ⊕ VG =>
        ∃ x : VH, z = Sum.inl x ∧ B.sourceCluster x = i) := by
      ext z
      cases z <;> simp [left, S]
    have hr : right (V i) = Finset.univ.filter (fun z : VH ⊕ VG =>
        ∃ v : VG, z = Sum.inr v ∧ B.hostCluster v = i) := by
      ext z
      cases z <;> simp [right, V]
    rw [hl, hr]
    exact hcand i
  have hXsub (i : Fin r) (j : Fin k) : X (i, j) ⊆ S i := by
    intro x hx
    have h := congrArg Prod.fst (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2
    simpa [S, hσ] using h
  -- Only the lower density test is used; no full-regularity tail lemma is needed.
  have honeSided : ∀ (L Q T : Finset (VH ⊕ VG)),
      LowerRegularPair C L Q ε d → T ⊆ L → ε * L.card < T.card →
      (((Q.filter fun v => ((T.filter fun x => C.Adj v x).card : ENNReal) <
        (d - 2 * ε) * T.card).card : ENNReal)) ≤ ε * Q.card := by
    intro L Q T hreg hTL hTsize
    let W := Q.filter fun v => ((T.filter fun x => C.Adj v x).card : ENNReal) <
      (d - 2 * ε) * T.card

    by_contra hbound
    have hWsize : ε * Q.card < W.card := lt_of_not_ge hbound
    have hWzero : (W.card : ENNReal) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt ((zero_le _).trans_lt hWsize)
    have hTzero : (T.card : ENNReal) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt ((zero_le _).trans_lt hTsize)
    have hWnonempty : W.Nonempty := Finset.card_pos.mp (by exact_mod_cast
      ((zero_le _).trans_lt hWsize : (0 : ENNReal) < W.card))
    have hsum : (∑ v ∈ W, ((T.filter fun x => C.Adj v x).card : ENNReal)) <
        ∑ _v ∈ W, (d - 2 * ε) * T.card := by
      apply ENNReal.sum_lt_sum_of_nonempty hWnonempty
      intro v hv
      exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hv).2
    have htranspose : ((T.product W).filter fun p => C.Adj p.1 p.2).card =
        ((W.product T).filter fun p => C.Adj p.1 p.2).card := by
      apply Finset.card_bij (fun p _ => (p.2, p.1))
      · intro p hp
        rcases Finset.mem_filter.mp hp with ⟨hp, ha⟩
        rcases Finset.mem_product.mp hp with ⟨hx, hv⟩
        exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨hv, hx⟩, ha.symm⟩
      · intro p _ q _ h
        exact Prod.ext (congrArg Prod.snd h) (congrArg Prod.fst h)
      · intro p hp
        rcases Finset.mem_filter.mp hp with ⟨hp, ha⟩
        rcases Finset.mem_product.mp hp with ⟨hv, hx⟩
        exact ⟨(p.2, p.1), Finset.mem_filter.mpr
          ⟨Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨hx, hv⟩, ha.symm⟩, rfl⟩

      unfold PairDensity
      apply (ENNReal.div_lt_iff (Or.inl (mul_ne_zero hTzero hWzero))
        (Or.inl (by finiteness))).mpr
      rw [htranspose, FilteredProductRowCount W T C.Adj]
      simpa only [Nat.cast_sum, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_assoc,
        mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using hsum
    exact (not_lt_of_ge (hreg T hTL W (Finset.filter_subset _ _) hTsize hWsize))

    have hbad := honeSided (left (S i)) (right (V i)) (left (X (i, j)))

    calc
      ((E i).card : ENNReal) ≤ ∑ j : Fin k, ((Ebin i j).card : ENNReal) := by
        exact_mod_cast (Finset.card_biUnion_le : (E i).card ≤ ∑ j : Fin k, (Ebin i j).card)

      _ = (k : ENNReal) * ε * n := by simp [mul_assoc]

      ∑ j : Fin k, ((X (i, j)).filter P).card = ((S i).filter P).card := by

      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, S, X]

      Finset.sum_card_fiberwise_eq_card_filter ((S i).filter P) Finset.univ

        (((X (i, j)).filter fun x => A.allowed x v).card : ENNReal) := by
    have hdegree := (hpair i).2.2 (Sum.inr v) (by simpa [right] using hv)
    rw [hleft] at hdegree

      simpa only [Finset.filter_true, show (S i).card = n from (hcard i).1] using

        (((X (i, j)).filter fun x => A.allowed x v).card : ENNReal) <

        simp only [V, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
        rw [Prod.ext_iff]
        simp only [hf]

      exact hcapacity (i, j)

      rw [holdcard]
      exact_mod_cast ((hEbound i).trans_lt (hroom.trans_le

    obtain ⟨g, _, hassign, hpreserve, hdiff⟩ :=
      CapacityPreservingReassignment (V i) (E i) (hES i) (fun v => (f v).2) b hroom'
    refine ⟨g, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro v hv
      rw [hassign v hv]
      exact hb v (hES i hv)
    · intro j
      exact (hpreserve j).trans (holdcard j)
    · intro j
      calc
        _ ≤ (2 : ENNReal) * (E i).card := by exact_mod_cast hdiff j
        _ ≤ 2 * ((k : ENNReal) * ε * n) := mul_le_mul_right (hEbound i) 2
        _ = 2 * k * ε * n := by ac_rfl
  choose g hgE hgcard hgdiff using hcorrect
  -- Global fibers are exactly the corrected fibers inside their original clusters.
  let f' : VG → Fin r × Fin k := fun v => (B.hostCluster v, g (B.hostCluster v) v)
  have hnew (i : Fin r) (j : Fin k) :
      (Finset.univ.filter fun v => f' v = (i, j)) = (V i).filter fun v => g i v = j := by
    ext v
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Prod.mk.injEq, f', V]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨h, hj⟩
      exact ⟨h, by simpa [h] using hj⟩
    · rintro ⟨h, hj⟩
      exact ⟨h, by simpa [h] using hj⟩
  have hold (i : Fin r) (j : Fin k) :
      (Finset.univ.filter fun v => f v = (i, j)) = (V i).filter fun v => (f v).2 = j := by
    ext v
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, V]
    rw [← hf v, Prod.ext_iff]
  refine ⟨f', fun v => rfl, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, j⟩
    rw [hnew]
    exact hgcard i j
  · rintro ⟨i, j⟩
    rw [hnew, hold]
    exact hgdiff i j
  · intro v
    simp only [← Finset.filter_filter]
    change (d - 2 * ε) * (X (B.hostCluster v, g (B.hostCluster v) v)).card ≤
      (((X (B.hostCluster v, g (B.hostCluster v) v)).filter fun x => A.allowed x v).card : ENNReal)
    by_cases hv : v ∈ E (B.hostCluster v)
    · exact (mul_le_mul_left (tsub_le_tsub_left htwo d) _).trans
          (hgE (B.hostCluster v) v hv)
    · apply le_of_not_gt
      intro hbad
      apply hv
      exact Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨g (B.hostCluster v) v, Finset.mem_univ _,
        Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨by simp [V], hbad⟩⟩
