  have hd₂lt : d₂ < d₁ ^ 2 / 2 :=
    ENNReal.half_lt_self hp.ne' (ne_top_of_le_ne_top (by simp) hpone)
  have hd₂one : d₂ ≤ 1 := ENNReal.half_le_self.trans hpone
  obtain ⟨ε₂, C', Nexec, hε₂, hε₂one, hC', hC'top, hNexec, hexec⟩ :=
    AuxiliarySpreadExecution d₂ (Delta ^ 3) hd₂ hd₂one
  obtain ⟨εred, hεred, _, hred⟩ := BlowUpReductionToAuxiliary Delta ε₂ d₂ d₁
    hDelta hε₂ hε₂one hd₂ hd₂lt hd₁one
  let ε₁ := min ε₀' εred
  have hε₁ : 0 < ε₁ := lt_min hε₀' hεred
  obtain ⟨ε₀, hε₀, hbal⟩ := hbal ε₁ hε₁ (min_le_left _ _)
  let η := min ε₀ (1 / 2)
  have hη : 0 < η := lt_min hε₀ (by norm_num)
  have hηhalf : η ≤ 1 / 2 := min_le_right _ _
  have hηone : η ≤ 1 := hηhalf.trans (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀, hC₀top, hbal⟩ := hbal η hη (min_le_left _ _)
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hCtop, hCC₀, hmargins⟩ :=
    BlowupOrderMargins η C₀ C' (Delta ^ 2) hη hηhalf hC₀ hC₀top hC'top
      (one_le_pow₀ hDelta)
  let ε := η * η
  have hε : 0 < ε := ENNReal.mul_pos hη.ne' hη.ne'
  have hεη : ε ≤ η := by
    simpa only [mul_one] using mul_le_mul_left' hηone η
  refine ⟨ε, C, hε, hεη.trans_lt (hηhalf.trans_lt (by norm_num)), hC, ?_⟩
  intro r
  obtain ⟨Nbal, hbal⟩ := hbal C hCC₀ r
  obtain ⟨Nred, hred⟩ := hred r
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hmargins Nbal Nred Nexec
  refine ⟨N, ?_⟩
  intro n hn VH VG _ _ _ _ H G _ _ R _ B A hH hR hhost hcand hsize
  letI : DecidableRel A.allowed := fun _ _ => Classical.propDecidable _
  obtain ⟨hnBal, hq, hmargins⟩ := hN n hn
  obtain ⟨Hp, hHp, Bp, Ap, hAp, hold, _, _, _, hhostmap, _, _,
    hEq, hmax, hpadhost, hpadcand, _, hunpad⟩ :=
    SourceClusterPadding B A ε η d hε le_rfl hηone hd1 hcand
  letI : DecidableRel Hp.Adj := hHp
  letI : DecidableRel Ap.allowed := hAp
  have hhη : InstanceLowerSuperRegular B η d := by
    intro i j hij
    obtain ⟨hreg, hl, hr⟩ := hhost hij
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro U hU T hT hsizeU hsizeT
      exact (tsub_le_tsub_left hεη d).trans (hreg U hU T hT
        ((mul_le_mul_right' hεη _).trans_lt hsizeU)
        ((mul_le_mul_right' hεη _).trans_lt hsizeT))
    · intro v hv
      exact (mul_le_mul_right' (tsub_le_tsub_left hεη d) _).trans (hl v hv)
    · intro v hv
      exact (mul_le_mul_right' (tsub_le_tsub_left hεη d) _).trans (hr v hv)
  have hsizep : ∀ i,
      (1 - η) * n ≤ Fintype.card {v : VG // Bp.hostCluster v = i} ∧
      (Fintype.card {v : VG // Bp.hostCluster v = i} : ENNReal) ≤ (1 + η) * n := by
    intro i
    have heq : Fintype.card {v : VG // Bp.hostCluster v = i} =
        Fintype.card {v : VG // B.hostCluster v = i} := by
      simp only [Fintype.card_subtype, hhostmap]
    rw [heq]
    exact ⟨(mul_le_mul_right' (tsub_le_tsub_left hεη 1) _).trans (hsize i).1,
      (hsize i).2.trans (mul_le_mul_right' (add_le_add le_rfl hεη) _)⟩
  obtain ⟨m, hmlo, hmhi, X, μ, hμ, hres⟩ := hbal n hnBal hq Bp Ap
    (hmax.trans hH) hR (hpadhost η hhη) hpadcand hEq hsizep
  obtain ⟨hmred, hmexec, hratio⟩ := hmargins m hmlo hmhi
  have hcomplete : ∃ ν : PMF {φ : SimpleGraph.Copy Hp G // CompatibleEmbedding Bp Ap φ},
      VertexSpreadOn (ν.map fun φ => fun x => φ.1 x) (C / n) Set.univ := by
    apply SupportedResidualComposition Bp Ap X μ (C / n) hμ
    intro f hf
    obtain ⟨Br, Ar, hsourcemap, hhostmapr, hallowed, hsizes, hsizev, hrhost, hrcand⟩ :=
      hres f hf
    let Y := {x : PaddedSource B // x ∉ X}
    let W := {v : VG // v ∉ X.image f.toFun}
    letI : DecidableRel Ar.allowed := fun _ _ => Classical.propDecidable _
    have hHr : (Hp.induce {x | x ∉ X}).maxDegree ≤ Delta := by
      let inc : SimpleGraph.Copy (Hp.induce {x | x ∉ X}) Hp := {
        toHom := { toFun := Subtype.val, map_rel' := fun h => h }
        injective' := Subtype.val_injective }
      exact inc.max_degree_le.trans (hmax.trans hH)
    have hrhost' : InstanceLowerSuperRegular Br εred d₁ := by
      intro i j hij
      obtain ⟨hreg, hl, hr⟩ := hrhost hij
      have hee : ε₁ ≤ εred := min_le_right _ _
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro U hU T hT hsizeU hsizeT
        exact (tsub_le_tsub_left hee d₁).trans (hreg U hU T hT
          ((mul_le_mul_right' hee _).trans_lt hsizeU)
          ((mul_le_mul_right' hee _).trans_lt hsizeT))
      · intro v hv
        exact (mul_le_mul_right' (tsub_le_tsub_left hee d₁) _).trans (hl v hv)
      · intro v hv
        exact (mul_le_mul_right' (tsub_le_tsub_left hee d₁) _).trans (hr v hv)
    have hrcand' : CandidacyLowerSuperRegular Br Ar εred d₁ := by
      intro i
      obtain ⟨hreg, hl, hr⟩ := hrcand i
      have hee : ε₁ ≤ εred := min_le_right _ _
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro U hU T hT hsizeU hsizeT
        exact (tsub_le_tsub_left hee d₁).trans (hreg U hU T hT
          ((mul_le_mul_right' hee _).trans_lt hsizeU)
          ((mul_le_mul_right' hee _).trans_lt hsizeT))
      · intro v hv
        exact (mul_le_mul_right' (tsub_le_tsub_left hee d₁) _).trans (hl v hv)
      · intro v hv
        exact (mul_le_mul_right' (tsub_le_tsub_left hee d₁) _).trans (hr v hv)
    have hcounts : ∀ i,
        (Finset.univ.filter fun x : Y => Br.sourceCluster x = i).card = m ∧
        (Finset.univ.filter fun v : W => Br.hostCluster v = i).card = m := by
      intro i
      simpa only [Fintype.card_subtype] using And.intro (hsizes i) (hsizev i)
    obtain ⟨H', G', R', hH', hG', hR', B', A', hHle, hGle, hAle,
      hsmap, hvmap, hparts, _, _, hRmax, hreg, hareg, hsat⟩ :=
      hred m hmred Br Ar hcounts hHr hR hrhost' hrcand'
    letI : DecidableRel H'.Adj := hH'
    letI : DecidableRel G'.Adj := hG'
    letI : DecidableRel R'.Adj := hR'
    have hRcomap : (R'.comap finProdFinEquiv.symm).maxDegree ≤ Delta ^ 3 := by
      let inc : SimpleGraph.Copy (R'.comap finProdFinEquiv.symm) R' := {
        toHom := { toFun := finProdFinEquiv.symm, map_rel' := fun h => h }
        injective' := finProdFinEquiv.symm.injective }
      exact inc.max_degree_le.trans hRmax
    have hpartcounts : ∀ j,
        ((Finset.univ.filter fun x : Y => B'.sourceCluster x = j).card = m / Delta ^ 2 ∨
         (Finset.univ.filter fun x : Y => B'.sourceCluster x = j).card = m / Delta ^ 2 + 1) ∧
        (Finset.univ.filter fun x : Y => B'.sourceCluster x = j).card =
          (Finset.univ.filter fun v : W => B'.hostCluster v = j).card := by
      intro j
      have hp := hparts (finProdFinEquiv.symm j)
      simpa only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply] using And.intro hp.2 hp.1
    have hsat' : ∀ ⦃i j⦄, (R'.comap finProdFinEquiv.symm).Adj i j →
        SaturatingSourcePair B' i j := by
      intro i j hij
      simpa only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply] using
        hsat (finProdFinEquiv.symm i) (finProdFinEquiv.symm j) hij
    obtain ⟨ν, hν⟩ := hexec (r * Delta ^ 2) (m / Delta ^ 2) hmexec B' A'
      hpartcounts hRcomap hreg hareg hsat'
    let F : {φ : SimpleGraph.Copy H' G' // CompatibleEmbedding B' A' φ} →
        {φ : SimpleGraph.Copy (Hp.induce {x | x ∉ X})
          (G.induce {v | v ∉ X.image f.toFun}) // CompatibleEmbedding Br Ar φ} := fun φ => by
      let g := RestrictReductionEmbedding Br Ar B' A' hHle hGle hAle hsmap hvmap φ.1 φ.2
      exact ⟨{
        toHom := {
          toFun := g.toFun
          map_rel' := fun h => g.map_adj (Finset.mem_univ _) (Finset.mem_univ _) h }
        injective' := fun _ _ h => g.injOn (Finset.mem_univ _) (Finset.mem_univ _) h },
        fun x => g.compatible x (Finset.mem_univ _)⟩
    refine ⟨Br, Ar, hsourcemap, hhostmapr, hallowed, ν.map F, ?_⟩
    have hspread : VertexSpreadOn ((ν.map F).map fun φ => fun x => φ.1 x)
        (C' / (m / Delta ^ 2 : ℕ)) Set.univ := by
      simpa only [PMF.map_comp, Function.comp_def, F, RestrictReductionEmbedding] using hν
    refine ⟨hq, ?_⟩
    intro s x y hx hy
    exact (hspread.2 s x y hx hy).trans (pow_le_pow_left' hratio s)
  obtain ⟨ν, hν⟩ := hcomplete
  exact hunpad (C / n) ν hν
SpreadBlowup.lean_statement:
theorem SpreadBlowup :
    ∀ (d : ENNReal) (Delta : ℕ), 0 < d → d ≤ 1 → 1 ≤ Delta →
      ∃ (epsilon C : ENNReal), 0 < epsilon ∧ epsilon < 1 ∧ 1 ≤ C ∧
      ∀ r : ℕ, ∃ n₀ : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, n₀ ≤ n →
      ∀ {VH VG : Type*} [Fintype VH] [Fintype VG]
        [DecidableEq VH] [DecidableEq VG]
        {H : SimpleGraph VH} {G : SimpleGraph VG}
        [DecidableRel H.Adj] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
        {R : SimpleGraph (Fin r)} [DecidableRel R.Adj]
        (B : BlowUpInstance r VH VG H G R) (A : CandidacySystem B),
        H.maxDegree ≤ Delta → R.maxDegree ≤ Delta →
        InstanceLowerSuperRegular B epsilon d →
        CandidacyLowerSuperRegular B A epsilon d →
        (∀ i, (1 - epsilon) * n ≤
            Fintype.card {v : VG // B.hostCluster v = i} ∧
          (Fintype.card {v : VG // B.hostCluster v = i} : ENNReal) ≤
            (1 + epsilon) * n) →
        ∃ μ : PMF {φ : SimpleGraph.Copy H G // CompatibleEmbedding B A φ},
          VertexSpreadOn (μ.map fun φ => fun x => φ.1 x) (C / n) Set.univ := by
SpreadBlowup.name: SpreadBlowup
SpreadBlowup.tex_proof:
\begin{proof}
Invoke \noderef{ClusterRebalancing} at $(\Delta,d)$ and let $d_1$ be its
positive density bound, so $0<d_1<d\leq1$. Use $d'=d_1$ in its next
quantifier to obtain a residual-error bound $\varepsilon'_0>0$.
Put $d_2=d_1^2/4$, so $0<d_2<d_1^2/2$ and $d_2\leq1$.
Apply \noderef{AuxiliarySpreadExecution} at $(d_2,\Delta^3)$ and choose
its input error $0<\varepsilon_2<1$, finite constant $C'\geq1$, and
uniform cutoff $N_{\rm exec}\geq1$. These precede the number of clusters.
Apply \noderef{BlowUpReductionToAuxiliary} with density $d_1$ and output
parameters $(\varepsilon_2,d_2)$, obtaining its admissible input error
$\varepsilon_{\rm red}>0$. Set
\[
 \varepsilon_1=\min\{\varepsilon'_0,\varepsilon_{\rm red}\}.
\]
The rebalancing statement at residual parameters $(\varepsilon_1,d_1)$
now gives an original-error bound $\varepsilon_0>0$. Set
$\eta=\min\{\varepsilon_0,1/2\}$ and use the statement at error $\eta$
to obtain $1\leq C_0<\infty$. Apply \noderef{BlowupOrderMargins} with
$(\eta,C_0,C',k)=(\eta,C_0,C',\Delta^2)$ and fix its finite $C\geq C_0,1$.
Finally put $\varepsilon=\eta^2$. Then
$0<\varepsilon\leq\eta\leq1/2<1$. All these choices depend only on
$d,\Delta$, not on $r$, the vertex types, or an instance.

After $r$ is given, let $N_{\rm bal}$ and $N_{\rm red}$ be the cutoffs
provided by rebalancing and reduction for the parameters just fixed.
Let $n_0$ be the cutoff from \noderef{BlowupOrderMargins} for these two
cutoffs and $N_{\rm exec}$. For every $n\geq n_0$ it gives
$n\geq N_{\rm bal}$ and $q=C/n\leq1$; if
$m\leq(1-\eta)n<m+1$ and $u=\lfloor m/\Delta^2\rfloor$, it gives
\[
 m\geq N_{\rm red},\qquad u\geq N_{\rm exec},\qquad C'/u\leq q.
\]

Fix an instance at such an $n$. Apply \noderef{SourceClusterPadding}
with input error $\varepsilon$ and transfer error $\eta$. This adds
isolated dummy source vertices with complete candidacy rows, leaving the
host and reduced graph unchanged, and returns a padded instance $B_p,A_p$
whose source and host clusters have equal sizes. Its source maximum degree
is at most $\Delta$ and its candidacy system is lower-$(\eta,d)$-super-regular.
Its host system is also lower-$(\eta,d)$-super-regular: increasing the
error from $\varepsilon$ to $\eta$ weakens the lower-regularity tests and
the degree bounds. More explicitly, from
\noderef{LowerRegularPair} any test above the $\eta$ thresholds is also
above the $\varepsilon$ thresholds, and $d-\eta\leq d-\varepsilon$.
Both degree bounds in \noderef{LowerSuperRegularPair} weaken for the
same reason. Apply this in \noderef{InstanceLowerSuperRegular} and then
the unchanged-host clause of the padding theorem. The original host-size
window implies the $\eta$ window since $\varepsilon\leq\eta$.

Apply \noderef{ClusterRebalancing} to the padded instance. Write $H_p$
for its source. It returns $m$ with the floor inequalities above, a fixed
$X\subseteq V(H_p)$, and a law $\mu$ on partial compatible embeddings
whose restrictions to $X$ are $q$-vertex-spread. For every $f$ with
$\mu(f)\ne0$, it supplies an instance $B_f,A_f$ on the literal complements
\[
 Y=V(H_p)\setminus X,\qquad W_f=V(G)\setminus f(X),
\]
with source $H_p[Y]$, host $G[W_f]$, reduced graph $R$, exact restricted
cluster maps, and candidacy relation equivalent to updated candidacy.
Every residual source and host cluster has size $m$, and both residual
systems are lower-$(\varepsilon_1,d_1)$-super-regular.

Fix this supported $f$. An induced subgraph has maximum degree at most
the original graph, so the residual source still has degree bound $\Delta$.
Increase the error from $\varepsilon_1$ to $\varepsilon_{\rm red}$ in
both residual systems. This is legitimate by the test/degree argument
above, applied also to the tagged candidacy graphs of
\noderef{CandidacyLowerSuperRegular}. Since $m\geq N_{\rm red}$, apply
\noderef{BlowUpReductionToAuxiliary}. It returns graphs $H',G',R'$,
instance $B'$, and candidacy $A'$ on the same residual vertex types, with
\[
 H_p[Y]\leq H',\qquad G'\leq G[W_f],\qquad A'\subseteq A_f.
\]
Their refined cluster maps project exactly to the residual maps. Source
and host fibers have equal sizes $u$ or $u+1$. The reduced graph has
maximum degree at most $\Delta^3$, the host and candidacy systems are
$(\varepsilon_2,d_2)$-super-regular, and every source pair at a reduced
edge is saturating. Relabel $[r]\times[\Delta^2]$ by $[r\Delta^2]$
using the product bijection. It preserves all these assertions: fibers
are literally the same after relabeling, adjacency is pulled back, and
the inverse bijection is a graph Copy, preserving the degree bound.

As $u\geq N_{\rm exec}$, \noderef{AuxiliarySpreadExecution} provides a
$(C'/u)$-vertex-spread law $\nu_f$ on compatible full Copies $H'\to G'$.
Apply \noderef{RestrictReductionEmbedding} to each sample. This gives a
partial compatible embedding of $B_f,A_f$ with full domain and the same
underlying map. Package it as a Copy $H_p[Y]\to G[W_f]$: injectivity
follows from full-domain injectivity, edges are preserved by source and
host containment, and original residual candidacy follows from
$A'\subseteq A_f$. All source and target values are unchanged. Hence
every cylinder probability is unchanged under this pushforward. Since
$C'/u\leq q\leq1$, its cylinder bound is at most $q^s$ for every $s$.
This is a $q$-vertex-spread residual full law for every supported $f$.

We have verified every hypothesis of \noderef{SupportedResidualComposition}:
the first-stage spread is on restrictions to $X$, the residual vertex
sets are the literal complements, their cluster maps are exactly the
restricted original maps, and their candidacy is equivalent to
\noderef{UpdatedCandidacy}. Apply it to obtain a $q$-vertex-spread law
on compatible full Copies $H_p\to G$. Its support-indexed cylinder
calculation neither identifies distinct total partial maps with the same
restriction nor assigns positive mass to impossible states. In particular
it preserves the full joint-spread bound, not merely singleton bounds.

Finally use the law-restriction clause of \noderef{SourceClusterPadding}
to remove the dummy source vertices. Restriction is a compatible full
Copy of the original source, and an original cylinder is exactly the
padded cylinder at its distinct original summand vertices. The resulting
law therefore has the same $q=C/n$ spread parameter. This is the claimed
law on the original instance.
\end{proof}
SpreadBlowup.tex_statement:
\begin{theorem}[Vertex-spread blow-up lemma]
For every real $0<d\leq1$ and integer $\Delta\geq1$, there are constants $0<\varepsilon<1$ and $C\geq1$, depending only on $d$ and $\Delta$, such that for every integer $r$ there is $n_0$ with the following property.  For every $n\geq n_0$, let
\[
 (H,G,R,(X_i)_{i\in[r]},(V_i)_{i\in[r]},(A^i)_{i\in[r]})
\]
be a lower-$(\varepsilon,d)$-super-regular blow-up instance with lower-$(\varepsilon,d)$-super-regular candidacy graphs.  If $\Delta(H),\Delta(R)\leq\Delta$ and
\[
 (1-\varepsilon)n\leq |V_i|\leq(1+\varepsilon)n
 \qquad(i\in[r]),
\]
then there is a probability distribution on compatible full embeddings $\phi:H\hookrightarrow G$ which is $(C/n)$-vertex-spread: for all distinct $x_1,\ldots,x_s\in V(H)$ and all $v_1,\ldots,v_s\in V(G)$,
\[
 \Pr[\phi(x_j)=v_j\text{ for every }j\in[s]]\leq(C/n)^s.
\]
\end{theorem}
SpreadBlowup.title: SpreadBlowup

SuperRegularCodegreeExceptionalBound.lean_proof:
classical
  intro V _ G _ U W n ε d hU hn hε hsr
  have hnzero : (n : ENNReal) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hεsub : ε < d - ε := by
    by_contra h
    have hd := tsub_le_iff_right.mp (le_of_not_gt h)
    rw [← two_mul] at hd
    exact (not_le_of_gt hε) hd
  have hεtwo : ε ≤ 2 * ε := by
    simpa only [one_mul] using (mul_le_mul_right' (by norm_num : (1 : ENNReal) ≤ 2) ε)
  have hsub : d - 2 * ε ≤ d - ε := tsub_le_tsub_left hεtwo d
  have hadd : d + ε ≤ d + 2 * ε := add_le_add_right hεtwo d
  have hrow : ∀ w ∈ W,
      ((W.filter fun w' =>
        ((U.filter fun u => G.Adj u w ∧ G.Adj u w').card : ENNReal) <
            (d - 2 * ε) ^ 2 * n ∨
          (d + 2 * ε) ^ 2 * n <
            ((U.filter fun u => G.Adj u w ∧ G.Adj u w').card : ENNReal)).card : ENNReal)
        ≤ 2 * ε * W.card := by
    intro w hw
    let A := U.filter fun u => G.Adj u w
    have hdeg := hsr.2.2 w hw
    have hAlower : (d - ε) * n ≤ (A.card : ENNReal) := by
      simpa only [hU] using hdeg.1
    have hAupper : (A.card : ENNReal) ≤ (d + ε) * n := by
      simpa only [hU] using hdeg.2
    have hAsize : ε * U.card < (A.card : ENNReal) := by
      rw [hU]
      exact (ENNReal.mul_lt_mul_left hnzero (by simp) hεsub).trans_le hAlower
    have hAzero : (A.card : ENNReal) ≠ 0 :=
      ne_of_gt ((zero_le _).trans_lt hAsize)
    have hcommon : ∀ w', A.filter (fun u => G.Adj u w') =
        U.filter (fun u => G.Adj u w ∧ G.Adj u w') := by
      intro w'
      ext u
      simp only [A, Finset.mem_filter, and_assoc]
    have hcount : ∀ T : Finset V,
        (((A.product T).filter fun p => G.Adj p.1 p.2).card : ENNReal) =
          ∑ w' ∈ T, ((A.filter fun u => G.Adj u w').card : ENNReal) := by
      intro T
      have hn : ((A.product T).filter fun p => G.Adj p.1 p.2).card =
          ∑ w' ∈ T, (A.filter fun u => G.Adj u w').card := by
        rw [FilteredProductRowCount A T G.Adj]
        simp only [Finset.card_eq_sum_ones, Finset.sum_filter]
        exact Finset.sum_comm (f := fun u w' => if G.Adj u w' then (1 : ℕ) else 0)
      rw [hn, Nat.cast_sum]
    have hlo : (d - 2 * ε) ^ 2 * n ≤ (d - ε) * A.card := by
      calc
        (d - 2 * ε) ^ 2 * n ≤ (d - ε) ^ 2 * n := by gcongr
        _ = (d - ε) * ((d - ε) * n) := by rw [pow_two, mul_assoc]
        _ ≤ (d - ε) * A.card := mul_le_mul_left' hAlower _
    have hhi : (d + ε) * A.card ≤ (d + 2 * ε) ^ 2 * n := by
      calc
        (d + ε) * A.card ≤ (d + ε) * ((d + ε) * n) := mul_le_mul_left' hAupper _
        _ = (d + ε) ^ 2 * n := by rw [pow_two, mul_assoc]
        _ ≤ (d + 2 * ε) ^ 2 * n := by gcongr
    let L := W.filter fun w' =>
      ((A.filter fun u => G.Adj u w').card : ENNReal) < (d - 2 * ε) ^ 2 * n
    let H := W.filter fun w' =>
      (d + 2 * ε) ^ 2 * n < ((A.filter fun u => G.Adj u w').card : ENNReal)
    have hL : (L.card : ENNReal) ≤ ε * W.card := by
      by_contra hbound
      have hsize : ε * W.card < (L.card : ENNReal) := lt_of_not_ge hbound
      have hzero : (L.card : ENNReal) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt ((zero_le _).trans_lt hsize)
      have hnonempty : L.Nonempty := Finset.card_pos.mp (by exact_mod_cast
        ((zero_le _).trans_lt hsize : (0 : ENNReal) < L.card))
      have hsum : (∑ w' ∈ L, ((A.filter fun u => G.Adj u w').card : ENNReal)) <
          ∑ _w' ∈ L, (d - ε) * A.card := by
        apply ENNReal.sum_lt_sum_of_nonempty hnonempty
        intro w' hw'
        exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hw').2 |>.trans_le hlo
      have hdensity : PairDensity G A L < d - ε := by
        unfold PairDensity
        apply (ENNReal.div_lt_iff (Or.inl (mul_ne_zero hAzero hzero))
          (Or.inl (ENNReal.mul_ne_top (by simp) (by simp)))).mpr
        rw [hcount]
        simpa only [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_assoc, mul_comm,
          mul_left_comm] using hsum
      exact (not_lt_of_ge (hsr.1 A (Finset.filter_subset _ _) L
        (Finset.filter_subset _ _) hAsize hsize).1) hdensity
    have hH : (H.card : ENNReal) ≤ ε * W.card := by
      by_contra hbound
      have hsize : ε * W.card < (H.card : ENNReal) := lt_of_not_ge hbound
      have hzero : (H.card : ENNReal) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt ((zero_le _).trans_lt hsize)
      have hnonempty : H.Nonempty := Finset.card_pos.mp (by exact_mod_cast
        ((zero_le _).trans_lt hsize : (0 : ENNReal) < H.card))
      have hsum : (∑ _w' ∈ H, (d + ε) * A.card) <
          ∑ w' ∈ H, ((A.filter fun u => G.Adj u w').card : ENNReal) := by
        apply ENNReal.sum_lt_sum_of_nonempty hnonempty
        intro w' hw'
        exact hhi.trans_lt (Finset.mem_filter.mp hw').2
      have hdensity : d + ε < PairDensity G A H := by
        unfold PairDensity
        apply (ENNReal.lt_div_iff_mul_lt (Or.inl (mul_ne_zero hAzero hzero))
          (Or.inl (ENNReal.mul_ne_top (by simp) (by simp)))).mpr
        rw [hcount]
        simpa only [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_assoc, mul_comm,
          mul_left_comm] using hsum
      exact (not_lt_of_ge (hsr.1 A (Finset.filter_subset _ _) H
        (Finset.filter_subset _ _) hAsize hsize).2) hdensity
    have hunion : (W.filter fun w' =>
        ((U.filter fun u => G.Adj u w ∧ G.Adj u w').card : ENNReal) <
            (d - 2 * ε) ^ 2 * n ∨
          (d + 2 * ε) ^ 2 * n <
            ((U.filter fun u => G.Adj u w ∧ G.Adj u w').card : ENNReal)) = L ∪ H := by
      ext w'
      simp only [L, H, ← hcommon, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_union]
      tauto
    rw [hunion]
    calc
      ((L ∪ H).card : ENNReal) ≤ (L.card : ENNReal) + H.card := by
        exact_mod_cast Finset.card_union_le L H
      _ ≤ ε * W.card + ε * W.card := add_le_add hL hH
      _ = 2 * ε * W.card := by rw [← two_mul, mul_assoc]
  change (((W.product W).filter fun z =>
      ((U.filter fun u => G.Adj u z.1 ∧ G.Adj u z.2).card : ENNReal) <
          (d - 2 * ε) ^ 2 * n ∨
        (d + 2 * ε) ^ 2 * n <
          ((U.filter fun u => G.Adj u z.1 ∧ G.Adj u z.2).card : ENNReal)).card : ENNReal)
    ≤ 2 * ε * (W.card : ENNReal) ^ 2
  have htotal := FilteredProductRowCount W W (fun w w' =>
    ((U.filter fun u => G.Adj u w ∧ G.Adj u w').card : ENNReal) <
        (d - 2 * ε) ^ 2 * n ∨
      (d + 2 * ε) ^ 2 * n <
        ((U.filter fun u => G.Adj u w ∧ G.Adj u w').card : ENNReal))
  have htotal' :
      (((W.product W).filter fun z =>
        ((U.filter fun u => G.Adj u z.1 ∧ G.Adj u z.2).card : ENNReal) <
            (d - 2 * ε) ^ 2 * n ∨
          (d + 2 * ε) ^ 2 * n <
            ((U.filter fun u => G.Adj u z.1 ∧ G.Adj u z.2).card : ENNReal)).card : ENNReal) =
        ∑ w ∈ W, ((W.filter fun w' =>
          ((U.filter fun u => G.Adj u w ∧ G.Adj u w').card : ENNReal) <
              (d - 2 * ε) ^ 2 * n ∨
            (d + 2 * ε) ^ 2 * n <
              ((U.filter fun u => G.Adj u w ∧ G.Adj u w').card : ENNReal)).card : ENNReal) := by
    exact_mod_cast htotal
  rw [htotal']
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ _w ∈ W, 2 * ε * (W.card : ENNReal) := Finset.sum_le_sum hrow
    _ = 2 * ε * (W.card : ENNReal) ^ 2 := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, pow_two]
      ac_rfl
SuperRegularCodegreeExceptionalBound.lean_statement:
theorem SuperRegularCodegreeExceptionalBound :
    ∀ {V : Type*} [DecidableEq V]
      (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
      (U W : Finset V) (n : ℕ) (ε d : ENNReal),
      U.card = n → n ≠ 0 → 2 * ε < d →
      SuperRegularPair G U W ε d →
      (((W ×ˢ W).filter fun z =>
          let C := (U.filter fun u => G.Adj u z.1 ∧ G.Adj u z.2).card
          (C : ENNReal) < (d - 2 * ε) ^ 2 * n ∨
            (d + 2 * ε) ^ 2 * n < (C : ENNReal)).card : ENNReal) ≤
        2 * ε * (W.card : ENNReal) ^ 2 := by
SuperRegularCodegreeExceptionalBound.name: SuperRegularCodegreeExceptionalBound
SuperRegularCodegreeExceptionalBound.tex_proof:
\begin{proof}
Put $k=|W|$.  If $W$ is empty, the assertion is immediate.  Otherwise fix
$w\in W$ and put $A=N_G(w)\cap U$.  The degree clause of
\noderef{SuperRegularPair} gives
\[
 (d-\varepsilon)n\leq |A|\leq(d+\varepsilon)n.
\]
The inequality $2\varepsilon<d$ implies that $\varepsilon$ is finite and
$\varepsilon<d-\varepsilon$.  As $n>0$, it follows that
$|A|>\varepsilon n=\varepsilon|U|$, so $A$ is nonempty.
The displayed lower degree bound also forces $d$ to be finite: otherwise
$(d-\varepsilon)n=\infty>|A|$.  Thus all quantities in the following
density comparisons are finite, and all denominators used are positive.
Monotonicity and the degree bounds give
\[
 (d-2\varepsilon)^2n\leq(d-\varepsilon)^2n
 \leq(d-\varepsilon)|A|,
 \qquad
 (d+\varepsilon)|A|\leq(d+\varepsilon)^2n
 \leq(d+2\varepsilon)^2n.
\]
Define
\[
 L=\{w'\in W:|A\cap N_G(w')|<(d-2\varepsilon)^2n\},\qquad
 H=\{w'\in W:(d+2\varepsilon)^2n<|A\cap N_G(w')|\}.
\]
Suppose $|L|>\varepsilon k$.  Both $A\subseteq U$ and $L\subseteq W$
then exceed their respective regularity thresholds, so the regularity
clause of \noderef{SuperRegularPair} gives $d_G(A,L)\geq d-\varepsilon$.
Counting edges by their second endpoint, using
\noderef{FilteredProductRowCount} (and interchanging the two finite sums),
gives
\[
 e_G(A,L)=\sum_{w'\in L}|A\cap N_G(w')|
 <\sum_{w'\in L}(d-\varepsilon)|A|
 =(d-\varepsilon)|A||L|.
\]
Indeed, every summand satisfies the strict inequality by the definition
of $L$ and the first comparison above; also $L$ is nonempty since
$|L|>\varepsilon k\geq0$.  Dividing by $|A||L|>0$, as in the density
definition \noderef{PairDensity}, contradicts the regularity lower bound.
Consequently $|L|\leq\varepsilon k$.

Similarly, if $|H|>\varepsilon k$, regularity gives
$d_G(A,H)\leq d+\varepsilon$, while the second comparison and the
defining strict inequalities of $H$ give
\[
 e_G(A,H)=\sum_{w'\in H}|A\cap N_G(w')|
 >\sum_{w'\in H}(d+\varepsilon)|A|
 =(d+\varepsilon)|A||H|.
\]
Here $H$ is nonempty, so the summed inequality is strict.  Dividing by
$|A||H|>0$ contradicts the regularity upper bound.  Hence
$|H|\leq\varepsilon k$ as well.

For this fixed $w$, the bad second coordinates are exactly $L\cup H$,
because $A\cap N_G(w')=N_G(w)\cap N_G(w')\cap U$.
Their number is at most $|L|+|H|\leq2\varepsilon k$.
Finally \noderef{FilteredProductRowCount} expresses the number of bad
ordered pairs as the sum of these row counts over $w\in W$.
There are $k$ rows, giving at most $k(2\varepsilon k)=2\varepsilon k^2$.
\end{proof}
SuperRegularCodegreeExceptionalBound.tex_statement:
\begin{helper}[Ordered codegree exceptions in a super-regular pair]
Let $G$ be a simple graph, let $U,W$ be finite vertex sets, and let
$|U|=n>0$.  Let $\varepsilon,d\in[0,\infty]$, with subtraction interpreted
as truncated subtraction.  Suppose $2\varepsilon<d$ and $(U,W)$ is
$(\varepsilon,d)$-super-regular.  Then at most $2\varepsilon|W|^2$
ordered pairs $(w,w')\in W^2$ have common-neighborhood size in $U$ outside
\[
 [(d-2\varepsilon)^2n,(d+2\varepsilon)^2n].
\]
No restriction on $|W|$ is required.
\end{helper}
SuperRegularCodegreeExceptionalBound.title: SuperRegularCodegreeExceptionalBound

SuperRegularCoreSample.lean_proof:
classical
  have hnr : 0 < (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hn
  let p : ℝ := d / 2
  have hp : 0 < p := by dsimp [p]; positivity
  have hp1 : p ≤ 1 := by dsimp [p]; linarith only [hd1]
  have hpd : p * d = d ^ 2 / 2 := by dsimp [p]; ring
  let E0 := (U₀.product W₀).filter fun e => H.Adj e.1 e.2
  let I := {e // e ∈ E0}
  let q : I → ℝ≥0 := fun _ => ⟨p, hp.le⟩
  have hq : ∀ e, q e ≤ 1 := fun _ => by exact_mod_cast hp1
  let μ := Measure.pi (fun e => (PMF.bernoulli (q e) (hq e)).toMeasure)
  obtain ⟨hμ, hi, _, hs⟩ := IndependentUnequalEdgeSampleLaw q hq
  change IsProbabilityMeasure μ at hμ
  letI := hμ
  let X : I → (I → Bool) → ℝ := fun e ω => if ω e then 1 else 0
  let Y : I → (I → Bool) → ℝ := fun e ω => X e ω - p
  have hind : iIndepFun Y μ :=
    hi.comp (fun _ x => x - p) (fun _ => measurable_id.sub_const _)
  have hsg : ∀ e, HasSubgaussianMGF (Y e) (1 / 4) μ := hs
  let F : (I → Bool) → SimpleGraph V := fun ω =>
    { Adj := fun u w => H.Adj u w ∧
        ((∃ he : (u, w) ∈ E0, ω ⟨(u, w), he⟩ = true) ∨
         (∃ he : (w, u) ∈ E0, ω ⟨(w, u), he⟩ = true))
      symm := by
        intro u w huv
        exact ⟨huv.1.symm, huv.2.symm⟩
      loopless := ⟨fun u huu => H.loopless.irrefl u huu.1⟩ }
  have hcontain (ω) : F ω ≤ H := fun _ _ huv => huv.1
  have hcross (ω : I → Bool) (u) (hu : u ∈ U₀) (w) (hw : w ∈ W₀) :
      (F ω).Adj u w ↔ ∃ he : (u, w) ∈ E0, ω ⟨(u, w), he⟩ = true := by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨_, h | h⟩
      · exact h
      · obtain ⟨hwu, _⟩ := h
        have hwU := (Finset.mem_product.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hwu).1).1
        exact False.elim (Finset.disjoint_left.mp hUW hwU hw)
    · rintro ⟨huw, hω⟩
      exact ⟨(Finset.mem_filter.mp huw).2, Or.inl ⟨huw, hω⟩⟩
  let s : Finset V → Finset V → Finset I := fun A B =>
    Finset.univ.filter fun e => e.val ∈ A.product B
  have hsum (A B : Finset V) (hAU : A ⊆ U₀) (hBW : B ⊆ W₀)
      (f : V × V → ℝ) :
      ∑ e ∈ s A B, f e.val =
        ∑ e ∈ (A.product B).filter (fun e => H.Adj e.1 e.2), f e := by
    apply Finset.sum_bij (fun e _ => e.val)
    · intro e hem
      exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr
        ⟨(Finset.mem_filter.mp hem).2, (Finset.mem_filter.mp e.property).2⟩
    · intro e he f hf hef
      exact Subtype.ext hef
    · intro e hem
      obtain ⟨heAB, heG⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hem
      obtain ⟨heA, heB⟩ := Finset.mem_product.mp heAB
      have heE : e ∈ E0 := Finset.mem_filter.mpr
        ⟨Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨hAU heA, hBW heB⟩, heG⟩
      exact ⟨⟨e, heE⟩, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, heAB⟩, rfl⟩
    · intro e hem
      rfl
  have hcount (A B : Finset V) (hAU : A ⊆ U₀) (hBW : B ⊆ W₀) (ω : I → Bool) :
      (((A.product B).filter fun e => (F ω).Adj e.1 e.2).card : ℝ) =
        ∑ e ∈ s A B, X e ω := by
    let f : V × V → ℝ := fun e => if he : e ∈ E0 then X ⟨e, he⟩ ω else 0
    have hsf : ∑ e ∈ s A B, X e ω = ∑ e ∈ s A B, f e.val := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro e hem
      simp only [f, dif_pos e.property]
      rfl
    rw [hsf, hsum A B hAU hBW f]
    have hfull : ∑ e ∈ (A.product B).filter (fun e => H.Adj e.1 e.2), f e =
        ∑ e ∈ A.product B, f e := by
      apply Finset.sum_filter_of_ne
      intro e hem hf
      by_contra hg
      have hnE : e ∉ E0 := fun heE => hg (Finset.mem_filter.mp heE).2
      exact hf (dif_neg hnE)
    rw [hfull, ← Finset.sum_boole]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro e hem
    obtain ⟨heA, heB⟩ := Finset.mem_product.mp hem
    have hcross' := hcross ω e.1 (hAU heA) e.2 (hBW heB)
    by_cases heE : e ∈ E0
    · simp only [f, dif_pos heE, X]
      have hcross'' : (F ω).Adj e.1 e.2 ↔ ω ⟨e, heE⟩ = true := by
        refine ⟨fun hadj => ?_, fun hω => hcross'.mpr ⟨heE, hω⟩⟩
        obtain ⟨heE', hω⟩ := hcross'.mp hadj
        exact hω
      simp only [hcross'']
    · have hnot : ¬(F ω).Adj e.1 e.2 := fun hadj =>
        (hcross'.mp hadj).elim (fun he _ => heE he)
      simp only [hnot, if_false, f, dif_neg heE]
  have hmean (A B : Finset V) (hAU : A ⊆ U₀) (hBW : B ⊆ W₀) :
      ∑ _e ∈ s A B, p =
        p * (((A.product B).filter fun e => H.Adj e.1 e.2).card : ℝ) := by
    rw [hsum A B hAU hBW (fun _ => p)]
    simp [mul_comm]
  have htrials (A B : Finset V) : (s A B).card ≤ A.card * B.card := by
    have hinj : Function.Injective (fun e : I => e.val) := Subtype.val_injective
    have hsub : (s A B).image (fun e => e.val) ⊆ A.product B := by
      intro e he
      obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp he
      exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
    have := Finset.card_le_card hsub
    rwa [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hinj, Finset.product_eq_sprod,
      Finset.card_product] at this
  have hrowcard (F : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel F.Adj] (u : V) :
      ((({u} : Finset V).product W₀).filter fun e => F.Adj e.1 e.2).card =
        (W₀.filter fun w => F.Adj u w).card := by
    have he : ((({u} : Finset V).product W₀).filter fun e => F.Adj e.1 e.2) =
        ({u} : Finset V).product (W₀.filter fun w => F.Adj u w) := by
      ext e
      simp only [Finset.product_eq_sprod, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product,
        Finset.mem_singleton]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨⟨rfl, hw⟩, ha⟩
        exact ⟨rfl, hw, ha⟩
      · rintro ⟨rfl, hw, ha⟩
        exact ⟨⟨rfl, hw⟩, ha⟩
    rw [he, Finset.product_eq_sprod, Finset.card_product]
    simp
  have hcolcard (F : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel F.Adj] (w : V) :
      ((U₀.product ({w} : Finset V)).filter fun e => F.Adj e.1 e.2).card =
        (U₀.filter fun u => F.Adj u w).card := by
    have he : ((U₀.product ({w} : Finset V)).filter fun e => F.Adj e.1 e.2) =
        (U₀.filter fun u => F.Adj u w).product ({w} : Finset V) := by
      ext e
      simp only [Finset.product_eq_sprod, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product,
        Finset.mem_singleton]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨⟨hu, he⟩, ha⟩
        rw [he] at ha
        exact ⟨⟨hu, ha⟩, he⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨hu, ha⟩, he⟩
        rw [← he] at ha
        exact ⟨⟨hu, he⟩, ha⟩
    rw [he, Finset.product_eq_sprod, Finset.card_product]
    simp
  let badU : V → Set (I → Bool) := fun u =>
    {ω | h * n < |∑ e ∈ s {u} W₀, Y e ω|}
  let badW : V → Set (I → Bool) := fun w =>
    {ω | h * n < |∑ e ∈ s U₀ {w}, Y e ω|}
  have hdegreeTail (A B : Finset V) (hr : (s A B).card ≤ n) :
      μ.real {ω | h * n < |∑ e ∈ s A B, Y e ω|} ≤
        2 * Real.exp (-2 * h ^ 2 * (n : ℝ)) := by
    have ht : 0 ≤ h * (n : ℝ) := by positivity
    have hb := FiniteIndependentSubgaussianTail μ Y (s A B) hind
      (fun e _ => hsg e) n (h * n) hnr (Nat.cast_le.mpr hr) ht
    have heq : -2 * (h * (n : ℝ)) ^ 2 / n = -2 * h ^ 2 * (n : ℝ) := by
      field_simp
    rwa [heq] at hb
  have htailU (u) : μ.real (badU u) ≤ 2 * Real.exp (-2 * h ^ 2 * (n : ℝ)) := by
    apply hdegreeTail
    simpa only [Finset.card_singleton, one_mul] using
      (htrials {u} W₀).trans (by simpa using hW)
  have htailW (w) : μ.real (badW w) ≤ 2 * Real.exp (-2 * h ^ 2 * (n : ℝ)) := by
    apply hdegreeTail
    simpa only [Finset.card_singleton, mul_one] using
      (htrials U₀ {w}).trans (by simpa using hU)
  let bad : Finset V × Finset V → Set (I → Bool) := fun AB =>
    {ω | h * n < (AB.1.card : ℝ) ∧ h * n < (AB.2.card : ℝ) ∧
      h * AB.1.card * AB.2.card < |∑ e ∈ s AB.1 AB.2, Y e ω|}
  have htail (AB : Finset V × Finset V) :
      μ.real (bad AB) ≤ 2 * Real.exp (-2 * h ^ 4 * (n : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
    by_cases hA : h * n < (AB.1.card : ℝ)
    · by_cases hB : h * n < (AB.2.card : ℝ)
      · let N : ℝ := (AB.1.card : ℝ) * AB.2.card
        have hhn : 0 < h * (n : ℝ) := mul_pos hh hnr
        have hapos : 0 < (AB.1.card : ℝ) := hhn.trans hA
        have hbpos : 0 < (AB.2.card : ℝ) := hhn.trans hB
        have hN : 0 < N := mul_pos hapos hbpos
        have hr : ((s AB.1 AB.2).card : ℝ) ≤ N := by
          dsimp only [N]
          exact_mod_cast htrials AB.1 AB.2
        have ht : 0 ≤ h * N := by positivity
        have hbound := FiniteIndependentSubgaussianTail μ Y (s AB.1 AB.2) hind
          (fun e _ => hsg e) N (h * N) hN hr ht
        have hsub : bad AB ⊆ {ω | h * N < |∑ e ∈ s AB.1 AB.2, Y e ω|} := by
          intro ω hω
          change h * N < |∑ e ∈ s AB.1 AB.2, Y e ω|
          simpa only [N, mul_assoc] using hω.2.2
        have heq : -2 * (h * N) ^ 2 / N = -2 * h ^ 2 * N := by
          field_simp
        have hNlo : h ^ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ N := by
          calc
            h ^ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 = (h * n) * (h * n) := by ring
            _ ≤ (AB.1.card : ℝ) * AB.2.card :=
              mul_le_mul hA.le hB.le hhn.le hapos.le
        have hexp : -2 * h ^ 2 * N ≤ -2 * h ^ 4 * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
          nlinarith only [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hNlo (sq_nonneg h)]
        rw [heq] at hbound
        exact (measureReal_mono hsub).trans
          (hbound.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hexp) (by norm_num)))
      · have hempty : bad AB = ∅ := by
          ext ω
          simp only [bad, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
          exact fun hω => hB hω.2.1
        rw [hempty, measureReal_empty]
        positivity
    · have hempty : bad AB = ∅ := by
        ext ω
        simp only [bad, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
        exact fun hω => hA hω.1
      rw [hempty, measureReal_empty]
      positivity
  let tests := U₀.powerset.product W₀.powerset
  have htests : (tests.card : ℝ) ≤ (4 : ℝ) ^ n := by
    have hu : (2 : ℝ) ^ U₀.card ≤ 2 ^ n :=
      pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hU
    have hw : (2 : ℝ) ^ W₀.card ≤ 2 ^ n :=
      pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hW
    change ((U₀.powerset.product W₀.powerset).card : ℝ) ≤ (4 : ℝ) ^ n
    simp only [Finset.product_eq_sprod, Finset.card_product, Finset.card_powerset,
      Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat]
    calc
      _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ n * 2 ^ n := mul_le_mul hu hw (by positivity) (by positivity)
      _ = (4 : ℝ) ^ n := by rw [← mul_pow]; norm_num
  let degreeFailure := (⋃ u ∈ U₀, badU u) ∪ (⋃ w ∈ W₀, badW w)
  let rectangleFailure := ⋃ AB ∈ tests, bad AB
  have hfinite {β : Type _} (t : Finset β) (f : β → Set (I → Bool))
      (b : ℝ) (hf : ∀ i ∈ t, μ.real (f i) ≤ b) :
      μ.real (⋃ i ∈ t, f i) ≤ t.card * b := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ t, μ.real (f i) := measureReal_biUnion_finset_le t f
      _ ≤ ∑ _i ∈ t, b := Finset.sum_le_sum hf
      _ = t.card * b := by simp [nsmul_eq_mul]
  have hdfail : μ.real degreeFailure < 1 / 4 := by
    have hb : 0 ≤ 2 * Real.exp (-2 * h ^ 2 * (n : ℝ)) := by positivity
    calc
      _ ≤ μ.real (⋃ u ∈ U₀, badU u) + μ.real (⋃ w ∈ W₀, badW w) :=
        measureReal_union_le _ _
      _ ≤ (U₀.card : ℝ) * (2 * Real.exp (-2 * h ^ 2 * (n : ℝ))) +
          W₀.card * (2 * Real.exp (-2 * h ^ 2 * (n : ℝ))) :=
        add_le_add (hfinite U₀ badU _ (fun u _ => htailU u))
          (hfinite W₀ badW _ (fun w _ => htailW w))
      _ ≤ (n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.exp (-2 * h ^ 2 * (n : ℝ))) +
          n * (2 * Real.exp (-2 * h ^ 2 * (n : ℝ))) :=
        add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Nat.cast_le.mpr hU) hb)
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Nat.cast_le.mpr hW) hb)
      _ = 4 * n * Real.exp (-2 * h ^ 2 * (n : ℝ)) := by ring
      _ < 1 / 4 := hdegreeCut
  have hrfail : μ.real rectangleFailure < 1 / 4 := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (tests.card : ℝ) * (2 * Real.exp (-2 * h ^ 4 * (n : ℝ) ^ 2)) :=
        hfinite tests bad _ (fun AB _ => htail AB)
      _ ≤ (4 : ℝ) ^ n * (2 * Real.exp (-2 * h ^ 4 * (n : ℝ) ^ 2)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right htests (by positivity)
      _ = 2 * (4 : ℝ) ^ n * Real.exp (-2 * h ^ 4 * (n : ℝ) ^ 2) := by ring
      _ < 1 / 4 := hrectangleCut
  let failure := degreeFailure ∪ rectangleFailure
  -- Select only after bounding both families under the same product law.
  have hfail : μ.real failure < 1 := by
    have hb : μ.real failure ≤ μ.real degreeFailure + μ.real rectangleFailure :=
      measureReal_union_le _ _
    linarith only [hb, hdfail, hrfail]
  obtain ⟨ω, hgood⟩ : ∃ ω, ω ∉ failure := by
    have hm : MeasurableSet failure := (Set.to_countable failure).measurableSet
    have hpos : μ failureᶜ ≠ 0 := by
      apply (measureReal_eq_zero_iff).not.mp
      rw [probReal_compl_eq_one_sub hm]
      linarith only [hfail]
    exact nonempty_of_measure_ne_zero hpos
  have hgoodU (u) (hu : u ∈ U₀) : |∑ e ∈ s {u} W₀, Y e ω| ≤ h * n := by
    apply le_of_not_gt
    intro hb
    apply hgood
    exact Or.inl (Or.inl (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨u, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨hu, hb⟩⟩))
  have hgoodW (w) (hw : w ∈ W₀) : |∑ e ∈ s U₀ {w}, Y e ω| ≤ h * n := by
    apply le_of_not_gt
    intro hb
    apply hgood
    exact Or.inl (Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨w, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨hw, hb⟩⟩))
  have hsupport (ω : I → Bool) : ∀ ⦃u v⦄, (F ω).Adj u v →
      (u ∈ U₀ ∧ v ∈ W₀) ∨ (u ∈ W₀ ∧ v ∈ U₀) := by
    rintro u v ⟨_, huv | hvu⟩
    · obtain ⟨he, _⟩ := huv
      exact Or.inl (Finset.mem_product.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp he).1)
    · obtain ⟨he, _⟩ := hvu
      exact Or.inr (Finset.mem_product.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp he).1).symm
  have hdegree (a b : ℝ)
      (hlo : (d - 3 * h) * n ≤ a) (hhi : a ≤ (d + h) * n)
      (hb : |b - p * a| ≤ h * n) :
      (d ^ 2 / 2 - 4 * h) * n ≤ b ∧ b ≤ (d ^ 2 / 2 + 2 * h) * n := by
    have hl := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlo hp.le
    have hu := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hhi hp.le
    have hph := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hp1 (mul_pos hh hnr).le
    have hprod : p * d * n = d ^ 2 / 2 * n := by rw [hpd]
    obtain ⟨hblo, hbhi⟩ := abs_le.mp hb
    constructor <;> nlinarith only [hl, hu, hph, hprod, hblo, hbhi]
  refine ⟨F ω, inferInstance, hcontain ω, hsupport ω, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro u hu
    have hcount' := hcount {u} W₀ (Finset.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hu)
      (Finset.Subset.refl _) ω
    have hmean' := hmean {u} W₀ (Finset.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hu)
      (Finset.Subset.refl _)
    rw [hrowcard (F ω) u] at hcount'
    rw [hrowcard H u] at hmean'
    have hb := hgoodU u hu
    simp only [Y, Finset.sum_sub_distrib] at hb
    rw [← hcount', hmean'] at hb
    exact hdegree _ _ (hdegU u hu).1 (hdegU u hu).2 hb
  · intro w hw
    have hcount' := hcount U₀ {w} (Finset.Subset.refl _)
      (Finset.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hw) ω
    have hmean' := hmean U₀ {w} (Finset.Subset.refl _)
      (Finset.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hw)
    rw [hcolcard (F ω) w] at hcount'
    rw [hcolcard H w] at hmean'
    have hb := hgoodW w hw
    simp only [Y, Finset.sum_sub_distrib] at hb
    rw [← hcount', hmean'] at hb
    exact hdegree _ _ (hdegW w hw).1 (hdegW w hw).2 hb
  · intro A hAU B hBW hA hB
    have hm : (A, B) ∈ tests := Finset.mem_product.mpr
      ⟨Finset.mem_powerset.mpr hAU, Finset.mem_powerset.mpr hBW⟩
    have hb : |∑ e ∈ s A B, Y e ω| ≤ h * A.card * B.card := by
      apply le_of_not_gt
      intro hb
      apply hgood
      exact Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨(A, B), Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨hm, hA, hB, hb⟩⟩)
    have hsample : |(((A.product B).filter fun e => (F ω).Adj e.1 e.2).card : ℝ) -
        p * (((A.product B).filter fun e => H.Adj e.1 e.2).card : ℝ)| ≤
          h * A.card * B.card := by
      rw [hcount A B hAU hBW ω, ← hmean A B hAU hBW]
      simpa only [Y, Finset.sum_sub_distrib] using hb
    have hAp : 0 < (A.card : ℝ) := (mul_pos hh hnr).trans hA
    have hBp : 0 < (B.card : ℝ) := (mul_pos hh hnr).trans hB
    have hden : 0 < (A.card : ℝ) * B.card := mul_pos hAp hBp
    have hdensity : |((F ω).edgeDensity A B : ℝ) -
        p * (H.edgeDensity A B : ℝ)| ≤ h := by
      have hid : ((F ω).edgeDensity A B : ℝ) - p * (H.edgeDensity A B : ℝ) =
          ((((A.product B).filter fun e => (F ω).Adj e.1 e.2).card : ℝ) -
            p * (((A.product B).filter fun e => H.Adj e.1 e.2).card : ℝ)) /
              ((A.card : ℝ) * B.card) := by
        simp only [SimpleGraph.edgeDensity_def, SimpleGraph.interedges_def,
          Rat.cast_div, Rat.cast_mul, Rat.cast_natCast, Finset.product_eq_sprod]
        ring
      rw [hid, abs_div, abs_of_pos hden]
      apply (div_le_iff₀ hden).mpr
      simpa only [mul_assoc] using hsample
    have hex := (hrect A hAU B hBW hA hB).le
    have hmeanDensity : |p * (H.edgeDensity A B : ℝ) - d ^ 2 / 2| ≤ h := by
      rw [← hpd, ← mul_sub, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hp]
      have he := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hex hp.le
      have hph : p * (h / 2) ≤ h := by
        have he := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hp1 (by positivity : 0 ≤ h / 2)
        linarith only [he, hh]
      exact he.trans hph
    exact (abs_sub_le ((F ω).edgeDensity A B : ℝ)
      (p * (H.edgeDensity A B : ℝ)) (d ^ 2 / 2)).trans
        (by linarith only [hdensity, hmeanDensity])

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open scoped NNReal

theorem SuperRegularCoreSample
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (H : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel H.Adj] (U₀ W₀ : Finset V)
    (n : ℕ) (d h : ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) (hd : 0 < d) (hd1 : d < 1) (hh : 0 < h)
    (hUW : Disjoint U₀ W₀) (hU : U₀.card ≤ n) (hW : W₀.card ≤ n)
    (hdegU : ∀ u ∈ U₀, (d - 3 * h) * n ≤
      ((W₀.filter fun w => H.Adj u w).card : ℝ) ∧
      ((W₀.filter fun w => H.Adj u w).card : ℝ) ≤ (d + h) * n)
    (hdegW : ∀ w ∈ W₀, (d - 3 * h) * n ≤
      ((U₀.filter fun u => H.Adj u w).card : ℝ) ∧
      ((U₀.filter fun u => H.Adj u w).card : ℝ) ≤ (d + h) * n)
    (hrect : ∀ A ⊆ U₀, ∀ B ⊆ W₀, h * n < (A.card : ℝ) →
      h * n < (B.card : ℝ) → |(H.edgeDensity A B : ℝ) - d| < h / 2)
    (hdegreeCut : 4 * n * Real.exp (-2 * h ^ 2 * (n : ℝ)) < 1 / 4)
    (hrectangleCut : 2 * (4 : ℝ) ^ n *
      Real.exp (-2 * h ^ 4 * (n : ℝ) ^ 2) < 1 / 4) :
    ∃ F : SimpleGraph V, ∃ _ : DecidableRel F.Adj,
      F ≤ H ∧
      (∀ ⦃u v⦄, F.Adj u v →
        (u ∈ U₀ ∧ v ∈ W₀) ∨ (u ∈ W₀ ∧ v ∈ U₀)) ∧
      (∀ u ∈ U₀, (d ^ 2 / 2 - 4 * h) * n ≤
        ((W₀.filter fun w => F.Adj u w).card : ℝ) ∧
        ((W₀.filter fun w => F.Adj u w).card : ℝ) ≤ (d ^ 2 / 2 + 2 * h) * n) ∧
      (∀ w ∈ W₀, (d ^ 2 / 2 - 4 * h) * n ≤
        ((U₀.filter fun u => F.Adj u w).card : ℝ) ∧
        ((U₀.filter fun u => F.Adj u w).card : ℝ) ≤ (d ^ 2 / 2 + 2 * h) * n) ∧
      (∀ A ⊆ U₀, ∀ B ⊆ W₀, h * n < (A.card : ℝ) →
        h * n < (B.card : ℝ) → |(F.edgeDensity A B : ℝ) - d ^ 2 / 2| ≤ 2 * h) := by
SuperRegularCoreSample.name: SuperRegularCoreSample
SuperRegularCoreSample.tex_proof:
\begin{proof}
Set $p=c/d=d/2$, which is in $(0,1)$ because $0<d<1$.
Index trials by the original $H$ edges oriented from $U_0$ to
$W_0$. Use the finite Bernoulli product law with constant probability
$p$ from \noderef{IndependentUnequalEdgeSampleLaw}. Its statement
gives independent indicators with mean $p$ and centered
subgaussian parameter $1/4$. Centering preserves independence.
For each outcome, include successful edges in both orientations
on $V$, and include no other edges. Thus $F\subseteq H$ is a
simple graph on the same vertex set with the claimed support.

For a core vertex the expected opposite-core degree lies between
$p(d-3h)n=(c-3ph)n$ and $p(d+h)n=(c+ph)n$.
Since $0<p<1$, these lie inside $[(c-3h)n,(c+h)n]$;
these inequalities hold even if $d-3h$ is negative.
There are at most $n$ edge trials per vertex. Apply
\noderef{FiniteIndependentSubgaussianTail} with $N=n>0$ and
$t=hn>0$. The degree bad event has probability at most
$2e^{-2h^2n}$. There are at most $2n$ core vertices, so their
union has probability at most $4ne^{-2h^2n}<1/4$.

For a tested rectangle, $N=|A||B|>h^2n^2>0$ and its mean
count is $p e_H(A,B)$. The assumed density bound gives mean
density within $ph/2\leq h$ of $pd=c$.
Apply \noderef{FiniteIndependentSubgaussianTail} with this $N$
and $t=hN$. There are at most $N$ trials, so the rectangle bad
event has probability at most
$2e^{-2h^2N}\leq2e^{-2h^4n^2}$.
The number of pairs of subsets is
$2^{|U_0|+|W_0|}\leq4^n$, giving total probability at most
$2\,4^n e^{-2h^4n^2}<1/4$.
Combine both unions in this same product sample. Their total
probability is less than $1/2$, so there is an outcome outside
them. Its degrees are within $hn$ of their means, and hence
lie in $[(c-4h)n,(c+2h)n]$. Its tested density differs from
the mean density by at most $h$, so its error from $c$ is at
most $h+h=2h$. Empty trial sets cause no problem because
their centered sums vanish. The bounds use only the ambient
$n$ and the displayed tail cutoffs, not the sizes of the core
parts beyond their upper bounds.
\end{proof}
SuperRegularCoreSample.tex_statement:
\begin{lemma}[Independent core thinning]
Let $H$ be a finite simple graph on $V$, and let $U_0,W_0$
be disjoint sets with $|U_0|,|W_0|\leq n$, where $n>0$.
Let $0<d<1$ and $h>0$, and put $c=d^2/2$.
Assume each core vertex has between $(d-3h)n$ and $(d+h)n$
neighbors in the opposite core part in $H$, and
\[
|d_H(A,B)-d|<h/2\quad
(A\subseteq U_0,\ B\subseteq W_0,\ |A|,|B|>hn).
\]
Suppose $4n e^{-2h^2n}<1/4$ and
$2\,4^n e^{-2h^4n^2}<1/4$.
There is a graph $F\subseteq H$ on $V$ whose edges all join
$U_0$ to $W_0$, whose opposite-core degrees on both sides lie in
$[(c-4h)n,(c+2h)n]$, and whose density on every such tested
rectangle satisfies $|d_F(A,B)-c|\leq2h$.
\end{lemma}
SuperRegularCoreSample.title: SuperRegularCoreSample

rintro ⟨hreg, hleft, hright⟩
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro U hU W hW hUL hWR
    obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := hreg U hU W hW
      (lt_of_le_of_lt (mul_le_mul_left h _) hUL)
      (lt_of_le_of_lt (mul_le_mul_left h _) hWR)

SuperRegularErrorMonotone.lean_statement:
theorem SuperRegularErrorMonotone {V : Type*} [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (L R : Finset V)
    (beta gamma d : ENNReal) (h : beta ≤ gamma) :
    SuperRegularPair G L R beta d → SuperRegularPair G L R gamma d := by
SuperRegularErrorMonotone.name: SuperRegularErrorMonotone
SuperRegularErrorMonotone.tex_proof:
\begin{proof}
Unfold \noderef{SuperRegularPair} and \noderef{RegularPair}.
If $U\subseteq L$ and $W\subseteq R$ satisfy
$|U|>\gamma|L|$ and $|W|>\gamma|R|$, then they also satisfy the
corresponding strict inequalities with $\beta$. The input regularity gives
$d-\beta\leq d_G(U,W)\leq d+\beta$. Since subtraction is truncated and
$\beta\leq\gamma$, one has $d-\gamma\leq d-\beta$ and
$d+\beta\leq d+\gamma$, proving the required regularity.
For each left vertex multiply these same endpoint comparisons by $|R|$;
for each right vertex multiply them by $|L|$. Nonnegativity preserves the
inequalities, so the two input degree bounds imply the two output degree
bounds. These are all three clauses of super-regularity.
\end{proof}
SuperRegularErrorMonotone.tex_statement:
\begin{lemma}[Increasing the super-regularity error]
Let $G$ be a graph on a finite vertex set, let $L,R$ be vertex sets, and let
$\beta\leq\gamma$ and $d$ be nonnegative extended real numbers.
If $G[L,R]$ is $(\beta,d)$-super-regular, then it is
$(\gamma,d)$-super-regular.
\end{lemma}
SuperRegularErrorMonotone.title: SuperRegularErrorMonotone

SuperRegularExceptionalRestoration.lean_proof:
classical

    by_contra hn
    have hn0 : (n : ℝ) = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hn) (by positivity)
    rw [hn0, mul_zero] at hfloor
    norm_num at hfloor
  have hn : 0 < n := by exact_mod_cast hnR
  let k := Nat.floor (c * n)
  have hkhi : (k : ℝ) ≤ c * n := Nat.floor_le (by positivity)
  have hklo : c * n - 1 ≤ (k : ℝ) := by
    have hk := Nat.lt_floor_add_one (c * (n : ℝ))
    linarith only [hk]
  -- Removing the opposite exceptional part leaves enough reserve for k edges.
  have hreserve : ∀ (A A₀ : Finset V) (v : V),
      ((A \ A₀).card : ℝ) ≤ 2 * h * n →
      (7 * c / 4) * n ≤ ((A.filter fun w => H.Adj v w).card : ℝ) →
      k ≤ (A₀.filter fun w => H.Adj v w).card := by
    intro A A₀ v hbad hres
    have hsub : A.filter (fun w => H.Adj v w) ⊆
        (A₀.filter fun w => H.Adj v w) ∪ (A \ A₀) := by
      intro w hw
      obtain ⟨hwA, hadj⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hw
      by_cases hw0 : w ∈ A₀
      · exact Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hw0, hadj⟩)
      · exact Finset.mem_union_right _ (Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨hwA, hw0⟩)

      (∀ v ∈ A₀, (c - 4 * h) * n ≤
        ((B₀.filter fun w => F.Adj v w).card : ℝ) ∧
        ((B₀.filter fun w => F.Adj v w).card : ℝ) ≤ (c + 2 * h) * n) →
      (∀ v ∈ A \ A₀, (B.filter fun w => G.Adj v w).card = k) →
      (∀ v ∈ A₀,
        (B₀.filter fun w => F.Adj v w).card ≤ (B.filter fun w => G.Adj v w).card ∧
        (B.filter fun w => G.Adj v w).card ≤
          (B₀.filter fun w => F.Adj v w).card + (B \ B₀).card) →
      ∀ v ∈ A, (c - η) * n ≤ ((B.filter fun w => G.Adj v w).card : ℝ) ∧
        ((B.filter fun w => G.Adj v w).card : ℝ) ≤ (c + η) * n := by
    intro A A₀ B B₀ hbad hdeg hex hcore v hv
    by_cases hv0 : v ∈ A₀

      have hglR : ((B₀.filter fun w => F.Adj v w).card : ℝ) ≤
          (B.filter fun w => G.Adj v w).card := by exact_mod_cast hgl

          (B₀.filter fun w => F.Adj v w).card + (B \ B₀).card := by exact_mod_cast hgu

      ((U.filter fun u => G.Adj w u).card : ℝ) ≤ (c + η) * n := by
    apply hdegrees W W₀ U U₀ hbadU _ hexW hcoreW
    intro w hw
    have he : U₀.filter (fun u => F.Adj w u) = U₀.filter (fun u => F.Adj u w) := by

        apply (ENNReal.toReal_le_toReal (by finiteness) hz).mp

          ENNReal.toReal_natCast] using hl
