\begin{lemma}[One-colour-class matching extension]
Let \(R\) have maximum degree at most \(D\), let \(c:V(R)\to[q]\)
distinguish vertices at distance at most two, and fix \(t<q\).
Suppose a particular law \(\mu\) satisfies
\(\mathcal I(t,S;X(t,S),\mu)\) of \noderef{ColourRoundInvariant} for
\(S\subseteq c^{-1}(t)\), and let \(i\in c^{-1}(t)\setminus S\).
Write \(x_j\) for the number of already embedded neighbours of an
unembedded cluster \(j\), and assume
\(\varepsilon_t\leq\varepsilon_{t+1}\leq1\).

The certificate has certified round bound $q$; hence the hypothesis $t<q$
licenses each of its guarantee clauses used below.  Assume every source and host cluster has the same cardinality in
\(\{n,n+1\}\), the initial host pairs are
\((\varepsilon_0,d)\)-super-regular, and every reduced edge carries a
saturating source matching. Fix an \noderef{InductionApplicationCertificate}
whose thinning, matching-existence, matching-spread, and Four-Graphs
conclusions use the displayed parameter sequences.

Assume that every \((\varepsilon_t,D_x)\)-super-regular witness and relevant
host pair on parts of sizes in \(\{n,n+1\}\) admits the required contained
spanning thinning, and that
\[
 2\sqrt{\zeta_t}\leq\theta_t,\qquad
 \zeta_t+D\sqrt{\zeta_t}\leq\theta_t,\qquad
 \zeta_t+2D\zeta_t\leq\theta_t,
\]
and, for every exposure \(x\leq D\),
\[
 0<\theta_t,\quad 4\theta_t<\rho_x,\quad
 2\zeta_t<\rho_x,\quad 2\zeta_t<1-\rho_x,\quad
 2\zeta_t<d/2,\quad 2\zeta_t<1-d/2.
\]
Assume also that, for every \(x<D\),
\[
 D_{x+1}=\rho_xd/2,
 \qquad D_{x+1}+\varepsilon_t+1/n\leq D_x.
\]
where \(\theta_t\) lies below the Four-Graphs input cutoff for all ordered
density triples \((\rho_x,\rho_y,d/2)\), \(x,y\leq D\), with output error
\(\omega_{t+1}<\varepsilon_{t+1}\). Take \(n\) above the finitely many
thinning, matching, and Four-Graphs thresholds. Suppose each retained current
pair has a uniform \((C/(2n))\)-vertex-spread matching law, each relevant
Four-Graphs failure probability is at most \((1-a)^n\), and
\[
 D(1-a)^n\leq\tfrac12,\qquad C/n\leq1.
\]
More precisely, for every exposure at most \(D\), all four certificate
thresholds are at most \(n\), its matching constant is at most \(C/2\), and
for every ordered pair \(x,y\leq D\) its Four-Graphs threshold is at most \(n\) and
its exponential constant is at least \(a\), where \(0<a\leq1\). For the
present round assume
\[
 n^{-1}\leq\xi_t<\zeta_t,\quad \xi_t+2/n\leq\zeta_t,\quad
 \xi_t+(\zeta_tn)^{-1}\leq\zeta_t,
\]
\[
 \omega_{t+1}+2/n\leq\varepsilon_{t+1},\qquad
 \omega_{t+1}+(\varepsilon_{t+1}n)^{-1}\leq\varepsilon_{t+1}.
\]
Then there is a total conditional extension kernel \(\kappa\), assigning to
every partial embedding of \(X(t,S)\) a law on compatible partial embeddings
of \(X(t,S\cup\{i\})\), such that, for every input embedding
\(f\in\operatorname{supp}(\mu)\), every extension in
\(\operatorname{supp}(\kappa(f))\) agrees with \(f\) on \(X(t,S)\), and the
restriction of \(\kappa(f)\) to the newly embedded cluster is
\((C/n)\)-vertex-spread. The
output law is exactly the composition
\(\mu\mathbin{\mathrm{bind}}\kappa\).  This very law satisfies
\(\mathcal I(t,S\cup\{i\};X(t,S\cup\{i\}),\mu\mathbin{\mathrm{bind}}\kappa)\).
Every future
neighbour \(j\) of \(i\) acquires a contained
\((\varepsilon_{t+1},D_{x_j+1})\)-super-regular witness in its true updated
candidacy graph. A witness touched before processing \(i\) remains a contained
\((\varepsilon_{t+1},D_{x_j})\)-super-regular witness, while every witness
which is neither previously nor newly touched retains its
\((\varepsilon_t,D_{x_j})\)-super-regular witness.  The current cluster and
every future witness tested at it are untouched, and hence have input error
\(\varepsilon_t\).  In every case the new law remains
\((C/n)\)-vertex-spread and the touched-neighbour set has size at most one.

\end{lemma}

classical
  have hprob : ∀ (ν : PMF (X → Y)) (F : Set (X → Y)), ν.toOuterMeasure F ≤ 1 := by
    intro ν F
    calc
      ν.toOuterMeasure F ≤ ν.toOuterMeasure Set.univ :=
        ν.toOuterMeasure.mono (Set.subset_univ F)
      _ = 1 := (ν.toOuterMeasure_apply_eq_one_iff Set.univ).2 (Set.subset_univ _)
  have hp1 : p ≤ 1 := hp.trans (hprob μ E)
  have hfilter : ∀ F : Set (X → Y),
      (μ.filter E hE).toOuterMeasure F = μ.toOuterMeasure (F ∩ E) / μ.toOuterMeasure E := by
    intro F
    rw [PMF.toOuterMeasure_apply]
    calc
      (∑' f, F.indicator (μ.filter E hE) f) =
          ∑' f, (F ∩ E).indicator μ f * (μ.toOuterMeasure E)⁻¹ := by
        apply tsum_congr
        intro f
        by_cases hF : f ∈ F <;> by_cases hEf : f ∈ E <;>
          simp [PMF.filter_apply, PMF.toOuterMeasure_apply, hF, hEf]
      _ = (∑' f, (F ∩ E).indicator μ f) * (μ.toOuterMeasure E)⁻¹ :=
        ENNReal.tsum_mul_right
      _ = μ.toOuterMeasure (F ∩ E) / μ.toOuterMeasure E := by
        rw [← PMF.toOuterMeasure_apply, div_eq_mul_inv]
  refine ⟨hratio, ?_⟩
  intro s x y hx hy
  by_cases hs : s = 0
  · simpa only [hs, pow_zero] using hprob (μ.filter E hE) (CylinderEvent x y)
  · have hps : p ^ s ≤ p := by
      simpa only [pow_one] using
        pow_le_pow_right_of_le_one' hp1 (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 hs)
    calc
      (μ.filter E hE).toOuterMeasure (CylinderEvent x y) =
          μ.toOuterMeasure (CylinderEvent x y ∩ E) / μ.toOuterMeasure E :=
        hfilter _
      _ ≤ q ^ s / p := ENNReal.div_le_div
        ((μ.toOuterMeasure.mono Set.inter_subset_left).trans (hμ.2 s x y hx hy)) hp
      _ ≤ q ^ s / p ^ s := ENNReal.div_le_div_left hps _
      _ = (q / p) ^ s := by
        simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_pow, ENNReal.inv_pow]
VertexSpreadConditioning.lean_statement:
theorem VertexSpreadConditioning {X Y : Type*} {μ : PMF (X → Y)} {q p : ENNReal}
    {U : Set Y} (E : Set (X → Y)) (hE : ∃ f ∈ E, f ∈ μ.support)
    (hμ : VertexSpreadOn μ q U) (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp : p ≤ μ.toOuterMeasure E)
    (hratio : q / p ≤ 1) : VertexSpreadOn (μ.filter E hE) (q / p) U := by
VertexSpreadConditioning.name: VertexSpreadConditioning
VertexSpreadConditioning.tex_proof:
\begin{proof}
Fix $s$, pairwise distinct sources $x_1,\ldots,x_s$, and targets $y_1,\ldots,y_s\in U$, and denote their cylinder by $F$.  By the definition of conditional probability,
\[
 \mu(F\mid E)=\frac{\mu(F\cap E)}{\mu(E)}.
\]
Since $F\cap E\subseteq F$, monotonicity of probability and \noderef{VertexSpreadOn} give $\mu(F\cap E)\leq\mu(F)\leq q^s$.  The hypothesis $p\leq\mu(E)$, positivity of $\mu(E)$, and monotonicity of division therefore give
\[
 \mu(F\mid E)\leq\frac{q^s}{p}.
\]
Because $0<p\leq1$, one has $p^s\leq p$ for every $s\geq1$, whence $q^s/p\leq q^s/p^s=(q/p)^s$.  For $s=0$, the required inequality is simply $\mu(F\mid E)\leq1=(q/p)^0$.  Thus every required cylinder has conditional probability at most $(q/p)^s$, and the assumed inequality $q/p\leq1$ supplies the parameter-range condition in \noderef{VertexSpreadOn}.
\end{proof}
VertexSpreadConditioning.title: VertexSpreadConditioning

VertexSpreadMonotone.lean_proof:
refine ⟨hq', fun s x y hx hy => ?_⟩
  exact (hμ.2 s x y hx hy).trans (pow_le_pow_left' hqq' s)

VertexSpreadOn.lean_proof:
q ≤ 1 ∧ ∀ (s : ℕ) (x : Fin s → X) (y : Fin s → Y),
    Function.Injective x → (∀ i, y i ∈ U) →
      μ.toOuterMeasure (CylinderEvent x y) ≤ q ^ s
VertexSpreadOn.lean_statement: def VertexSpreadOn {X Y : Type*} (μ : PMF (X → Y)) (q : ENNReal) (U : Set Y) : Prop :=
VertexSpreadOn.name: VertexSpreadOn
VertexSpreadOn.tex_statement:
\begin{definition}
Let $X,Y$ be arbitrary types, let $U\subseteq Y$, let $q$ be an extended nonnegative real, and let $\mu$ be a probability mass function on the functions $X\to Y$.  We say that $\mu$ is \emph{$q$-vertex-spread on $U$} if $q\leq1$ and, for every natural number $s$, every injective map $x:[s]\to X$, and every map $y:[s]\to Y$ whose image lies in $U$, one has
\[
 \mu\bigl(\operatorname{Cyl}(x,y)\bigr)\leq q^s.
\]
Here the cylinder event is the one in \noderef{CylinderEvent}.  The paper applies this definition when $X$ and $Y$ are finite sets and $q\in[0,1]$.
\end{definition}
VertexSpreadOn.title: VertexSpreadOn

VertexSpreadRestriction.lean_proof:
refine ⟨hμ.1, ?_⟩
  intro s x y hx hy
  rw [PMF.toOuterMeasure_map_apply]
  change μ.toOuterMeasure (CylinderEvent (e ∘ x) y) ≤ q ^ s
  exact hμ.2 s (e ∘ x) y (e.injective.comp hx) hy
VertexSpreadRestriction.name: VertexSpreadRestriction

VertexSpreadSequential.lean_proof:
classical
  refine ⟨hμ.1, ?_⟩
  intro s x y hx _
  let L := {i : Fin s // ∃ u : X, x i = Sum.inl u}
  let R := {i : Fin s // ¬∃ u : X, x i = Sum.inl u}
  let left : L → X := fun i => Classical.choose i.property
  have hleft (i : L) : x i.val = Sum.inl (left i) :=
    Classical.choose_spec i.property
  have right_exists (i : R) : ∃ u : Z, x i.val = Sum.inr u := by
    cases hi : x i.val with
    | inl u => exact False.elim (i.property ⟨u, hi⟩)
    | inr u => exact ⟨u, rfl⟩
  let right : R → Z := fun i => Classical.choose (right_exists i)
  have hright (i : R) : x i.val = Sum.inr (right i) :=
    Classical.choose_spec (right_exists i)
  have left_inj : Function.Injective left := by
    intro i j hij
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply hx
    rw [hleft i, hleft j, hij]
  have right_inj : Function.Injective right := by
    intro i j hij
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply hx
    rw [hright i, hright j, hij]
  let a := Fintype.card L
  let b := Fintype.card R
  have hab : a + b = s := by
    simpa only [Fintype.card_sum, Fintype.card_fin] using
      Fintype.card_congr (Equiv.sumCompl (fun i : Fin s => ∃ u : X, x i = Sum.inl u))
  let eL := Fintype.equivFin L
  let eR := Fintype.equivFin R
  let EL : Set (X → Y) := {f | ∀ i : L, f (left i) = y i.val}
  let ER : Set (Z → Y) := {g | ∀ i : R, g (right i) = y i.val}
  have left_cylinder :
      CylinderEvent (fun j : Fin a => left (eL.symm j))
        (fun j => y (eL.symm j).val) = EL := by
    ext f
    change (∀ j, f (left (eL.symm j)) = y (eL.symm j).val) ↔
      ∀ i : L, f (left i) = y i.val
    constructor
    · intro h i
      simpa only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using h (eL i)
    · intro h j
      exact h (eL.symm j)
  have right_cylinder :
      CylinderEvent (fun j : Fin b => right (eR.symm j))
        (fun j => y (eR.symm j).val) = ER := by
    ext g
    change (∀ j, g (right (eR.symm j)) = y (eR.symm j).val) ↔
      ∀ i : R, g (right i) = y i.val
    constructor
    · intro h i
      simpa only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using h (eR i)
    · intro h j
      exact h (eR.symm j)
  have hEL : μ.toOuterMeasure EL ≤ q ^ a := by
    rw [← left_cylinder]
    exact hμ.2 a _ _ (left_inj.comp eL.symm.injective) (fun _ => Set.mem_univ _)
  have hER (f : X → Y) : (κ f).toOuterMeasure ER ≤ q ^ b := by
    rw [← right_cylinder]
    exact (hκ f).2 b _ _ (right_inj.comp eR.symm.injective)
      (fun _ => Set.mem_univ _)
  have joint_iff (f : X → Y) (g : Z → Y) :
      Sum.elim f g ∈ CylinderEvent x y ↔ f ∈ EL ∧ g ∈ ER := by
    change (∀ i, Sum.elim f g (x i) = y i) ↔
      (∀ i : L, f (left i) = y i.val) ∧ (∀ i : R, g (right i) = y i.val)
    constructor
    · intro h
      constructor
      · intro i
        simpa only [hleft i, Sum.elim_inl] using h i.val
      · intro i
        simpa only [hright i, Sum.elim_inr] using h i.val
    · rintro ⟨hf, hg⟩ i
      by_cases hi : ∃ u : X, x i = Sum.inl u
      · rw [hleft ⟨i, hi⟩]
        exact hf ⟨i, hi⟩
      · rw [hright ⟨i, hi⟩]
        exact hg ⟨i, hi⟩
  have preimage (f : X → Y) :
      (fun g => Sum.elim f g) ⁻¹' CylinderEvent x y =
        if f ∈ EL then ER else ∅ := by
    ext g
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, joint_iff]
    by_cases hf : f ∈ EL <;> simp [hf]
  have conditional (f : X → Y) :
      ((κ f).map (fun g => Sum.elim f g)).toOuterMeasure (CylinderEvent x y) ≤
        if f ∈ EL then q ^ b else 0 := by
    rw [PMF.toOuterMeasure_map_apply, preimage]
    by_cases hf : f ∈ EL
    · simpa only [hf, if_true] using hER f
    · simp [hf]
  calc
    (μ.bind fun f => (κ f).map (fun g => Sum.elim f g)).toOuterMeasure
        (CylinderEvent x y) =
        ∑' f, μ f * ((κ f).map (fun g => Sum.elim f g)).toOuterMeasure
          (CylinderEvent x y) := PMF.toOuterMeasure_bind_apply _ _ _
    _ ≤ ∑' f, (if f ∈ EL then μ f else 0) * q ^ b := by
      apply ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum
      intro f
      have h := mul_le_mul_right (conditional f) (μ f)
      by_cases hf : f ∈ EL <;> simpa only [hf, if_true, if_false, mul_zero, zero_mul] using h
    _ = μ.toOuterMeasure EL * q ^ b := by
      rw [ENNReal.tsum_mul_right, PMF.toOuterMeasure_apply]
      simp only [Set.indicator_apply]
    _ ≤ q ^ a * q ^ b := mul_le_mul_left hEL _
    _ = q ^ s := by rw [← pow_add, hab]
VertexSpreadSequential.lean_statement:
theorem VertexSpreadSequential {X Z Y : Type*} (μ : PMF (X → Y))
    (κ : (X → Y) → PMF (Z → Y)) (q : ENNReal)
    (hμ : VertexSpreadOn μ q Set.univ)
    (hκ : ∀ f, VertexSpreadOn (κ f) q Set.univ) :
    VertexSpreadOn
      (μ.bind fun f => (κ f).map (fun g => Sum.elim f g)) q Set.univ := by
VertexSpreadSequential.name: VertexSpreadSequential
VertexSpreadSequential.title: VertexSpreadSequential

WeightedRectangleExpectation.lean_proof:
classical
  let q : Finset V × Finset V → ℝ := fun ST =>
    if ST ∈ E then d / (G.edgeDensity (U ∩ ST.1) (W ∩ ST.2) : ℝ) else 1
  let p : V × V → ℝ := fun e =>
    if e ∈ U.product W ∧ G.Adj e.1 e.2 then q (P.part e.1, P.part e.2) else 0
  have hq : ∀ ST ∈ P.parts.product P.parts, 0 ≤ q ST ∧ q ST ≤ 1 := by
    intro ST hST
    dsimp [q]
    split_ifs with he
    · have hD' := hD ST.1 ST.2 he
      have hpos : 0 < (G.edgeDensity (U ∩ ST.1) (W ∩ ST.2) : ℝ) :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le hd hD'.1
      exact ⟨div_nonneg hd.le hpos.le, (div_le_one hpos).2 hD'.1⟩
    · exact ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩
  have hp : ∀ e, 0 ≤ p e ∧ p e ≤ 1 := by
    intro e
    dsimp [p]
    split_ifs
    · exact hq _ (Finset.mem_product.mpr
        ⟨P.part_mem.mpr (Finset.mem_univ _), P.part_mem.mpr (Finset.mem_univ _)⟩)
    · exact ⟨le_rfl, zero_le_one⟩
  have hpne : ∀ e, ¬G.Adj e.1 e.2 → p e = 0 := by
    intro e he
    simp [p, he]
  have hpout : ∀ e, e ∉ U.product W → p e = 0 := by
    intro e he
    exact if_neg (fun h => he h.1)
  have hpformula : ∀ S ∈ P.parts, ∀ T ∈ P.parts,
      ∀ u ∈ U ∩ S, ∀ w ∈ W ∩ T, G.Adj u w → p (u, w) = q (S, T) := by
    intro S hS T hT u hu w hw hadj
    have hpartu := P.part_eq_of_mem hS (Finset.mem_inter.mp hu).2
    have hpartw := P.part_eq_of_mem hT (Finset.mem_inter.mp hw).2
    have hcross : (u, w) ∈ U.product W := Finset.mem_product.mpr
      ⟨(Finset.mem_inter.mp hu).1, (Finset.mem_inter.mp hw).1⟩
    dsimp only [p]
    rw [if_pos (And.intro hcross hadj), hpartu, hpartw]
  have hchunks : ∀ (X : Finset V) (f : V → ℝ),
      (∑ S ∈ P.parts, ∑ x ∈ X ∩ S, f x) = ∑ x ∈ X, f x := by
    intro X f
    have hfiber : ∀ S ∈ P.parts, X.filter (fun x => P.part x = S) = X ∩ S := by
      intro S hS
      ext x
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_inter, P.part_eq_iff_mem hS]
    have := Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to
      (s := X) (t := P.parts) (g := P.part)
      (fun x _ => P.part_mem.mpr (Finset.mem_univ x)) f
    calc
      _ = ∑ S ∈ P.parts, ∑ x ∈ X.filter (fun x => P.part x = S), f x := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro S hS
        rw [hfiber S hS]
      _ = _ := this
  have hcards : ∀ X : Finset V, (∑ S ∈ P.parts, ((X ∩ S).card : ℝ)) = X.card := by
    intro X
    simpa using hchunks X (fun _ => 1)
  have hrects : ∀ (X Y : Finset V) (f : V × V → ℝ),
      (∑ ST ∈ P.parts.product P.parts, ∑ e ∈ (X ∩ ST.1).product (Y ∩ ST.2), f e) =
        ∑ e ∈ X.product Y, f e := by
    intro X Y f
    have hfiber : ∀ ST ∈ P.parts.product P.parts,
        (X.product Y).filter (fun e => (P.part e.1, P.part e.2) = ST) =
          (X ∩ ST.1).product (Y ∩ ST.2) := by
      rintro ⟨S, T⟩ hST
      obtain ⟨hS, hT⟩ := Finset.mem_product.mp hST
      ext e
      simp only [Finset.product_eq_sprod, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_inter,
        Prod.mk.injEq, P.part_eq_iff_mem hS, P.part_eq_iff_mem hT]
      tauto
    have := Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to
      (s := X.product Y) (t := P.parts.product P.parts)
      (g := fun e => (P.part e.1, P.part e.2))
      (fun e _ => Finset.mem_product.mpr
        ⟨P.part_mem.mpr (Finset.mem_univ _), P.part_mem.mpr (Finset.mem_univ _)⟩) f
    calc
      _ = ∑ ST ∈ P.parts.product P.parts,
          ∑ e ∈ (X.product Y).filter (fun e => (P.part e.1, P.part e.2) = ST), f e := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro ST hST
        rw [hfiber ST hST]
      _ = _ := this
  have hareas : ∀ X Y : Finset V,
      (∑ ST ∈ P.parts.product P.parts,
        ((X ∩ ST.1).card : ℝ) * (Y ∩ ST.2).card) = (X.card : ℝ) * Y.card := by
    intro X Y
    simp only [Finset.product_eq_sprod, Finset.sum_product]
    simp only [← Finset.mul_sum, hcards, ← Finset.sum_mul]
  have hcount : ∀ A B : Finset V, A.Nonempty → B.Nonempty →
      ((G.interedges A B).card : ℝ) = (G.edgeDensity A B : ℝ) * A.card * B.card := by
    intro A B hA hB
    have hAc : (A.card : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hA.card_ne_zero
    have hBc : (B.card : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hB.card_ne_zero
    simp only [SimpleGraph.edgeDensity_def, Rat.cast_div, Rat.cast_mul, Rat.cast_natCast]
    field_simp [hAc, hBc]
  have hcoarse : ∀ A ⊆ U, ∀ B ⊆ W,
      |(∑ e ∈ A.product B, p e) - d * A.card * B.card| ≤
        2 * α * A.card * B.card + (6 * γ + 9 * α + 6 / (l : ℝ)) * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    intro A hA B hB
    let a : Finset V → ℝ := fun S => (A ∩ S).card
    let b : Finset V → ℝ := fun T => (B ∩ T).card
    let u : Finset V → ℝ := fun S => (U ∩ S).card
    let w : Finset V → ℝ := fun T => (W ∩ T).card
    let z : Finset V × Finset V → ℝ := fun ST =>
      ∑ e ∈ (A ∩ ST.1).product (B ∩ ST.2), p e
    have hAs : ∀ S, A ∩ S ⊆ U ∩ S := by
      intro S x hx
      exact Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨hA (Finset.mem_inter.mp hx).1, (Finset.mem_inter.mp hx).2⟩
    have hBs : ∀ T, B ∩ T ⊆ W ∩ T := by
      intro T x hx
      exact Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨hB (Finset.mem_inter.mp hx).1, (Finset.mem_inter.mp hx).2⟩
    have ha0 : ∀ S, 0 ≤ a S := fun S => Nat.cast_nonneg _
    have hb0 : ∀ T, 0 ≤ b T := fun T => Nat.cast_nonneg _
    have hu0 : ∀ S, 0 ≤ u S := fun S => Nat.cast_nonneg _
    have hw0 : ∀ T, 0 ≤ w T := fun T => Nat.cast_nonneg _
    have hau : ∀ S, a S ≤ u S := fun S => by
      dsimp only [a, u]
      exact_mod_cast Finset.card_le_card (hAs S)
    have hbw : ∀ T, b T ≤ w T := fun T => by
      dsimp only [b, w]
      exact_mod_cast Finset.card_le_card (hBs T)
    have hz0 : ∀ ST, 0 ≤ z ST := by
      intro ST
      exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun e _ => (hp e).1)
    have hz1 : ∀ ST, z ST ≤ a ST.1 * b ST.2 := by
      intro ST
      calc
        z ST ≤ ∑ _e ∈ (A ∩ ST.1).product (B ∩ ST.2), (1 : ℝ) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum (fun e _ => (hp e).2)
        _ = a ST.1 * b ST.2 := by simp [a, b, Finset.card_product]
    have hrough : ∀ ST, |z ST - d * a ST.1 * b ST.2| ≤ a ST.1 * b ST.2 := by
      intro ST
      have htarget0 : 0 ≤ d * a ST.1 * b ST.2 := by positivity
      have htarget1 : d * a ST.1 * b ST.2 ≤ a ST.1 * b ST.2 := by
        nlinarith only [hd1, mul_nonneg (ha0 ST.1) (hb0 ST.2)]
      exact abs_sub_le_iff.mpr ⟨by linarith only [hz1 ST, htarget0],
        by linarith only [hz0 ST, htarget1]⟩
    have hzcount : ∀ ST ∈ P.parts.product P.parts,
        z ST = q ST * ((G.interedges (A ∩ ST.1) (B ∩ ST.2)).card : ℝ) := by
      intro ST hST
      obtain ⟨hS, hT⟩ := Finset.mem_product.mp hST
      calc
        z ST = ∑ e ∈ (A ∩ ST.1).product (B ∩ ST.2),
            if G.Adj e.1 e.2 then q ST else 0 := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro e he
          obtain ⟨heA, heB⟩ := Finset.mem_product.mp he
          by_cases hadj : G.Adj e.1 e.2
          · rw [if_pos hadj]
            exact hpformula ST.1 hS ST.2 hT e.1 (hAs _ heA) e.2 (hBs _ heB) hadj
          · rw [if_neg hadj, hpne e hadj]
        _ = ∑ _e ∈ G.interedges (A ∩ ST.1) (B ∩ ST.2), q ST := by
          rw [SimpleGraph.interedges_def, Finset.sum_filter]
          simp only [Finset.product_eq_sprod]
        _ = _ := by simp [mul_comm]
    have hgood : ∀ ST ∈ P.parts.product P.parts, ST ∈ E →
        γ * u ST.1 < a ST.1 → γ * w ST.2 < b ST.2 →
        |z ST - d * a ST.1 * b ST.2| ≤ 2 * α * a ST.1 * b ST.2 := by
      intro ST hST he hlargeA hlargeB
      have hapos : 0 < a ST.1 := lt_of_le_of_lt (mul_nonneg hγ.le (hu0 _)) hlargeA
      have hbpos : 0 < b ST.2 := lt_of_le_of_lt (mul_nonneg hγ.le (hw0 _)) hlargeB
      have hAn : (A ∩ ST.1).Nonempty := Finset.card_pos.mp (by
        dsimp only [a] at hapos
        exact_mod_cast hapos)
      have hBn : (B ∩ ST.2).Nonempty := Finset.card_pos.mp (by
        dsimp only [b] at hbpos
        exact_mod_cast hbpos)
      have hden : 0 < (G.edgeDensity (U ∩ ST.1) (W ∩ ST.2) : ℝ) :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le hd (hD _ _ he).1
      have hslice' := (hslice _ _ he _ (hAs _) _ (hBs _) hlargeA hlargeB).le
      have hqST : q ST = d / (G.edgeDensity (U ∩ ST.1) (W ∩ ST.2) : ℝ) := by
        simp only [q, if_pos he]
      have hfactor : z ST - d * a ST.1 * b ST.2 =
          q ST * ((G.edgeDensity (A ∩ ST.1) (B ∩ ST.2) : ℝ) -
            G.edgeDensity (U ∩ ST.1) (W ∩ ST.2)) * (a ST.1 * b ST.2) := by
        rw [hzcount ST hST, hcount _ _ hAn hBn, hqST]
        dsimp only [a, b]
        field_simp [hden.ne']
      rw [hfactor, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (hq ST hST).1,
        abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (ha0 _) (hb0 _))]
      calc
        _ ≤ 1 * (2 * α) * (a ST.1 * b ST.2) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
            (mul_le_mul (hq ST hST).2 hslice' (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one)
            (mul_nonneg (ha0 _) (hb0 _))
        _ = _ := by ring
    have hpoint : ∀ ST ∈ P.parts.product P.parts,
        |z ST - d * a ST.1 * b ST.2| ≤
          2 * α * a ST.1 * b ST.2 +
          (if ST ∉ E then u ST.1 * w ST.2 else 0) +
          γ * u ST.1 * b ST.2 + γ * a ST.1 * w ST.2 := by
      intro ST hST
      have hgood0 : 0 ≤ 2 * α * a ST.1 * b ST.2 := by positivity
      have hleft0 : 0 ≤ γ * u ST.1 * b ST.2 := by positivity
      have hright0 : 0 ≤ γ * a ST.1 * w ST.2 := by positivity
      by_cases he : ST ∈ E
      · rw [if_neg (not_not.mpr he)]
        by_cases hlargeA : γ * u ST.1 < a ST.1
        · by_cases hlargeB : γ * w ST.2 < b ST.2
          · linarith only [hgood ST hST he hlargeA hlargeB, hleft0, hright0]
          · have hsmall := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_of_not_gt hlargeB) (ha0 ST.1)
            nlinarith only [hrough ST, hsmall, hgood0, hleft0]
        · have hsmall := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_of_not_gt hlargeA) (hb0 ST.2)
          linarith only [hrough ST, hsmall, hgood0, hright0]
      · rw [if_pos he]
        have hareaST := mul_le_mul (hau ST.1) (hbw ST.2) (hb0 ST.2) (hu0 ST.1)
        linarith only [hrough ST, hareaST, hgood0, hleft0, hright0]
    have hsumz := hrects A B p
    have hsumab := hareas A B
    have hsumub := hareas U B
    have hsumaw := hareas A W
    have hinelig : (∑ ST ∈ P.parts.product P.parts,
        if ST ∉ E then u ST.1 * w ST.2 else 0) ≤
          (4 * γ + 9 * α + 6 / (l : ℝ)) * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      simpa only [← Finset.sum_filter, u, w] using harea
    have hAc : (A.card : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast (Finset.card_le_card hA).trans_eq hU
    have hBc : (B.card : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast (Finset.card_le_card hB).trans_eq hW
    calc
      _ = |∑ ST ∈ P.parts.product P.parts, (z ST - d * a ST.1 * b ST.2)| := by
        rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        simp only [mul_assoc, ← Finset.mul_sum]
        rw [show (∑ ST ∈ P.parts.product P.parts, z ST) = ∑ e ∈ A.product B, p e from hsumz]
        rw [show (∑ ST ∈ P.parts.product P.parts, a ST.1 * b ST.2) =
          (A.card : ℝ) * B.card from hsumab]
      _ ≤ ∑ ST ∈ P.parts.product P.parts, |z ST - d * a ST.1 * b ST.2| :=
        Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ ST ∈ P.parts.product P.parts,
          (2 * α * a ST.1 * b ST.2 +
          (if ST ∉ E then u ST.1 * w ST.2 else 0) +
          γ * u ST.1 * b ST.2 + γ * a ST.1 * w ST.2) := Finset.sum_le_sum hpoint
      _ = 2 * α * A.card * B.card +
          (∑ ST ∈ P.parts.product P.parts, if ST ∉ E then u ST.1 * w ST.2 else 0) +
          γ * n * B.card + γ * A.card * n := by
        simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, mul_assoc, ← Finset.mul_sum]
        rw [show (∑ ST ∈ P.parts.product P.parts, a ST.1 * b ST.2) =
            (A.card : ℝ) * B.card from hsumab,
          show (∑ ST ∈ P.parts.product P.parts, u ST.1 * b ST.2) =
            (U.card : ℝ) * B.card from hsumub,
          show (∑ ST ∈ P.parts.product P.parts, a ST.1 * w ST.2) =
            (A.card : ℝ) * W.card from hsumaw, hU, hW]
      _ ≤ _ := by
        have hleft := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hBc (mul_nonneg hγ.le (Nat.cast_nonneg n))
        have hright := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hAc hγ.le) (Nat.cast_nonneg n : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n)
        nlinarith only [hinelig, hleft, hright]
  refine ⟨p, hp, hpne, hpout, ?_, hcoarse, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [q] using hpformula
  · intro h hh hmargin A hA B hB hlargeA hlargeB
    let K : ℝ := 6 * γ + 9 * α + 6 / (l : ℝ)
    have hK : 0 ≤ K := by dsimp only [K]; positivity
    have hh2 : 0 < h ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hh
    have hn0 : 0 ≤ h * (n : ℝ) := mul_nonneg hh.le (Nat.cast_nonneg n)
    have hApos : 0 < (A.card : ℝ) := lt_of_le_of_lt hn0 hlargeA
    have hBpos : 0 < (B.card : ℝ) := lt_of_le_of_lt hn0 hlargeB
    have hNpos : 0 < (A.card : ℝ) * B.card := mul_pos hApos hBpos
    have hprod : h ^ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ (A.card : ℝ) * B.card := by
      have := mul_le_mul hlargeA.le hlargeB.le hn0 hApos.le
      nlinarith only [this]
    have hcancel : K / h ^ 2 * (h ^ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 2) = K * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      field_simp [hh2.ne']
    have herror : K * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ K / h ^ 2 * ((A.card : ℝ) * B.card) := by
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hprod (div_nonneg hK hh2.le)
      rwa [hcancel] at this
    have hstrict := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hmargin hNpos
    have hc := hcoarse A hA B hB
    change |(∑ e ∈ A.product B, p e) - d * A.card * B.card| ≤
      2 * α * A.card * B.card + K * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 at hc
    nlinarith only [hc, herror, hstrict]

theorem WeightedRectangleExpectation
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (U W : Finset V)
    (n l : ℕ) (d γ α : ℝ) (hU : U.card = n) (hW : W.card = n)
    (hd : 0 < d) (hd1 : d ≤ 1) (hγ : 0 < γ) (hα : 0 < α)
    (P : Finpartition (Finset.univ : Finset V))
    (E : Finset (Finset V × Finset V)) (hEP : E ⊆ P.parts.product P.parts)
    (hD : ∀ S T, (S, T) ∈ E →
      d ≤ (G.edgeDensity (U ∩ S) (W ∩ T) : ℝ) ∧
      (G.edgeDensity (U ∩ S) (W ∩ T) : ℝ) ≤ 1)
    (hslice : ∀ S T, (S, T) ∈ E → ∀ A ⊆ U ∩ S, ∀ B ⊆ W ∩ T,
      γ * (U ∩ S).card < (A.card : ℝ) →
      γ * (W ∩ T).card < (B.card : ℝ) →
      |(G.edgeDensity A B : ℝ) - G.edgeDensity (U ∩ S) (W ∩ T)| < 2 * α)
    (harea : (∑ ST ∈ (P.parts.product P.parts).filter (fun ST => ST ∉ E),
      (((U ∩ ST.1).card : ℝ) * (W ∩ ST.2).card)) ≤
      (4 * γ + 9 * α + 6 / (l : ℝ)) * (n : ℝ) ^ 2) :
    ∃ p : V × V → ℝ,
      (∀ e, 0 ≤ p e ∧ p e ≤ 1) ∧
      (∀ e, ¬G.Adj e.1 e.2 → p e = 0) ∧
      (∀ e, e ∉ U.product W → p e = 0) ∧
      (∀ S ∈ P.parts, ∀ T ∈ P.parts,
        ∀ u ∈ U ∩ S, ∀ w ∈ W ∩ T, G.Adj u w →
        p (u, w) = if (S, T) ∈ E then
          d / (G.edgeDensity (U ∩ S) (W ∩ T) : ℝ) else 1) ∧
      (∀ A ⊆ U, ∀ B ⊆ W,
        |(∑ e ∈ A.product B, p e) - d * A.card * B.card| ≤
          2 * α * A.card * B.card +
            (6 * γ + 9 * α + 6 / (l : ℝ)) * (n : ℝ) ^ 2) ∧
      (∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h →
        2 * α + (6 * γ + 9 * α + 6 / (l : ℝ)) / h ^ 2 < h / 4 →
        ∀ A ⊆ U, ∀ B ⊆ W, h * n < (A.card : ℝ) →
        h * n < (B.card : ℝ) →
        |(∑ e ∈ A.product B, p e) - d * A.card * B.card| <
          (h / 4) * A.card * B.card) := by

WeightedRectangleExpectation.tex_proof:
\begin{proof}
Each vertex lies in exactly one part of the partition. For an edge
in $U\times W$, use these unique parts to assign the stated weight;
set all other weights to zero. Thus there is no ambiguity in the
definition. For every eligible pair, $D_{ST}\geq d>0$, so the
denominator is positive and $0<d/D_{ST}\leq1$. The other possible
values are zero and one. All probabilities are consequently valid
before any sampling is undertaken.

Fix $A\subseteq U$, $B\subseteq W$ and write $A_S=A\cap S$,
$B_T=B\cap T$. These chunks partition $A,B$, and their Cartesian
rectangles partition $A\times B$. On an eligible rectangle whose
two intersections exceed their $\gamma$ thresholds, the weight sum
is $(d/D_{ST})e_G(A_S,B_T)$. Both intersections are nonempty:
their sizes are strictly greater than nonnegative numbers. Hence
the count-density identity gives
\[
 \left|(d/D_{ST})e_G(A_S,B_T)-d|A_S||B_T|\right|
 = (d/D_{ST})|d_G(A_S,B_T)-D_{ST}||A_S||B_T|
 \leq2\alpha|A_S||B_T|.
\]
For every other rectangle the weight sum and the target
$d|A_S||B_T|$ both lie in $[0,|A_S||B_T|]$, since $p,d\in[0,1]$.
Their distance is therefore at most its area, also for empty
rectangles.

All ineligible rectangles cost at most
$(4\gamma+9\alpha+6/l)n^2$ by the assumed area inequality and
$A_S\subseteq U\cap S$, $B_T\subseteq W\cap T$.
For eligible rectangles with a small $A_S$, the union of all such
$A_S$ has size at most
$\gamma\sum_S|U\cap S|=\gamma n$, so these rectangles cost at most
$\gamma n^2$. The small $B_T$ rectangles cost at most another
$\gamma n^2$. These bounds apply whether or not the corresponding
other intersection is small, and overlap only overcounts the cost.
On the remaining rectangles the sum of the areas is at most
$|A||B|$. Adding all discrepancies by the triangle inequality
gives exactly
$2\alpha|A||B|+(6\gamma+9\alpha+6/l)n^2$.
For the last assertion fix any real $h>0$ satisfying the stated margin
inequality and put $N=|A||B|$. The strict thresholds and
$h>0$ imply $N>h^2n^2$ and $N>0$, even if $n=0$.
The coefficient $K=6\gamma+9\alpha+6/l$ is nonnegative, including
the real-division convention when $l=0$. Thus $n^2/N\leq1/h^2$.
Dividing the bound just proved by $N$ gives an error at most
$2\alpha+K/h^2<h/4$, as required.
\end{proof}
WeightedRectangleExpectation.tex_statement:
\begin{lemma}[Weighted rectangle expectation]
Let $G$ be a finite simple graph, let $|U|=|W|=n$, let
$0<d\leq1$, $\gamma,\alpha>0$, and let $l$ be natural.
Let $\mathcal P$ be a partition of the whole vertex set and let
$E\subseteq\mathcal P\times\mathcal P$. Assume that, for every
$(S,T)\in E$, $d\leq D_{ST}=d_G(U\cap S,W\cap T)\leq1$, and that
\[
 |d_G(A,B)-D_{ST}|<2\alpha
\]
whenever $A\subseteq U\cap S$, $B\subseteq W\cap T$ have
$|A|>\gamma|U\cap S|$, $|B|>\gamma|W\cap T|$.
Assume also
\[
 \sum_{(S,T)\in(\mathcal P\times\mathcal P)\setminus E}
 |U\cap S||W\cap T|\leq(4\gamma+9\alpha+6/l)n^2.
\]
There is a function $p:V\times V\to[0,1]$, zero on nonedges and
outside $U\times W$, which assigns to every edge from
$u\in U\cap S$ to $w\in W\cap T$ the value $d/D_{ST}$ if
$(S,T)\in E$, and the value $1$ otherwise. For all $A\subseteq U$,
$B\subseteq W$, its total weight satisfies
\[
 \left|\sum_{(a,b)\in A\times B}p(a,b)-d|A||B|\right|
 \leq2\alpha|A||B|+(6\gamma+9\alpha+6/l)n^2.
\]
The same function $p$ has the following property for every real $h$:
if $h>0$ and $2\alpha+(6\gamma+9\alpha+6/l)/h^2<h/4$, then
for all such $A,B$ with $|A|,|B|>hn$ the same discrepancy is
strictly less than $(h/4)|A||B|$. Real division is used, with the usual
zero-denominator convention.
\end{lemma}

classical
  let U : Finset (Fin n) := Finset.univ
  let S := U.powersetCard s
  let F (x : ℕ) := S.filter (fun A => (A ∩ M).card = x)
  have hU : U.card = n := by simp [U]
  have hcomp : (U \ M).card = n - M.card := by
    rw [Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset (Finset.subset_univ M), hU]
  have hprod (A : Finset (Fin n)) :
      (∏ i ∈ A, if i ∈ M then r else 1) = r ^ (A ∩ M).card := by
    rw [← Finset.prod_filter]
    have : A.filter (fun i => i ∈ M) = A ∩ M := by ext; simp
    rw [this, Finset.prod_const]
  have hcount (x : ℕ) (hx : x ≤ s) :
      (F x).card = M.card.choose x * (n - M.card).choose (s - x) := by
    let T := M.powersetCard x ×ˢ (U \ M).powersetCard (s - x)
    have hbij : (F x).card = T.card := by
      apply Finset.card_bij (fun A _ => (A ∩ M, A \ M))
      · intro A hA
        obtain ⟨hAS, hAx⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hA
        have hAc : A.card = s := (Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp hAS).2
        apply Finset.mem_product.mpr
        constructor
        · exact Finset.mem_powersetCard.mpr ⟨Finset.inter_subset_right, hAx⟩
        · apply Finset.mem_powersetCard.mpr
          constructor
          · intro i hi
            exact Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ i, (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hi).2⟩
          · rw [Finset.card_sdiff, Finset.inter_comm, hAx, hAc]
      · intro A hA B hB hAB
        have h1 : A ∩ M = B ∩ M := congrArg Prod.fst hAB
        have h2 : A \ M = B \ M := congrArg Prod.snd hAB
        have hAeq : (A ∩ M) ∪ (A \ M) = A := by ext; simp; tauto
        have hBeq : (B ∩ M) ∪ (B \ M) = B := by ext; simp; tauto
        rw [← hAeq, ← hBeq, h1, h2]
      · intro B hB
        obtain ⟨hBM, hBC⟩ := Finset.mem_product.mp hB
        obtain ⟨hBMsub, hBMcard⟩ := Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp hBM
        obtain ⟨hBCsub, hBCcard⟩ := Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp hBC
        have hd : Disjoint B.1 B.2 := by
          apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
          intro i hi hj
          exact (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp (hBCsub hj)).2 (hBMsub hi)
        have hi : (B.1 ∪ B.2) ∩ M = B.1 := by
          ext i
          simp only [Finset.mem_inter, Finset.mem_union]
          constructor
          · rintro ⟨hi | hi, hm⟩
            · exact hi
            · exact False.elim ((Finset.mem_sdiff.mp (hBCsub hi)).2 hm)
          · intro hi
            exact ⟨Or.inl hi, hBMsub hi⟩
        have hc : (B.1 ∪ B.2) \ M = B.2 := by
          ext i
          simp only [Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_union]
          constructor
          · rintro ⟨hi | hi, hm⟩
            · exact False.elim (hm (hBMsub hi))
            · exact hi
          · intro hi
            exact ⟨Or.inr hi, (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp (hBCsub hi)).2⟩
        refine ⟨B.1 ∪ B.2, ?_, ?_⟩
        · apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
          constructor
          · apply Finset.mem_powersetCard.mpr
            refine ⟨Finset.subset_univ _, ?_⟩
            rw [Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hd, hBMcard, hBCcard]
            omega
          · rw [hi, hBMcard]
        · exact Prod.ext hi hc
    rw [hbij, Finset.card_product, Finset.card_powersetCard,
      Finset.card_powersetCard, hcomp]
  have hsum :
      (∑ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ∑ A ∈ F x,
        ∏ i ∈ A, if i ∈ M then r else 1) =
      ∑ A ∈ S, ∏ i ∈ A, if i ∈ M then r else 1 := by
    apply Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to
    intro A hA
    apply Finset.mem_range.mpr
    have hAc : A.card = s := (Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp hA).2
    have := Finset.card_le_card (Finset.inter_subset_left (s₁ := A) (s₂ := M))
    omega
  rw [← hsum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro x hx
  by_cases hxs : x ≤ s
  · rw [if_pos hxs]
    calc
      _ = ∑ _A ∈ F x, r ^ x := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro A hA
        rw [hprod, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hA).2]
      _ = _ := by simp [hcount x hxs, Nat.cast_mul]
  · rw [if_neg hxs]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro A hA
    obtain ⟨hAS, hAx⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hA
    have hAc : A.card = s := (Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp hAS).2
    have := Finset.card_le_card (Finset.inter_subset_left (s₁ := A) (s₂ := M))
    omega
WeightedSubsetIntersectionSum.lean_statement:
open scoped BigOperators

theorem WeightedSubsetIntersectionSum (n s : ℕ) (hs : s ≤ n)
    (M : Finset (Fin n)) (r : ℝ) :
    (∑ A ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).powersetCard s,
      ∏ i ∈ A, if i ∈ M then r else 1) =
    ∑ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
      if x ≤ s then
        ((M.card.choose x : ℝ) * ((n - M.card).choose (s - x) : ℝ)) * r ^ x
      else 0 := by
WeightedSubsetIntersectionSum.name: WeightedSubsetIntersectionSum
WeightedSubsetIntersectionSum.tex_proof:
\begin{proof}
Put $U=\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. For each $s$-subset $A$ of $U$, its weight is
$r^{|A\cap M|}$, since precisely the factors indexed by $A\cap M$ are
$r$, and the other factors are $1$. Its intersection size lies between
$0$ and $s\le n$, so partitioning all $s$-subsets according to this size
accounts for each summand exactly once.

Fix $x\le s$. The map
\[
 A\longmapsto (A\cap M,A\setminus M)
\]
is a bijection from the $s$-subsets having marked intersection size $x$
to the pairs $(B,C)$ where $B\subseteq M$, $|B|=x$,
$C\subseteq U\setminus M$, and $|C|=s-x$.
Indeed, for an $A$ in this fiber, $A\cap M$ has size $x$, and the disjoint
decomposition $A=(A\cap M)\cup(A\setminus M)$ gives
$|A\setminus M|=s-x$. Conversely, for such a pair, $B$ and $C$ are
disjoint, so $A=B\cup C$ has size $x+(s-x)=s$; moreover
$A\cap M=B$ and $A\setminus M=C$. Union is therefore a two-sided inverse.
There are $\binom{t}{x}$ choices for $B$ and
$\binom{n-t}{s-x}$ choices for $C$, by the finite-subset counting formula.
All members of the fiber have weight $r^x$, giving the stated contribution.
If either requested subset size exceeds the corresponding ambient size,
its family is empty and the same counting formula gives zero.

For $x>s$ the fiber is empty because $A\cap M\subseteq A$ implies
$|A\cap M|\le |A|=s$. Its contribution is thus zero, independently of
any convention for truncated subtraction. Summing the fiber contributions
over $x=0,\ldots,n$ proves the identity, also when $s=0$ or $r=0$.
\end{proof}
